title: Full Stack Mern Developer
description:
Workana is the largest remote work platform for talents in Latin America. Our Workana Premium segment focuses on connecting exceptional professionals with leading companies around the world, offering competitive compensation, dedicated support, and the flexibility of remote work.

We are pleased to present the following opportunity.

About Our Client

OurOffice is a U.S.-based SaaS startup developing technology solutions for organizations that need secure, scalable, and reliable software. The company is seeking a senior-level Full Stack MERN Developer to work directly with its hands‑on CTO and take ownership of complex production systems.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable working across the frontend, backend, database, integrations, and AWS infrastructure. A key initiative for this role is the development of a secure Data Export and Analytics API that will allow external platforms, including Microsoft Power BI, to access organization‑scoped SaaS data efficiently and securely.

Role Overview

As a Full Stack MERN Developer, you will maintain and scale an established MERN application while building new features and improving the platform’s security, performance, reliability, and observability.

You will be responsible for designing and implementing secure multi‑tenant APIs, large‑data processing workflows, integrations with third‑party services, and end‑to‑end product features using React, Redux, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and AWS.

This is a long‑term remote opportunity for a senior or expert engineer based in Latin America who can work during U.S. West Coast business hours and communicate fluently in English.

Responsibilities

  • Maintain, debug, and scale a production MERN application.
  • Build secure Data Export and Analytics APIs for Microsoft Power BI and other external systems.
  • Design large‑data workflows using MongoDB cursors, batching, Node.js streams, CSV exports, and Amazon S3.
  • Implement secure multi‑tenant access with authentication, authorization, API credentials, rate limiting, and strict organization‑level data isolation.
  • Design and optimize MongoDB and Mongoose schemas, indexes, aggregation pipelines, Atlas Search configurations, and database queries.
  • Analyze query performance using tools such as explain() and implement appropriate optimization strategies.
  • Build reliable asynchronous workflows with concurrency controls, retries, idempotency, leases, locks, timeouts, and failure recovery.
  • Develop new features end‑to‑end across React, Redux, Node.js, and Express.
  • Integrate and maintain third‑party services, including AI/NLP tools, Twilio, SendGrid, Stripe, Microsoft services, Slack, and AWS services.
  • Improve application performance, security, reliability, logging, monitoring, and observability.
  • Investigate and resolve production issues in a large, established application.
  • Collaborate directly with the CTO to define technical solutions, prioritize work, and deliver reliable production features.
  • Contribute to technical documentation, development standards, and continuous improvement of the platform.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience developing full stack applications with the MERN stack.
  • Advanced experience with MongoDB, Express, React, and Node.js.
  • Strong experience designing and developing backend systems and production‑grade APIs.
  • Proven experience building data‑access, reporting, analytics, or data‑export APIs.
  • Strong knowledge of REST APIs, API design, and API versioning.
  • Solid understanding of authentication, authorization, and multi‑tenant application security.
  • Practical experience with Node.js streams, backpressure, batching, and processing large datasets without loading everything into memory.
  • Strong knowledge of concurrency, retries, idempotency, timeouts, failure recovery, and asynchronous processing.
  • Deep experience with MongoDB indexes, aggregation pipelines, query optimization, explain(), and Mongoose.
  • Strong AWS experience, particularly with EC2, S3, IAM, CloudFront, and WAF.
  • Strong React and Redux experience in established production codebases.
  • Availability to work in alignment with U.S. West Coast / Los Angeles business hours.

Nice to Have

  • Experience integrating applications with Microsoft Power BI or Power Query.
  • Knowledge of Tableau, Looker, OData, or other analytics and data‑platform integrations.
  • Experience with Amazon SQS, EventBridge, Lambda, or background‑worker architectures.
  • Experience integrating Twilio, SendGrid, Stripe, Microsoft Graph, Azure, Okta, SAML, or Slack.
  • Experience with AI/LLM integrations, embeddings, vector search, or retrieval‑augmented generation systems.
  • Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, deployment pipelines, and production releases.
  • Previous experience working in SaaS, B2B software, or multi‑tenant environments.
  • Compensation in USD.
  • Fully remote, long‑term opportunity.
  • Work directly with a technical founder and CTO.
  • Professional growth toward a technical lead position.

title: People Data & Insights Engineer
company: MEX - 9930 Takeda Innovation Solutions Mexico S.A de C.V
description:
Job Description

We are seeking a People Data & Insights Engineer to build and scale the data foundation that powers People Analytics at Takeda. This role sits at the intersection of data engineering and workforce insights, focusing on transforming complex HR and employee experience data into structured and reliable data assets. This position is embedded within Takeda's People Analytics and Capabilities team and requires deep engagement with HR use cases such as talent metrics, employee listening, and workforce planning, ensuring data is not only technically sound, but analytically meaningful.

How you will contribute

  • Design and maintain robust pipelines that integrate HR systems (HRIS, ATS, survey/listening platforms, etc.) into curated, reusable datasets.
  • Build data models that support consistent reporting, longitudinal analysis (e.g., workforce changes over time), and deeper insights into employee experience.
  • Partner closely with People Analysts and HR stakeholders to understand evolving business questions and embed them into well-designed data models and pipelines.
  • Implement validation checks, reconciliation logic, and monitoring processes to ensure the integrity of people data across sources and time.
  • Build and maintain datasets that power consistent reporting across core People Analytics domains (e.g., hiring, retention, mobility, skills, engagement).
  • Create clear documentation and reusable frameworks to improve how people data is modeled, accessed, and reused across the function.
  • Apply AI-assisted approaches (e.g., code generation, data exploration, documentation, and troubleshooting) to accelerate development, improve code quality, and streamline pipeline and data model creation.

Skills and qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Computer Science, Economics, Analytics) or equivalent experience ~3-6 years of experience in analytics, data engineering, or people analytics.
  • Advanced SQL and experience working with large, complex datasets.
  • Proficiency in Python (or similar) for data processing and automation.
  • Experience with cloud data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake).
  • Strong experience designing analytical data models (e.g., dimensional modeling, time-series structures).
  • Proficiency communicating in English language is mandatory.
  • Experience working with HR data (HRIS, recruiting, survey/listening platforms) or other complex behavioral datasets.
  • Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured data solutions.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Our 'black belt' specialists are leaders in their domains: digital champions, delivery-focused experts, top-tier security professionals, AI thought leaders, and engineering best practice advocates.

As 1 of Australia's fastest-growing software businesses, Software at Scale delivers cutting-edge technology solutions that power mission-critical platforms. We solve complex engineering challenges at scale, driving quality, performance, and resilience through the strength of our people.

Our 'black belt' specialists are leaders in their domains: digital champions, delivery-focused experts, top-tier security professionals, AI thought leaders, and engineering best practice advocates.

As 1 of Australia's fastest-growing software businesses, Software at Scale delivers cutting-edge technology solutions that power mission-critical platforms. We solve complex engineering challenges at scale, driving quality, performance, and resilience through the strength of our people.

The Role & The Challenge

We are seeking a highly proactive, commercially minded AI-Empowered Senior Data AI Engineer to play a key role in designing and scaling data foundations that directly power advanced artificial intelligence systems.

This is not a traditional pipeline-building role. You will operate within complex enterprise environments, taking the initiative to actively source required data assets, build robust enterprise data models that make sound commercial sense, and bridge the gap between raw data engineering and data science.

You will step into a high-trust, fully empowered environment where you are expected to take complete technical ownership, align data architectures with strategic business priorities, and leverage statistical rigour to solve complex enterprise problems.

AI Access & Claude Code: We actively encourage our engineers to solve problems using AI. You will have full access to enterprise GenAI tooling, including Claude Code, to accelerate data transformations, pipeline refactoring, and code generation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Proactive Asset Discovery: Act as a technical catalyst within the enterprise. Autonomously source, evaluate, and integrate required data asset sources across complex business domains, ensuring high data readiness for AI initiatives.
  • Commercial Enterprise Modelling: Design and build high-impact enterprise data models that align directly with business priorities and drive measurable commercial value.
  • Modern Data Stack Execution: Architect and optimise large-scale data platforms using Snowflake (strongly preferred) or Databricks (highly preferred), ensuring high performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
  • Statistical & Analytical Rigour: Apply a deep understanding of statistics and data patterns to validate data integrity, shape feature engineering, and support advanced machine learning workloads.
  • AI-Driven Engineering: Extensively utilise Claude Code and modern agentic tools to accelerate pipeline refactoring, test automation, and code generation.
  • Pipeline Architecture & Orchestration: Build and optimise robust data pipelines, ELT frameworks (using tools like dbt), and orchestration layers (such as Airflow) to feed analytical and AI systems seamlessly.
  • Data Governance & Quality: Implement rigorous data quality controls, governance standards, and operational monitoring across all data products.

What You Bring

  • Commercial & Strategic Acumen: A sharp understanding of business priorities. You don't just move data from point A to point B; you design models that make strict commercial sense and solve real business problems.
  • Data Platform Mastery: Deep, hands‑on commercial expertise with industry‑leading data platforms—Snowflake is strongly preferred, and proficiency with Databricks is highly desirable.
  • Statistical & Analytical Foundation: A solid grasp of applied statistics, enabling you to reason about data distributions, feature relevance, and data quality metrics for AI use cases.
  • Proactive Enterprise Navigation: Proven experience operating within large, complex enterprise environments where you independently hunt down data sources, untangle ambiguity, and drive alignment with stakeholders.
  • Senior‑Level Engineering: Advanced SQL and Python skills, alongside strong experience with modern ELT frameworks (dbt) and workflow orchestration (Airflow).
  • AI Fluency: Practical experience using Claude Code and AI tooling to accelerate data engineering workflows.

What We Offer

  • The chance to work for 1 of Australia's fastest-growing and most innovative software businesses.
  • Full access to cutting‑edge AI tooling, including Claude Code.
  • Meaningful, hands‑on data and AI engineering work on mission‑critical enterprise platforms.
  • Clear growth pathways from Senior to Staff and beyond.
  • A low‑ceremony, delivery‑focused environment that values engineers who own outcomes.
  • Competitive remuneration and benefits.

title: Lead/Senior Backend/Full stack Javascript Developer
description:
We're a fast growing fin-tech startup making waves in the lending industry. We've built an innovative product that has just been launched into market and now we're looking to go to the next level. We're well funded with backing from heavy weights in the industry. We're not just looking to be disruptive but to take over.

About us

We're a fast growing fin-tech startup making waves in the lending industry. We've built an innovative product that has just been launched into market and now we're looking to go to the next level. We're well funded with backing from heavy weights in the industry. We're not just looking to be disruptive but to take over.

About the role

We're looking for a strong senior, back-end focused engineer. Our stack is predominantly TypeScript/Node, and you'll be working with us on many different elements of our platform, from:

  • integrating AI into our broker platform,
  • building out our APIs and corresponding SDKs, and integrating with commercial partners,
  • dabbling in our Electron-based desktop application and (React) web application,
  • working on UI automation over websockets / CDP,
  • changing our event-driven durable execution pipelines (Inngest),
  • provisioning infrastructure across Cloudflare and AWS

Being a small team, we're used to jumping on all ends of the stack to tackle our priorities effectively, and we don't tend to have static, pigeon-holed responsibilities.

We make heavy use of AI to write code at Financeable, and our team have experience across multiple harnesses including Claude/Codex/Amp/Cursor/OpenCode etc, we're looking for similarly curious engineers with opinions about the tools they use.

You should have:

  • 5+ years experience as a developer
  • Extensive experience working with TypeScript, knowledge of other languages like Go greatly appreciated.
  • Knowledge of observability tools, vendors and ecosystem. We utilise Honeycomb.io, but knowledge of OTEL generally is highly regarded.
  • Infrastructure-as-code experience is a must - we provision application infrastructure exclusively via IAC. We utilise a mixture of Serverless Stack and Alchemy, across AWS and Cloudflare.
  • Experience and knowledge regarding API management (versioning, documentation) is a plus.

Nice to have:

  • Experience working in Finance/Banking
  • Experience working with distributed/remote teams
  • Experience with feature toggling
  • Knowledge of emerging trends like Local First, Durable Compute, LLMs generally.
  • Domain Driven Design knowledge is appreciated but not essential.
  • Opinionated about error handling: do you prefer treating errors as values or throwing exceptions? How do you ensure your error output meets your API spec?

Why join us

  • Very competitive salary
  • Relaxed, flexible and accommodating working environment
  • Equity opportunities
  • Free tech - keep the equipment we buy you!
  • Get in on the ground level of a fast growing company
  • Make your mark - you'll have direct influence on the product
  • We're tons of fun - loads of team, community and industry events on the calendar

title: Commercial GTM Associate
description:
About Poseidon Aerospace:

Poseidon Aerospace is reimagining how the world moves goods. We build and operate full-size autonomous cargo aircraft - capable of carrying two tons of payload over a thousand nautical miles. From remote communities to contested logistics operations, our platforms unlock a new cost curve for air freight, making it faster, cheaper, and accessible anywhere it's needed. Headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area with locations in Washington DC, Oregon, and Maine; we're building something consequential.

About the role

Our commercial team is building the business that brings Poseidon’s aircraft into the world. This means understanding where our technology can create the most value, developing markets, and building the customer relationships and partnerships that support a new approach to air cargo.

As a Commercial GTM Associate, you will be on the frontlines of that effort, building customer relationships, developing new markets, launching services, and selling air cargo. You will work across commercial strategy, partnerships, and regulatory and operational requirements to close new cargo business. The role involves frequent travel and close collaboration with customers, partners, and our engineering, regulatory, and operations teams. You will take ownership from the first customer conversation through commercial agreements, service launch, and continued growth.

We are looking for a generalist with a high work rate, intellectual curiosity, and the resourcefulness to make progress in unfamiliar environments. You should be excited by the breadth of work involved in building a company and willing to take responsibility for problems whose solutions are not yet obvious. Your understanding of customers and markets will help shape both our commercial direction and what we build.

What you’ll do

  • Help develop and execute Poseidon’s commercial go-to-market strategy across domestic and international markets.

  • Build relationships with customers, operating partners, and other organizations central to bringing new air cargo services into operation.

  • Identify commercial opportunities and work through the customer, economic, and operational questions that determine their potential.

  • Close new cargo business, taking ownership from initial outreach through proposals, commercial agreements, service launch, and account growth.

  • Work with our regulatory and operations teams to understand market-entry requirements and advance commercial opportunities.

  • Bring customer insights into Poseidon’s product, partnership, and market-entry decisions.

  • Help build the commercial capabilities and approaches that allow Poseidon to grow.

What we’re looking for

  • A high work rate and a strong sense of responsibility for the outcome.

  • Evidence of learning quickly, taking initiative, and accomplishing something difficult.

  • The ability to reason from first principles and form a clear view when information is incomplete.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to earn trust across different backgrounds and disciplines.

  • Comfort moving between analytical work, customer relationships, and hands-on execution.

  • Willingness to travel frequently to develop customer relationships and advance commercial opportunities.

  • Receptiveness to direct feedback and the ambition to take on progressively greater responsibility.

  • Curiosity about technology, logistics, and the practical work of building a business.

A background in air cargo or logistics is valuable, but not required. Nontraditional backgrounds are welcome. We care more about how quickly you learn and what you are capable of becoming than a particular degree, industry background, or number of years of experience.

What you get from us

  • Competitive salary and meaningful early-stage equity

  • Relocation support if applicable

  • Employee Health Benefit Plans

  • 6% Retirement matching

  • Flexible PTO

  • Free lunches, snacks, and a stocked fridge at our offices

  • AI tools and subscriptions

title: CRM Program Manager - UAE (contract - remote)
description:
CRM Program Manager (contract - remote)

Team: Consumer Marketing

Reports to: Head of Consumer Marketing

Level: Manager (program-level ownership)

About Cambly

Cambly is a global language learning platform that connects learners with tutors for real conversation practice, supported by AI-powered learning tools. We help students around the world build confidence and fluency in English.

About the Role

We're looking for a CRM Program Manager to lead Cambly's customer relationship management strategy and execution — delivering the right message to the right customer at the right time, via the right channel. This is a global role covering Cambly's markets across Latin America, Europe/Middle East, and Asia. You will run one CRM strategy with market-specific channel and messaging execution. You'll own CRM across email, in-app, push, and messaging apps, including expansion into local chat platforms such as WhatsApp, WeChat, and KakaoTalk.

This role combines strategic program management, cross-functional leadership, and CRM platform expertise to drive acquisition, engagement, and retention based on deep analysis of user behavior. You'll own the CRM roadmap, platform strategy, audience strategy, deliverability health, major CRM initiatives (including AI integrations), and performance measurement across regions. You'll partner with creative, growth, product, data, engineering, and regional teams, and work closely with operational specialists who execute day-to-day campaign setup.

What You'll Do

CRM Strategy & Program Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end CRM strategy across email, in-app, push, and messaging apps, aligned to acquisition, engagement, and retention KPIs.

  • Build and maintain the CRM roadmap, balancing evergreen lifecycle programs, promotional campaigns, and strategic initiatives.

  • Own the messaging-app channel strategy by market: WhatsApp (e.g., Brazil, Turkey, Arabic-speaking markets), WeChat (China), KakaoTalk (Korea), and other local platforms as markets warrant. Lead each from evaluation and pilot through rollout.

  • Set the global CRM framework and define what can be localized by market (channel mix, timing, offers, tone) and what stays standard.

  • Serve as the single point of accountability for CRM outcomes and leadership reporting.

CRM Platform & Vendor Management

  • Evaluate and manage messaging providers and official business account setups per platform (e.g., WhatsApp Business API providers, WeChat Official Accounts, KakaoTalk business channels), including template approvals and platform policy compliance.

  • Own platform relationships (e.g., Iterable), including contracts, roadmap alignment, feature adoption, and renewals.

  • Drive strategic CRM innovation projects, such as AI/LLM integrations with the CRM stack, from discovery through rollout and measurement.

  • Identify gaps across the CRM stack and champion investments that reduce cost, improve efficiency, or unlock new capabilities.

Audiences & Lifecycle Journeys

  • Partner with PMs and engineers to co-design lifecycle programs, in-product messaging surfaces, event instrumentation, and journey delivery mechanics.

  • Define audience segmentation and lead qualification frameworks — who we reach, via which channel, and at which lifecycle stage.

  • Own audiences and lists across markets: segmentation, hygiene, suppression, and ongoing maintenance.

  • Develop customer journey and audience insights that improve profitability, delivery, and engagement.

  • Design and oversee automated journeys, personalization, and experimentation standards (subject lines, send times, cohorts, journey structures), including promotional updates.

Analytics, Measurement & Optimization

  • Own CRM KPIs, dashboards, and reporting across all channels.

  • Report CRM performance by market and channel, with cross-market comparisons in the WBR.

  • Own email deliverability health (bounces, spam complaints, warming, IP/domain reputation), partnering with engineering and ESPs.

  • Design and lead CRM experiments and turn learnings into durable program improvements.

  • Tie CRM performance to business outcomes (LTV, retention, activation, payback) with actionable recommendations.

Cross-Functional Program Management

  • Lead planning, execution, and retros for major campaigns (promotions, product launches, regional initiatives).

  • Partner with product and data teams to make every initiative measurable end-to-end — event tracking, data pipelines, attribution, and metric integrity.

  • Coordinate workstreams across marketing, product, engineering, data, and regional stakeholders.

  • Document CRM processes, playbooks, and standards so execution is repeatable.

  • Secure creative resourcing before committing to timelines; write clear creative briefs, and step in on messaging and copy when needed.

AI, Automation & Innovation

  • Automate reporting, monitoring, and manual workflows using AI, scripts, and no-code/low-code tools.

  • Use AI to deliver high-quality, culturally accurate localization and scale content without sacrificing brand voice.

  • Lead AI adoption within CRM — personalization, copy generation, segmentation, and journey optimization — and share learnings across marketing.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in CRM, lifecycle, or retention marketing, ideally at a consumer subscription, mobile, or edtech company.

  • Hands-on expertise with a modern CRM/ESP platform (e.g., Iterable, Braze, ), including journey building and segmentation.

  • Proven track record owning CRM strategy and roadmap with measurable impact on acquisition, engagement, and retention.

  • Strong analytical skills — comfortable with dashboards, experimentation, and SQL or similar tools.

  • Working knowledge of email deliverability best practices.

  • Experience running multi-market or international CRM programs; familiarity with messaging apps like WhatsApp, WeChat, or KakaoTalk is a plus.

  • Excellent cross-functional program management and stakeholder communication skills.

  • Strong writing skills and the ability to brief creative teams or draft copy directly.

  • Curiosity and hands-on experience using AI and automation to improve marketing workflows.

What Success Looks Like

  • CRM is a clearly defined, strategically led function with a published roadmap and measurable impact.

  • Audiences are well segmented and maintained; deliverability is strong and proactively managed.

  • CRM is meaningfully expanded onto local chat platforms, driving incremental engagement and revenue.

  • Journey and audience insights drive higher-profitability segments and better engagement — not just more sends.

  • CRM results are clearly and consistently represented in the Weekly Business Review.

  • Product, data, and engineering see CRM as a true technical partner — every initiative is instrumented from day one.

  • The CRM stack is used to its full potential, and major initiatives are delivered end-to-end.

  • Manual workflows are increasingly automated, and AI powers high-quality localization and content at scale.

title: English Transcriber
description:

Our service offerings cover end-to-end workflows including language services such as scripting, subtitling, access services, dubbing, text and metadata localization in over 50 languages. Enjoy delicious catered meals, unlimited snacks and drinks, and a fun office activity area for games and stress relief. We also provide free internet for remote work, convenient office transportation, and a rewarding referral bonus system.

title: #EG AI Data Engineer
description:
NCS is a leading technology services firm that operates across the Asia Pacific region in over 20 cities, providing consulting, digital services, technology solutions, and more. We believe in harnessing the power of technology to achieve extraordinary things, creating lasting value and impact for our communities, partners, and people. Our diverse workforce of 15,000 has delivered large-scale, mission-critical, and multi-platform projects for governments and enterprises in Singapore and the APAC region.

We are looking for an AI Engineer with strong Data Engineering expertise to join a mission-critical project in the public safety and security domain.

Operating within a secure IT environment, you will work across advanced Agentic AI architectures and scalable data infrastructure. You will design and deploy Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, metadata-driven data catalogs, fine-grained policy systems, and sovereign agent workflows that empower data-driven decision-making for public sector stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Delivery

  • Agentic AI & LLM Systems: Build and deploy autonomous agent workflows using frameworks like LangChain, CrewAI, or AutoGen. Implement semantic search, vector indexing, custom prompt strategies, and RAG architectures tailored for sensitive datasets.
  • Modern Data Engineering: Develop high-throughput, maintainable data transformation pipelines using Python and dbt. Utilize modern query engines and open table formats (Starburst, Apache Iceberg, Apache Arrow, DuckDB) to query and analyze structured and unstructured data efficiently.
  • Metadata & Taxonomy Governance: Design and govern metadata schemas, taxonomies, and lineage systems using tools like OpenMetadata to guarantee strict data discoverability, auditability, and governance.
  • Secure Architecture & Policy Enforcement: Integrate fine-grained authorization and data access control frameworks leveraging Cedar, ensuring alignment with OSI and ODSC guidelines in restricted public sector infrastructure.

Client & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Support client workshops and daily interactions: requirements discovery, solution walkthroughs, sprint demos, and retrospectives.
  • Communicate technical trade-offs and design decisions in clear, non-jargon language appropriate for business stakeholders.

Qualifications

Experience & Education

  • 2–4 years of hands-on AI/ML engineering or data science experience.
  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Engineering, or equivalent quantitative discipline.
  • Experience in delivery of complex AI projects end-to-end in a professional services, consulting, or SI environment.
  • Demonstrable agentic AI project experience.

Technical Skills

  • Core Engineering: Strong foundation in Python development, clean code practices, and standard software design patterns.
  • AI & Agent Frameworks: Hands-on experience developing LLM applications, prompt engineering, semantic search, and multi-agent systems using LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar frameworks.
  • Data Infrastructure & Stack: Exposure to data modeling and pipeline development using dbt, alongside hands‑on familiarity with Starburst, Apache Iceberg, Apache Arrow, and DuckDB.
  • Metadata & Data Governance: Understanding of metadata management and taxonomy design, with experience implementing data cataloging solutions (OpenMetadata or equivalent).
  • Security & Governance Standards: Experience with access control systems, authorization policies (Cedar), and enterprise/government data frameworks (OSI, ODSC).

Client & Communication Skills

  • Strong written and verbal communication: able to produce client-ready documentation, presentations, and technical specifications.

Nice-to-Have / Preferred

  • Sovereign & On-Prem AI: Experience deploying LLMs or AI workloads in air‑gapped, sovereign, or strictly controlled on‑premise environments.
  • Tool-Calling & Protocols: Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and structured tool/function calling patterns.
  • Domain Background: Prior work in government, defence, financial institutions or equivalent high‑security and highly-regulated IT environments.

Additional Information

We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

title: Full Stack Developer/Engineer x2
description:
Help shape the future of free access to law in Australia. A rare opportunity to take on a high-impact role enhancing access to justice in the AI era.

Join AustLII at a pivotal moment and work with recognised pioneers in computer science and law to shape the future of free legal information

About the job

AustLII (austlii.edu.au) is at a pivotal point in its growth. Under the leadership of world-class academics in computer science and law, we are developing the next generation of legal information services, combining trusted legal content, advanced search capabilities and new and emerging AI technologies to further strengthen free access to legal information in Australia.

As a member of the newly established Software Engineering team at the centre of this transformation, you will help build scalable backend services and intuitive frontend interfaces that integrate seamlessly and deliver quality user-facing applications. You will provide engineering expertise in the design and development of large-scale legal information, search and AI-enabled platforms and services. Working closely with our Data & Content and Infrastructure teams, you will contribute to collaborative, agile ways of working and a culture of innovation across the organisation.

Organisational background

AustLII is Australia’s most-used free-access online resource for Australian legal information, serving more than 500 million page access requests last year — over 1 million per day — from more than 13 million distinct hosts.

Since 1995, AustLII has built the most comprehensive curated collection of Australian primary and secondary legal information and made it freely and anonymously available to the community online. In doing so, AustLII has created a service that plays a fundamental role in the Australian legal system, safeguards the integrity of Australian law and supports national data sovereignty.

Sitting at the intersection of technology and the law, AustLII pioneered free online access to legal information in Australia and helped shape similar services around the world. Now, on the cusp of the most significant transformation in access to information since the development of the World Wide Web, AustLII is ready to pioneer once more. We are uniquely placed to develop AI-assisted tools that make Australian legal information easier to discover, understand and navigate for citizens, courts, government, educators and legal professionals.

What we offer

We offer meaningful work and an opportunity to help build technology with impact:

Be part of a mission-driven organisation creating technology with real-world impact

title: At Your Service Center Associate, Fox Valley - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an At Your Service Center Colleague, you are at the heart of delivering a seamless and personalized shopping experience. You’ll support all At Your Service activities, including Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS), merchandise returns, order pickups, and other assigned tasks - all while upholding Macy’s service standards.

This role goes far beyond just being a cashier. Here, the customer is at the heart of everything we do - every day, all day. If you're passionate about selling, reaching goals, working as a team, and creating amazing experiences through genuine hospitality, this could be the perfect fit for you! You’ll also help keep the shopping space clean, organized, and inviting so every customer feels welcome the moment they walk in.

How Our At Your Service Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Every day starts with a positive example. As an At Your Service Colleagues (AYS), you come in energized and ready to make an impact - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting teammates with warmth, and helping ensure the At Your Service areas is clean, organized, and ready for customers. You help set the pace by reviewing sales goals, learning about new arrivals and top-selling items, and staying up to date on trends and promotions - so you’re prepared to support the team and engage customers confidently.
  • In the At Your Service area, you lead through action - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships. Assist customers in all aspects of total store fulfillment, including By Online and Pick Up in Store, be proficient in all systems needed to complete transactions, and ensure the collection area is organized so the customer pick-up experience is friction-free
  • You help maintain a shoppable space by recovering merchandise and keeping the pickup and return areas clean while ensuring timely completion and curbside delivery of Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS) orders.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Makes prompt, sound decisions in real time to effectively address customer needs and resolve issues
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics
  • You can handle electronic devices with no problem

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands.
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs. stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level.
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment.
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

This job description is not all-inclusive and may not apply to colleagues covered by a collective bargaining agreement. Macy's Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to an inclusive work environment.

title: Program Manager, Hospital Partnerships
description:
Join Us in Transforming Lives Every Day

At OneLegacy, every moment counts. As the nation's largest organ, eye, and tissue recovery organization, we are dedicated to saving lives and sharing hope. Guided by our values of integrity, compassion, stewardship, diversity and inclusion, urgency, innovation and excellence, and collaboration, our team works tirelessly to honor every gift of donation. This is more than a job; it’s an opportunity to make a profound impact on countless lives.

This is the career in medicine that you never knew existed. An exciting and rewarding profession in the field of organ and tissue donation, where you can truly save lives and make a difference every day.

Job Type: Full-time, Exempt.

Work Hours: The workweek for full-time exempt employees is normally considered to be 40 hours; however, greater emphasis is placed on meeting the responsibilities assigned to the position than on working a specified number of hours. Must be available evenings, holidays, and weekends as required.

Work Setting: In-person and Field Service Area

Location: Azusa, CA

Travel: Frequently required to travel by personal auto to hospitals, meeting sites, and other locations within our service area.

Summary of Functions:

The Program Manager, Hospital Partnerships (PMHP) is a primarily field-based position designed to oversee the donation programs within hospitals and inspire hospital partners to build a positive culture of donation while maximizing their potential for organ, eye and tissue donation. As the primary liaison between OneLegacy and the hospital, the PMHP fosters collaboration and communication with healthcare professionals and develops customized donation programs to ensure hospital and donor family experiences are consistent and meet the highest level of quality service. Along with cultivating relationships, the PMHP advocates for those on the donor registry and patients awaiting life-saving transplants.
Utilizing data-driven strategies, the PMHP guides key administration and hospital team members in developing policies and procedures per federal and state guidelines to address process improvement and ensure optimal performance outcomes. Hospital development oversight includes, but is not limited to, managing the donation process to fruition, analyzing, and presenting donation metrics, conducting educational in-services, and addressing any challenges in real time to support the donation process. The PMHP functions as a subject matter expert for both hospital partners and OneLegacy team members in achieving success with the donation process.

Duties & Responsibilities:

Essential Job Functions:

Apply the three pillars of building Relationships, Systems and Resources to ensure the success of the donation process and the efficiency of OneLegacy operations.

Relationships:

  1. Implement and manage customized hospital organ, eye and tissue donation programs while strategizing with hospital partners to achieve Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) benchmarks.
  2. Establish working relationships with physician groups to provide support services for active referrals and donors. Examples include intensivist, hospitalist, trauma, and palliative care groups.
  3. Proactively identify educational opportunities within hospital and physician groups and conduct education to meet or exceed CMS conditions of participation.
  4. Establish and maintain contracts with hospitals to ensure that state and federal laws, standards, regulations, governing bodies, and accrediting agencies are met.
  5. Collaborate with hospitals to develop and implement policies, procedures and processes that maximize organ, eye and tissue donation and are compliant with federal, state, and accrediting agency requirements.
  6. Prepare and analyze performance data and partner with hospitals to develop and implement data-driven performance improvement plans.
  7. Develop internal OneLegacy relationships through training and interdisciplinary collaboration to address performance improvement.
  8. Collaborate with eye and tissue bank representatives in assigned hospitals, if applicable.
  9. Encourage hospital partner participation in organ, eye and tissue donor awareness events, community-based donation promotion activities and public education activities.
  10. Collaborate and partner with OneLegacy Public Education and Public Relations departments in developing OneLegacy brand awareness in the community surrounding assigned hospitals.
  11. Identify hospital/community events in which OneLegacy can participate to engage hospital staff and community members.
  12. Support OneLegacy signature events as required.

Systems:

  1. Establish onsite and remote access to electronic medical records (EMR) between OneLegacy and the hospital.
  2. Conduct hospital medical chart reviews to assess organ, eye and tissue donation opportunities and to identify missed or late referrals.
  3. Support or initiate a process for the hospital’s EMR system to interface with OneLegacy’s digitalDONOR system to improve the donation process.

Resources:

  1. Function as an internal and external resource for hospital donation programs and the donation process.
  2. Maintain a functional understanding of legal and clinical aspects of death by neurological criteria, donation after cardiac death, organ, eye and tissue recovery protocols, donor maintenance, transplantation, organ, eye and tissue allocation and preservation.
  3. Develop resources and donation champions within hospitals to establish a system that supports an efficient donation process.
  4. Update and maintain hospital profiles in digitalDONOR with pertinent information and resources utilized by OneLegacy operations teams to ensure successful outcomes.
  5. Document all hospital development and improvement activities in accordance with the Association of Organ Procurement Organization (AOPO) hospital development standards and CMS regulations.

Other Responsibilities:

  1. Attend staff meetings and other training programs as required.
  2. Support the organization’s Standards of Professional Conduct as outlined in the OneLegacy Policies and Procedures and the mission, vision, and values of the organization.
  3. Perform other duties as assigned.

Competencies and Skills Required:

  1. Self-starter with ability to work flexibly and in a fast-paced environment while meeting goals and expectations with limited supervision.
  2. Interpret and analyze data while utilizing critical thinking skills to develop innovative solutions and implement process improvement initiatives.
  3. Exceptional organizational and time management skills with attention to detail.
  4. Proficient public speaking and presentation skills to audiences of varying sizes and professional levels.
  5. Excellent professional written and verbal communication with ability to navigate conversations with diplomacy and tact.
  6. Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite, electronic databases and other technologies as tools to manage priorities and responsibilities.
  7. Readiness to learn and understand medical terminology.
  8. Willingness to primarily work in an active clinical/hospital environment including, but not limited to, critical care and operating room.
  9. Willingness to work in an environment where hospital staff and patient families engage in end-of-life conversations, palliative care, and terminal care.
  10. Frequent travel within the OneLegacy designated service area.

Education: Bachelor’s degree or 2 years of Organ Procurement Organization (OPO) experience.

Experience: Compliance and regulatory experienced preferred.

Certification & License: OneLegacy requires employees to maintain a current California driver’s license and current vehicle insurance.

The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, OneLegacy considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.

title: CRM Program Manager - Turkey (contract - remote)
description:
CRM Program Manager (contract - remote)

Team: Consumer Marketing

Reports to: Head of Consumer Marketing

Level: Manager (program-level ownership)

About Cambly

Cambly is a global language learning platform that connects learners with tutors for real conversation practice, supported by AI-powered learning tools. We help students around the world build confidence and fluency in English.

About the Role

We're looking for a CRM Program Manager to lead Cambly's customer relationship management strategy and execution — delivering the right message to the right customer at the right time, via the right channel. This is a global role covering Cambly's markets across Latin America, Europe/Middle East, and Asia. You will run one CRM strategy with market-specific channel and messaging execution. You'll own CRM across email, in-app, push, and messaging apps, including expansion into local chat platforms such as WhatsApp, WeChat, and KakaoTalk.

This role combines strategic program management, cross-functional leadership, and CRM platform expertise to drive acquisition, engagement, and retention based on deep analysis of user behavior. You'll own the CRM roadmap, platform strategy, audience strategy, deliverability health, major CRM initiatives (including AI integrations), and performance measurement across regions. You'll partner with creative, growth, product, data, engineering, and regional teams, and work closely with operational specialists who execute day-to-day campaign setup.

What You'll Do

CRM Strategy & Program Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end CRM strategy across email, in-app, push, and messaging apps, aligned to acquisition, engagement, and retention KPIs.

  • Build and maintain the CRM roadmap, balancing evergreen lifecycle programs, promotional campaigns, and strategic initiatives.

  • Own the messaging-app channel strategy by market: WhatsApp (e.g., Brazil, Turkey, Arabic-speaking markets), WeChat (China), KakaoTalk (Korea), and other local platforms as markets warrant. Lead each from evaluation and pilot through rollout.

  • Set the global CRM framework and define what can be localized by market (channel mix, timing, offers, tone) and what stays standard.

  • Serve as the single point of accountability for CRM outcomes and leadership reporting.

CRM Platform & Vendor Management

  • Evaluate and manage messaging providers and official business account setups per platform (e.g., WhatsApp Business API providers, WeChat Official Accounts, KakaoTalk business channels), including template approvals and platform policy compliance.

  • Own platform relationships (e.g., Iterable), including contracts, roadmap alignment, feature adoption, and renewals.

  • Drive strategic CRM innovation projects, such as AI/LLM integrations with the CRM stack, from discovery through rollout and measurement.

  • Identify gaps across the CRM stack and champion investments that reduce cost, improve efficiency, or unlock new capabilities.

Audiences & Lifecycle Journeys

  • Partner with PMs and engineers to co-design lifecycle programs, in-product messaging surfaces, event instrumentation, and journey delivery mechanics.

  • Define audience segmentation and lead qualification frameworks — who we reach, via which channel, and at which lifecycle stage.

  • Own audiences and lists across markets: segmentation, hygiene, suppression, and ongoing maintenance.

  • Develop customer journey and audience insights that improve profitability, delivery, and engagement.

  • Design and oversee automated journeys, personalization, and experimentation standards (subject lines, send times, cohorts, journey structures), including promotional updates.

Analytics, Measurement & Optimization

  • Own CRM KPIs, dashboards, and reporting across all channels.

  • Report CRM performance by market and channel, with cross-market comparisons in the WBR.

  • Own email deliverability health (bounces, spam complaints, warming, IP/domain reputation), partnering with engineering and ESPs.

  • Design and lead CRM experiments and turn learnings into durable program improvements.

  • Tie CRM performance to business outcomes (LTV, retention, activation, payback) with actionable recommendations.

Cross-Functional Program Management

  • Lead planning, execution, and retros for major campaigns (promotions, product launches, regional initiatives).

  • Partner with product and data teams to make every initiative measurable end-to-end — event tracking, data pipelines, attribution, and metric integrity.

  • Coordinate workstreams across marketing, product, engineering, data, and regional stakeholders.

  • Document CRM processes, playbooks, and standards so execution is repeatable.

  • Secure creative resourcing before committing to timelines; write clear creative briefs, and step in on messaging and copy when needed.

AI, Automation & Innovation

  • Automate reporting, monitoring, and manual workflows using AI, scripts, and no-code/low-code tools.

  • Use AI to deliver high-quality, culturally accurate localization and scale content without sacrificing brand voice.

  • Lead AI adoption within CRM — personalization, copy generation, segmentation, and journey optimization — and share learnings across marketing.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in CRM, lifecycle, or retention marketing, ideally at a consumer subscription, mobile, or edtech company.

  • Hands-on expertise with a modern CRM/ESP platform (e.g., Iterable, Braze, ), including journey building and segmentation.

  • Proven track record owning CRM strategy and roadmap with measurable impact on acquisition, engagement, and retention.

  • Strong analytical skills — comfortable with dashboards, experimentation, and SQL or similar tools.

  • Working knowledge of email deliverability best practices.

  • Experience running multi-market or international CRM programs; familiarity with messaging apps like WhatsApp, WeChat, or KakaoTalk is a plus.

  • Excellent cross-functional program management and stakeholder communication skills.

  • Strong writing skills and the ability to brief creative teams or draft copy directly.

  • Curiosity and hands-on experience using AI and automation to improve marketing workflows.

What Success Looks Like

  • CRM is a clearly defined, strategically led function with a published roadmap and measurable impact.

  • Audiences are well segmented and maintained; deliverability is strong and proactively managed.

  • CRM is meaningfully expanded onto local chat platforms, driving incremental engagement and revenue.

  • Journey and audience insights drive higher-profitability segments and better engagement — not just more sends.

  • CRM results are clearly and consistently represented in the Weekly Business Review.

  • Product, data, and engineering see CRM as a true technical partner — every initiative is instrumented from day one.

  • The CRM stack is used to its full potential, and major initiatives are delivered end-to-end.

  • Manual workflows are increasingly automated, and AI powers high-quality localization and content at scale.

title: Key Account Management Lead (QLD)
description:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About the role:

We are searching for an experienced and ambitious Key Account Management Lead to build and lead Halter's enterprise Key Account program in Queensland. We're looking for someone with proven management capability, deep account growth expertise, commercial edge, and the ability to inspire a team while driving real customer outcomes.

You will be building from the ground up; developing the strategy, team structure, and playbooks that scale Halter's presence with large enterprise cattle producers across Queensland. You'll lead a team of Key Account Managers, each managing a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts from pilot stage through to full-scale integration with Halter technology. You'll own the growth strategy, manage key relationships at all levels, and ensure our enterprise partners realize the full value of their investment.

You'll thrive in a high-stakes, fast-moving environment where autonomy, judgment, and drive matter. You might find yourself building the playbook one week, negotiating a multi-million-dollar expansion the next, coaching a KAM through a critical deal by Friday, and presenting strategy to the exec team the following week. You'll masterfully navigate complex organizational structures, adjust your communication with ranch managers, general managers, and boards alike, and know when to guide, when to challenge, and when to step in to unlock value.

This isn't a typical role. This is a foundational role in building Halter's enterprise presence in a new region. You'll be making a real-world impact, helping Queensland's largest cattle producers become more productive and sustainable. You'll build relationships with influential ranching leaders while working closely with Halter's leadership team and supporting a commercial team across the region. You'll help shape what great account management looks like as we scale into new markets.

Frequent travel across Queensland and Northern Territory is required as part of the position.

What your day could look like:

  • Team Leadership & Development: You'll build and lead the Queensland KAM team from the ground up—setting the vision, hiring the right people, and coaching them to excellence. You'll establish rituals, create scalable playbooks, and ensure every KAM is set up for success. You'll conduct account reviews, coach deal strategy, and hold your team accountable to ambitious growth targets.

  • Account Portfolio Strategy: You'll own the strategic direction of Halter's enterprise relationships in Queensland. You'll work closely with our commercial team to develop account tiering, expansion strategies, and identify growth opportunities within your portfolio. You'll know your key accounts inside-out and play a critical role in shaping how we grow in-market.

  • Customer Success at Scale: You'll be embedded in the success of Halter's largest and most strategic customers—ensuring they realize full value from their investment. You'll understand their goals deeply, help them embed Halter into daily operations, drive customer success initiatives, and surface impact across the business. Your efforts will directly influence retention, expansion, and long-term growth.

  • Executive & Stakeholder Engagement: You'll work directly with senior leaders, boards, and multi-entity decision-makers. You'll understand organizational structures, surface strategic pain points, and partner with internal teams to tailor solutions that move the needle. You'll be known and respected as a trusted Halter advisor at the highest levels.

  • Growth & Expansion Leadership: You'll collaborate with Business Development and Sales leadership to co-create account growth strategies, drive territory expansion, and identify new revenue streams. You'll play a key role in building the business case for new investments and managing the execution of expansion opportunities across your accounts.

  • Cross-functional Leadership: You'll work closely with Halter's product, support, and sales teams to champion your accounts internally. You'll surface product feedback, coordinate training, align on rollout strategies, and be the glue that holds enterprise relationships together and drives results.

  • Forecasting & Planning: You'll contribute to accurate revenue forecasting and strategic planning. You'll bring rigor to account performance tracking, identify early signals of both risk and growth, and present insights to leadership on pipeline health and business trajectory.

  • Scalable Growth Initiatives: You'll help build how we support and grow our largest customers at scale. From refining account management strategies to building playbooks that can be replicated as we expand into new regions, you'll be part of the team shaping what great looks like as Halter scales globally.

Who are we looking for:

  • Team leadership track record – You've managed and developed high-performing sales or account management teams. You know how to hire for culture and capability, coach people to greatness, and build a team culture that attracts talent.

  • Enterprise account experience – You've managed large, complex accounts and driven growth over time. You're comfortable navigating executive rooms, multiple stakeholders, and complex business structures. You know how to identify expansion opportunities and move them to close.

  • Industry fluency – You bring real experience in agricultural systems or rural enterprise operations and know what success looks like in a modern, large-scale farming business. You're credible, informed, and customer-first.

  • Strong commercial instincts – You don't just nurture relationships; you find value, expand accounts, and deliver results. You understand business economics and know how to quantify and communicate impact.

  • Strategic thinking – You can build a plan, see around corners, and adapt as circumstances change. You can balance strategic vision with tactical execution and know how to make the tough calls.

  • Autonomy & pace – You're happy working independently in a fast-changing environment. You solve problems proactively, adjust quickly, and thrive with ambiguity. You don't wait for permission.

  • Team-first mindset – You collaborate across roles and functions to get the best outcome for the customer and the company. You lift your team and the broader organization.

  • Growth hunger – You're looking to stretch yourself, take on more, and grow your career alongside a world-class commercial team. You're excited by the challenge of building something new.

  • Travel-ready – You'll be regularly out with customers, your team, and regional partners - being in the room, the paddock, or the boardroom when it counts.

Our Benefits:

  • Delicious snacks and drinks are available for your daily flow.

  • Healthy body, healthy mind. We're partnered with Southern Cross Health Insurance to support your well-being.

  • We offer 6 months of fully paid parental leave for primary caregivers, 4 weeks of fully paid secondary caregiver leave and many other parental benefits that support you and your family.

  • Our personal growth is important. Halter offers an annual $1000 self-development budget to be used for anything that fuels personal growth.

  • Our time to recharge is valued, we're offered wellness leave and unlimited paid annual leave.

  • Importantly, we offer an inclusive and attractive remuneration package made up of salary, benefits and an employee stock ownership plan.

Halter in Australia:

Halter entered Tasmania two years ago and has rapidly expanded to now have 20% of the state's dairy herd with Halter - a thriving customer base managed by a talented, local team. Halter recently entered Queensland and NSW, and now has a growing team and customer base across both states.

In Victoria and South Australia, Halter is preparing to launch operations following recent regulatory approval for virtual fencing. In Western Australia, Halter does not yet have customers. In these states there is a groundswell of demand for Halter across thousands of farmers. In Australia, virtual fencing is regulated by individual states' animal welfare legislation. Until recently, several states had legislation that did not permit farmers to use high-quality virtual fencing technology. With NSW parliament's announcement regulating virtual fencing, and Victoria and South Australia following suit, these barriers are now lifting.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

  • Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

  • Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

  • You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.

  • This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

title: Senior Credit Risk Analyst
description:
The Senior Credit Risk Analyst owns credit insight for a single business division. This is a strategic, business partnering role: you are not here to run reports, you are here to decide what should be measured, build the means to measure it automatically, and then use it to change how the division makes credit decisions. You will act as the credit voice inside your division. Challenging commercial assumptions with evidence, setting the analytical agenda without being directed, and turning a portfolio of manual reporting into a small number of automated, trusted, decision-grade products. Success in this role is measured by the decisions your work changes and the loss it prevents, not by the volume of reporting produced. We will be happy to welcome you to our office in Crewe, with working hours from Monday to Friday from 8.30 am to 5 pm.

Your daily responsibilities will be

  • Business partnering. Act as the embedded credit analytics partner for your division, working directly with operational, commercial and senior leadership teams to support portfolio performance, risk management and strategic decision-making.
  • Set the analytical agenda. Proactively identify, scope and prioritise analytical opportunities, emerging risks and performance improvement initiatives without relying solely on stakeholder requests. • Re-shape reporting. Review and rationalise existing reporting, ensuring management information is focused on supporting business decisions and delivers measurable value.
  • Automate. Design and implement automated SQL and Tableau reporting and analytics solutions that reduce manual production, improve efficiency and data reliability, and enable analyst time to be focused on insight generation, interpretation and business impact rather than data assembly.
  • Own the insight. Deliver root-cause analysis, trend identification and predictive insights across portfolio performance, default rates, recoveries, bad debt and customer behaviour, presenting recommendations directly to stakeholders.
  • Influence policy. Contribute to the design of credit policy, limit setting etc. bringing divisional evidence into framework decisions. • Influence policy and strategy Provide analytical evidence to support credit strategy, policy development, risk appetite decisions and continuous improvement initiatives across the division.

What do we expect from you?

  • Advanced SQL: able to design, optimise and document multi-stage queries and data models against a large warehouse independently, and to define the data structures others will build on.
  • Advanced Tableau: able to architect dashboards and data sources from scratch, not only maintain existing ones, with a clear view of what belongs on a dashboard and what does not.
  • Advanced Excel: able to build, stress-test and defend models used in decision-making.
  • Proven ability to automate manual reporting processes end to end and demonstrate the time and risk saved.
  • Strong commercial judgement: Able to interpret portfolio performance, identify key drivers and emerging risks, and translate complex data into clear recommendations that support operational and strategic decision making.
  • Credibility with senior audiences and business partnering capability: Proven ability to build trusted relationships with stakeholders, influence business decisions through evidence-based, data-driven insight, and confidently present and defend findings and recommendations to divisional leadership.
  • Self-directed and strategically focused: Able to identify opportunities for performance improvement, determine analytical priorities and deliver outcomes with minimal supervision.
  • Strong grounding in credit and risk principles: exposure, default, recovery, provisioning and portfolio monitoring, and the judgement to apply them to live customer decisions.

No specific formal qualifications are required; however, a degree in Data Analytics, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Finance or a related discipline would be advantageous.

Significant experience delivering credit, risk, portfolio analytics or commercial analytics within a complex business environment is essential. Candidates must be able to demonstrate a track record of influencing business decisions through data-driven insight, leading analytical projects, and delivering automation or process improvement initiatives. This role is expected to lead analytical work and represent the department to divisional leadership.

What to expect from us?

  • A friendly culture that reflects our proposition to customers.
  • A fast-growing organization that defines itself as agile and innovative.
  • A drive for continuous improvement, which will give you the opportunity to support from day one.
  • A commitment to building a work environment that values inclusivity, innovation, agility and grit.

And, of course, competitive pay, a potential bonus, and a good range of basic benefits.
