  • Experience developing full-stack applications using Angular, Java, and TypeScript.
  • Experience designing and consuming GraphQL, RESTful APIs.
  • Experience with AI standards, frameworks, models, and libraries (e.g., LangGraph, Model Context Protocol, OpenAI).
  • Exposure to AWS or cloud-based application development.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and build/deployment automation.
  • Working knowledge of Docker or containerization concepts.
  • Understanding of secure web development practices, including authentication and authorization.
  • Experience working within established design systems.
  • Knowledge of web standards, accessibility, and responsive design principles.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)

How We Work

Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for the majority of our crew members, designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience. Vanguard, one of the world's leading investment management companies, serves individual investors, institutions, employer-sponsored retirement plans, and financial professionals. We have a diverse and talented crew with a culture that promotes teamwork, along with an unwavering focus on serving our clients' best interests.

title: Junior Data Engineer - Ops & Infrastructure Support
description:
Datamine has championed data, analytics and AI for over 30 years. As organisations across Australia and New Zealand increasingly invest in AI and data-driven decisions, we’re seeking a junior data engineer to join our Data Engineering/Ops team. You'll help monitor, maintain, and build data environments for our clients across diverse industries, take on day-to-day client tickets and requests, and give our small Infrastructure team a second pair of hands. You'll also help make sure our internal tools support automation and efficiency, always looking for pragmatic ways to enhance and optimise. We use AI every day here and expect you will too.

At Datamine, we aim to give people power, through the ethical use of technology, to make decisions that transform their work, lives, and communities for the better. We collaborate closely with our clients to leverage insights and provide organisations with proven, repeatable success in this area. We thrive on making a difference.

This is a full-time role based in our Parnell office.

About the role

This is a blended role at the intersection of data engineering, operations, and infrastructure. You'll start close to the ground with daily checks, client tickets, and infrastructure support, and grow from there. As you build confidence, you'll take on more client-facing data engineering work, such as SQL, Python, and Datamart development. You'll also be a key point of continuity for our Infrastructure team, so Datamine has cover when it matters.

As you evolve in the role, and we better understand your strengths, Datamine will work with you to shape your future path. This role suits someone who enjoys working with a high degree of autonomy, takes ownership of outcomes, and enjoys continually improving the way they work to achieve better results.

At Datamine, we’re all individuals. You’ll find no boxes here. In fact, one of our values is "don’t just tick the box!"

What a day may look like

  • Running daily checks across Datamine's Datamarts and client environments, and flagging anything that looks off

  • Working through client tickets and requests, and keeping people updated on progress

  • Supporting our Infrastructure team with monitoring, patching, back-ups, and routine maintenance of servers, network, and cloud resources

  • Solving a diverse range of client and internal problems to keep technology running smoothly

  • Using Linux and Bash on a daily basis

  • Implementing, testing, and releasing code

  • Contributing your opinion and expertise to a solution

  • Communicating with the Client Services team on progress and any potential issues

  • Pitching in at team meetings and contributing to the team's goals

  • Working with your direct team and the wider Datamine team to keep learning, improving, and getting constructive feedback along the way

What you'll bring

  • A university degree in a technology or data-related field, such as computer science, engineering, or information systems, or equivalent experience in a systems administration or infrastructure support role with some coding under your belt

  • Programming experience, such as with SQL, Python, or R, through study or the workplace

  • Hands‑on use of AI tools in your study, work or own projects

  • A good grounding in databases (SQL, and ideally some RDBMS exposure) and an understanding of DBMS concepts

  • Exposure to Linux, a cloud platform (AWS or Azure), and infrastructure basics such as monitoring, back-ups, or networking is a bonus, not a requirement

  • Practical work experience of any kind – part‑time, holiday work, or personal projects. We're interested in what you've done and what you've learned from it

  • A team‑first mindset. You enjoy supporting others, thrive on collaboration, and love celebrating shared successes

  • A growth mentality. You're curious, eager to learn, and ready to build your skills while adding value along the way

What Datamine offers

  • Competitive salary aligned with experience

  • A chance to make your mark in a growing business

  • The opportunity to learn from and work alongside experts in their field

  • A values‑driven organisation where accountability matters more than hierarchy

  • A supportive environment where you’ll have genuine ownership and your contributions are valued

  • An opportunity to work with a diverse and talented team

  • An environment that will allow you to be you and to thrive

  • Flexibility around hours, and the option to work from home

  • A place that celebrates our wins and is on the path of continual learning

  • An Employee Assistance Program

  • Subsidised health insurance

Oh, and did we mention, lunch and coffee are on us. It’s always worth reading to the end of the ad!

title: NPDI Project Manager Products and Solutions - Engineering Specialist
description:
The NPDI Project Manager is responsible and accountable for the management of projects aimed at new products development, to the customization of existing products upon specific client requests (Engineered to Order) or for products transfer from region to region from inception to product launch, coordinating the efforts of all involved departments (engineering, product management, manufacturing engineering, operations, procurement, quality, order fulfillment, logistics, service, marketing, sales and other cross-functional groups) to the successful completion of the project. The NPDI Project Manager has no direct reports but will manage people indirectly. The NPDI Project Manager is responsible for projects scope, schedule and budget. Project manager is also driving the team to achieve the objectives of product costs and Time to Market.

The NPDI Project Manager will be part of the PMO Team which manages the development of Thermal Management products.

The projects to be followed spans different manufacturing plants, in different regions.

Project Manager must maintain continuous alignment of Project scope with Company strategic business and other organizational objectives, make recommendations to modify the Project to enhance effectiveness, highlight any possible situation hindering achievement of Project results and elaborate a recovery plan.

The context in which the NPDI Project Manager operates is characterized by complex relationships in an international and multicultural environment, typical of large organizations.

The NPDI Project Manager therefore must be able to navigate complexities, foster relationships, and maintain communication with stakeholders at multiple levels, including those external to the organization.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead end-to-end project management for new product development, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and objectives.
  • Ensure the projects are managed in accordance with the Corporate NPDI (New Product Development and Introduction) Process,
  • Develop and execute project plans, including timelines, milestones, and resource allocation, while effectively managing risks and dependencies.
  • Drive cross-functional collaboration and foster a culture of teamwork to achieve project deliverables and meet aggressive deadlines.
  • Work with management of different operating functions to identify and obtain required resources to adequately staff projects.
  • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration between various stakeholders, including engineering teams, operations, product offering and executive leadership.
  • Track and report on project progress, budget utilization, and key performance indicators (KPIs) to stakeholders and senior management.
  • Identify and proactively mitigate risks and issues that may impact project timelines, scope, or quality.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, driving innovation and efficiency in the product development process.
  • Collaborate closely with the Product Management team to define product requirements, specifications, and ensure alignment with customer needs and with the Engineering team to develop and validate solutions which are compliant with the requirements set, at a competitive product cost.
  • Initiate and complete post-launch product analysis and feedback collection to inform future iterations and enhancements.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business, or related field (Master degree preferred).
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience as a Program/Project Manager, leading programs or Projects in a structured organization
  • Understanding of the product development lifecycle, from concept ideation to commercialization.
  • Good Project management skills, PMP certification preferred.
  • Proficiency in project management tools and software (e.g. MS Project, Smartsheet)
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage and influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Excellent leadership and influencing skills, with the ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams towards a common goal.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Availability to travel up to 20% of the time, mostly within US/MX, occasionally in other regions.
  • Experience in the HVAC sector is preferred.

The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principals & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities.

About Vertiv

Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs. Vertiv solves the most important challenges facing today’s data centers, communication networks and commercial and industrial facilities with a portfolio of power, cooling and IT infrastructure solutions and services that extend from the cloud to the edge of the network. Headquartered in Westerville, Ohio, USA, Vertiv employs around 34,000 people and does business in more than 130 countries. Visit Vertiv.com to learn more.

title: Senior Engineer - Data and AI - Sydney/Melbourne
description:
Overview

Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries collaborate with clients to bring powerful customer experiences, innovative ways of working, and new products and services to life. We are trusted by leaders across the Global 1000, many successful enterprise and mid-market companies, and 500+ public sector organisations to improve operations, drive growth, and create value. At Slalom, we believe that together, we can move faster, dream bigger, and build better tomorrows for all.

The purpose of our Data practice at Slalom is to build a better future with Data. Through trusted partnerships with our clients, we co-create modern data solutions that drive results and improve the world. We are continuing to grow our practice whilst keeping Diversity, Equity, and Inclusiveness at the forefront, and hiring individuals who share a similar passion for data, technology, and culture. Joining our team will allow you to partner with our clients to learn from their data, create incredible digital experiences, and make the most of ML and analytics. We blend design, engineering, and expertise to help them build the future.

What You’ll Do

  • Work in teams with minimal oversight and direction to deliver innovative solutions on Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform using core cloud data warehouse tools, distributed processing engines, event streaming platforms, and other modern data related technologies.
  • Build the next generation of data platforms and work with some of the most forward-thinking organizations in data and analytics.
  • Work under the direction of a Solution Architect to help design and implement components of our clients’ data platform solution.
  • Participate in design sessions and be able to break down complex development tasks, and complete development items on time.

What will you bring?

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering
  • Proficiency in SQL and Python modern programming language
  • Strong experience with cloud-based data platforms (AWS preferred; Azure and GCP also valued)
  • Experience with tools such as Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Snowflake, Synapse, or similar
  • Solid understanding of data modeling, ETL best practices, and data warehousing
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps/DataOps practices
  • Comfortable working in Agile environments and using version control tools like Git
  • A curious, client-focused mindset with a passion for learning and experimenting with new technologies
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down complex problems and share insights with the team
  • Experience working with NoSQL Databases: DynamoDB, Cosmos DB, MongoDB
  • Experience with Modern Data Workflows: Apache Airflow, dbt, Dagster
  • AI/ML Tools: Amazon SageMaker, Azure ML Studio ( beneficial but not essential )

Our Values

Our culture and values reflect each individual Slalomer. We are dedicated to encouraging workplace diversity and ensuring all our people, from any background can contribute to their full potential. We wish to build a team that echoes the diversity of the communities we serve, and our values are an active part of our every-day, guiding our decisions.

What keeps us here?

When we moved to Australia in 2020, we had no idea just how important our work/life balance would need to be. We’ve asked our consultants what makes Slalom a great place to work and the most common answer – “the freedom to be ourselves when life gets in the way”. We make a big effort to bring everyone together and allow space when space is needed. We believe in helping each other thrive in work and life and are proud to invest in benefits that include holistic wellbeing, meaningful allowances, and investment in our team’s professional, technical, and personal growth.

Slalom is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes all qualified applicants. Slalom does not discriminate on grounds of race, religion, or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

title: Lead Data Engineer - AWS / AI / SQL
description:
Lead Data Engineer

Manchester Hybrid Circa £85K

An established organisation is looking for a hands-on Lead Data Engineer to take ownership of its existing data estate and lead the development of a modern, scalable data platform.

This is an excellent opportunity to build a platform supporting Business Intelligence, Data Science and Applied AI. You'll introduce modern batch and real-time data-processing capabilities, automate inefficient processes and make trusted data more accessible across the organisation.

Alongside remaining technically hands-on, you'll manage and develop a small team of Data Engineers.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the reliability, security and ongoing development of the data platform.
  • Modernise the existing SQL Server, SSIS/SSDT and Power BI environment.
  • Develop scalable batch and real-time data-processing solutions.
  • Lead the design of a Customer Data Platform.
  • Build and evolve a lakehouse architecture using AWS technologies.
  • Create governed semantic models, consistent metrics and clear data definitions.
  • Enable secure, self-service data analysis using modern AI tooling.
  • Automate manual, repetitive or fragile data processes.
  • Support BI, Data Science, Machine Learning and Applied AI teams.
  • Take ownership of data governance, security, monitoring and platform costs.
  • Line-manage, develop and help grow the Data Engineering team.
  • Work closely with technical, operational and senior business stakeholders.

Skills and experience

We're looking for an experienced Data Engineer who has built and operated complete data platforms rather than solely delivering individual components.

You'll need experience across:

  • Batch data processing, ELT and orchestration.
  • Modern streaming technologies such as Flink or comparable platforms.
  • AWS data services, including S3, Lambda, Glue, Athena, Kinesis and RDS.
  • Infrastructure as code using Terraform.
  • CI/CD and automated testing.
  • Lakehouse architecture and open table formats such as Iceberg.
  • Medallion architecture and dimensional data modelling.
  • Strong SQL and Python.
  • SQL Server, SSIS/SSDT and Power BI.
  • Semantic layers, common metrics and data glossaries.
  • Data governance, lineage, retention, classification and auditability.
  • Managing and developing a small technical team.

You should also be comfortable using advanced AI coding assistants, such as Claude Code or equivalent tools, to improve engineering productivity while maintaining high standards of quality, governance and security.

Desirable experience

  • Regulated environment.
  • PySpark for large-scale data transformations.
  • Migrating legacy data estates to lakehouse or metadata-driven architectures.
  • Customer Data Platforms or event-driven systems.
  • Data-quality tools such as dbt tests or Great Expectations.
  • MCP servers or governed natural-language data interfaces.
  • Financial crime, fraud or regulatory-reporting data.
  • Power BI administration and semantic modelling.

The opportunity

This is a genuinely influential role where you'll own the data platform end to end and help shape how data and AI are used across the organisation.

You'll have the scope to introduce modern technologies, remove unnecessary manual work and build a platform capable of supporting future products, analytics and business decision-making.

title: Senior Data Engineer / Data Architect - Databricks & AWS
description:
TECHNICAL LEAD / PRINCIPAL ENGINEER / HANDS-ON ARCHITECT - DATA ENGINEERING (PLATFORM & INFRASTRUCTURE)

Sydney, NSW (on-site) | Full Australian working rights required - we\'re unable to progress candidates without them.

You’ve built a Databricks and AWS data platform from nothing before: medallion architecture, Delta Lake, real pipelines and real tradeoffs, not a diagram someone else handed you. If that’s familiar, keep reading. Sydney-based, Technical Lead through to Hands-on Architect, genuinely hands-on at every level.

SEEK SELLING POINTS

  • You've built a platform from nothing before. This role needs that again.
  • Haven't led a team yet? If you\'re ready to, this is where you start.
  • Join a 500+ strong data and AI practice, backed by tier-one vendor alliances.

ABOUT THE CLIENT

A top-tier global professional services firm delivering large-scale data and AI transformation programs for major enterprise and government clients across Australia. This is deep, complex platform and infrastructure build work, not light analytics or reporting. You get total ownership of the platforms you build, structured investment in advanced technical training, and direct access to the vendors behind the stack, not just a licence and a support ticket.

ABOUT THE TEAM

You’d be joining a data and AI practice of 500+ specialist practitioners nationally, sitting inside tier-one vendor alliances spanning AWS, Databricks, Google Cloud, dbt Labs, Snowflake, Salesforce and Informatica. The programs here run at genuine scale: think large transport-network digital twin builds, national-scale public health rollout automation, and sustainability data initiatives delivered across Australia and the wider region. Career development is coaching-led, with benefits including dedicated wellbeing leave, paid volunteering and market-leading parental leave.

ABOUT THE ROLE

If you’ve built a data platform from the ground up before, you already know the difference between that and being handed one to extend. This is the first kind. You’ll be designing and building end-to-end Databricks Lakehouse platforms including medallion architecture, batch and streaming pipelines, and Delta Lake at the core, backed by AWS (Glue or Redshift), not a single layer someone else designed around you.

How much of that you own depends on where you sit, and leadership experience isn\'t a prerequisite at every level. As a Technical Lead, you might already be leading a team, or you might be ready to step into that for the first time with real support behind you. As a Principal Engineer or Hands-on Architect, you’re setting technical direction and coaching engineers through the complexity yourself. Either way, you own the platform, not a slice of it.

DUTIES

  • Architect end-to-end Databricks Lakehouse platforms, including medallion architecture, on AWS (Glue or Redshift).
  • Design and build batch, streaming and real-time pipelines feeding AI and advanced analytics workloads.
  • Own distributed systems performance: Spark tuning, query optimisation, and cost and cluster right-sizing at scale.
  • Improve CI/CD, infrastructure as code (Terraform) and automated deployment practice across the platform.
  • Technical Lead level: own delivery of your components directly, whether you\'re already leading others or ready to step into that for the first time.
  • Principal Engineer / Hands-on Architect level: set technical direction across the build and coach engineers through the complexity, not just review their output.
  • Get direct access to advanced vendor training and close working relationships with the platform partners behind the stack.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Proven experience building data platforms end to end, infrastructure through to data lake, not one layer in isolation.
  • Deep hands-on Databricks and Delta Lake, including medallion architecture and PySpark or Scala, with AWS (Glue or Redshift at minimum).
  • Advanced SQL and performance tuning across distributed systems, with real Spark and cloud troubleshooting experience.
  • Databricks certifications (Certified Data Engineer / Certified Professional) and AWS certifications highly regarded, not mandatory.
  • Technical Lead level: strong individual delivery on complex builds. Prior leadership experience is valued but not required, clear potential to lead is enough.
  • Principal Engineer / Hands-on Architect level: demonstrated ownership of technical direction and coaching engineers through delivery, not just managing tickets.
  • Comfortable in genuine ambiguity on large, complex programs, not tightly scoped analytics or reporting projects.
  • Full Australian working rights required. We are unable to progress applications without them.

KEY SKILLS

Databricks, Delta Lake, Apache Spark, PySpark, Scala, Medallion Architecture, AWS, Glue, Redshift, Terraform, CI/CD, Data Engineering, Data Architecture, Data Platform, Data Lake, Sydney.

A note from the consultant running this search: I\'ve placed engineers into this practice who came in as builders and ended up leading their own workstreams within a year. The ones who thrive aren\'t chasing a title, they\'re chasing the platform work that\'s actually hard. If your CV reads like tidy dashboards and light reporting, this isn\'t your role. If it reads like you\'ve fought with Spark cluster configs at 11pm and won, let\'s talk.

title: Toezichthouder Zorginstelling - Regio Dordrecht
description:
In deze rol ben jij degene op wie iedereen kan bouwen. Jij ziet een situatie aankomen vóórdat die escaleert, en grijpt in met rust en overzicht. Bewoners voelen zich veilig, collega's kunnen zich volledig op hun vak richten.

Als toezichthouder ben jij het kloppend hart van de veiligheid binnen een zorglocatie. Niet op de achtergrond, maar middenin. Je bent zichtbaar en aanwezig, altijd alert.

Wat jij doet:

  • Je ontzorgt het zorgteam – jij neemt de veiligheidstaak over én springt bij waar nodig.

  • Je bent altijd een stap voor – met actieve, alerte rondes signaleer jij risico's al vóórdat ze een probleem worden

  • Je blijft het rustpunt – met een kalme, doortastende aanpak zorg jij dat een situatie niet verder escaleert dan nodig

  • Je sluit sterk af – iedere dienst eindig je met een scherpe, heldere overdracht, zodat het team exact weet waar ze aan toe zijn

Wie zoeken wij?

  • Zelfstandig ondernemer (ZZP) of bereid om als ZZP aan de slag te gaan

  • Ervaring in zorg of beveiliging is een vereiste.

  • Betrouwbaar, kalm onder druk en communicatief sterk

  • Flexibel inzetbaar op wisselende tijden

  • Bereid om in regio: Rotterdam-Sliedrecht-Breda-Dordrecht te werken.

Wat krijg je ervoor terug?

  • Zekerheid over je locatie – je werkt flexibel op verschillende zorglocaties

  • Salaris: € 16,08 – € 19,98 excl. ORT

  • ORT: 110% (23:00–00:00), 120% (00:00–07:00), 135% (zaterdag 00:00 – zondag 23:59)

  • Flexibiliteit in je planning

  • Direct starten – geen lange procedures, je bent snel inzetbaar

  • Uitbetaling zonder gedoe – vier wekelijks, gewoon op tijd

Waarom Werken voor SureCare?

SureCare is geen groot anoniem bedrijf waar je een nummer bent. We zijn een groeiende organisatie met een duidelijke missie: de zorg veiliger maken. En daar geloven we écht in.

  • Je wordt gezien — jouw inzet en betrokkenheid worden opgemerkt en gewaardeerd

  • Je maakt impact — elke dienst draag jij bij aan de veiligheid van kwetsbare mensen

  • Je staat er niet alleen voor — we begeleiden je goed en denken met je mee

  • Je hebt vrijheid — als ZZP'er bepaal jij wanneer je werkt, wij zorgen voor de opdrachten

Bij SureCare kom je terecht in een team van mensen met een groot hart voor de zorg. Mensen die weten waarom ze doen wat ze doen. Herken jij je daarin? Dan horen we graag van je.

The essential duties and responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to, the following:

Leadership:

  • Maintain a neat, well-groomed personal appearance at all times and observe company dress regulations; enforce grooming standards throughout the department; must wear an approved hat or hair net and clean uniform while in the department and make sure all personnel in the bakery department does the same.

  • Must assure that company values are practiced and taught.
  • Must demonstrate managerial courage.
  • Be able to hear, speak and understand the spoken word in order to respond promptly to pages for assistance, to accommodate verbal requests from customers for information or assistance, to answer telephones, and to be able to communicate effectively with supervisors, coworkers and customers.

Operational:

  • Comply with all state, county and local weights and measures laws and labeling requirements.

  • Follow approved bakery department plans for effective space management based on product movement, consumer demand and profitability.
  • Keep displays fully stocked and attractively merchandised at all times according to tag allocation, product movement or department standards; sign and display merchandise in a neat manner.
  • Keep perishable merchandise rotated in accordance with store policy and product code dates and pull all out-of-code merchandise.
  • Observe local competitive activity pertaining to the bakery department and keep others informed.

  • Use and maintain equipment in good working order.
  • Immediately advise department manager of any maintenance or equipment problems.
  • Take action to control shrinkage and pilferage losses; observe security standards by staying alert and aware of customer actions and behavior; report to store manager or security any abnormal behavior.
  • Ability to hear, speak and understand the spoken word in order to respond promptly to pages for assistance, to accommodate verbal requests from customers for information or assistance, to answer telephones, and to be able to communicate effectively with coworkers and customers.

  • The employee must be able to climb a ladder to retrieve inaccessible items stored on overhead racks, elevated shelves and other storage areas. The employee must be able to sweep and mop floors, dust and face shelves, and lift and carry out trash containers to be emptied in an outside bin.

For more than 25 years, Altis has focused on one thing: helping organisations create better outcomes through data.

We're Australian-owned and technology-agnostic, which means our consultants can focus on solving the right problem rather than selling a particular platform.

At Altis you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Learn from experienced specialists across consulting, engineering, analytics and AI

Our values — Be Curious, Own It, Lead with Heart and Discover a Way — shape how we work with our clients and with each other.

Your next move doesn't need to tick every box

Different experiences and perspectives make our teams stronger.

BTPN Syariah sampai saat ini menjadi satu-satunya bank di Indonesia yang memfokuskan diri melayani keluarga prasejahtera produktif, yang biasa disebut 'unbankable'. Melayani segmen tersebut sejak 2010 adalah tantangan sekaligus peluang. Karenanya, BTPN Syariah senantiasa membangun produk dan layanan yang paling tepat sesuai kebutuhan mereka.

Dengan hanya memiliki 25 cabang di seluruh Indonesia, 41 Kantor Fungsional Operasional, namun bank memiliki hampir 12.000 karyawan yang melayani langsung ke sentra sentra nasabah di hampir 70% total kecamatan di Indonesia. Pola jemput bola ini bertujuan untuk mengajarkan 4 perilaku unggul nasabah yaitu Berani Berusaha, Disiplin, Kerja Keras, dan Saling Bantu (BDKS), yang dilakukan oleh karyawan yang sebagian besar adalah lulusan SMA yang telah dilatih dengan tepat, sebagai Community Officer Bank.

Sebagai Bank yang juga menghimpun dana, saat ini, terdapat sekitar 20.000 nasabah sejahtera yang menempatkan dana mereka di BTPN Syariah. Nasabah pendanaan dilayani oleh personal banker profesional, dimana, hampir 100% dana yang ditempatkan disalurkan kepada keluarga prasejahtera produktif yang mencapai 3,70 juta nasabah aktif (total penerima pembiayaan sejak 2010 telah mencapai lebih dari 5,2 juta).

Perubahan dampak sosial nasabah juga diukur setiap tahunnya, diantaranya probabilitas kembali ke garis prasejahtera, penurunan persentase anak bersekolah, peningkatan kemampuan mencicil pembiayaan dan menabung. Ini menunjukan program pembiayaan BTPN Syariah memberikan dampak untuk peningkatan pendapatan keluarga prasejahtera. Metode dan alat survei yang dipilih merupakan alat yang berlaku internasional dan memiliki kredibilitas yang baik, serta mudah dalam pengimplementasiannya yaitu PPI (Poverty Probability Index) dari IPA (Inovative for Poverty Action).

Keyakinan untuk 'Do Good Do Well' (berkinerja baik sekaligus memiliki dampak sosial yang nyata) inilah, yang membuat seluruh insan di BTPN Syariah memiliki satu identitas yang sama, yaitu #bankirpemberdaya.

BTPN Syariah sampai saat ini menjadi satu-satunya bank di Indonesia yang memfokuskan diri melayani keluarga prasejahtera produktif, yang biasa disebut 'unbankable'. Melayani segmen tersebut sejak 2010 adalah tantangan sekaligus peluang. Karenanya, BTPN Syariah senantiasa membangun produk dan layanan yang paling tepat sesuai kebutuhan mereka.

Dengan hanya memiliki 25 cabang di seluruh Indonesia, 41 Kantor Fungsional Operasional, namun bank memiliki hampir 12.000 karyawan yang melayani langsung ke sentra sentra nasabah di hampir 70% total kecamatan di Indonesia. Pola jemput bola ini bertujuan untuk mengajarkan 4 perilaku unggul nasabah yaitu Berani Berusaha, Disiplin, Kerja Keras, dan Saling Bantu (BDKS), yang dilakukan oleh karyawan yang sebagian besar adalah lulusan SMA yang telah dilatih dengan tepat, sebagai Community Officer Bank.

Sebagai Bank yang juga menghimpun dana, saat ini, terdapat sekitar 20.000 nasabah sejahtera yang menempatkan dana mereka di BTPN Syariah. Nasabah pendanaan dilayani oleh personal banker profesional, dimana, hampir 100% dana yang ditempatkan disalurkan kepada keluarga prasejahtera produktif yang mencapai 3,70 juta nasabah aktif (total penerima pembiayaan sejak 2010 telah mencapai lebih dari 5,2 juta).

Perubahan dampak sosial nasabah juga diukur setiap tahunnya, diantaranya probabilitas kembali ke garis prasejahtera, penurunan persentase anak bersekolah, peningkatan kemampuan mencicil pembiayaan dan menabung. Ini menunjukan program pembiayaan BTPN Syariah memberikan dampak untuk peningkatan pendapatan keluarga prasejahtera. Metode dan alat survei yang dipilih merupakan alat yang berlaku internasional dan memiliki kredibilitas yang baik, serta mudah dalam pengimplementasiannya yaitu PPI (Poverty Probability Index) dari IPA (Inovative for Poverty Action).

title: Remote Senior Frontend Developer
description:
About Us:

DOHE is a global EdTech championing group headquartered in Singapore, with a branch in the United Kingdom.We are on a mission to transform education by leveraging technology responsibly to enhance educational quality and foster meaningful societal progress.

We are building EdTech Hub, a global ecosystem designed to empower startups, foster collaboration, and strengthen innovation across the education sector worldwide.Through our Go-Together Accelerator Programme, we support EdTech founders in turning their vision into reality through tailored coaching and strategic support. Guided by our proprietary Navigator methodology, we create structured and efficient pathways to success for education innovators.

Over the next decade, our ambition is to accelerate more than 5,000 EdTech startups globally

Everything we do is dedicated to championing EdTech startups to improve society and fulfil our mission.

Find out more

EdTech Hub IT Team

The EdTech Hub IT Team powers the digital foundation of our ecosystem.

We design, build, and maintain secure, scalable, and reliable technology infrastructure that enables startups, partners, and stakeholders to collaborate seamlessly.

From platform development and data management to cybersecurity and system optimisation, our team ensures that innovation is supported by strong and future-ready technology.

By combining technical expertise with a deep understanding of the EdTech landscape, we help create an environment where startups can focus on growth — while we take care of the technology that drives it.

We are building a high-impact core team of 9 professionals across engineering, product, and design. Detailed Job Descriptions are available for each role.

About The Role

Establish the design system on a modern framework and build the entire frontend for five portals plus EdTech Hub. Implement role-based access control and create interactive UIs that surface AI-generated reports and matching results.

In This Role, You'll

· Build all 5 portals and EdTech Hub frontend from scratch

· Establish a shared component library and Design System

· Implement role-based access control and authentication integration

· Develop complex workflow UIs — multi-step approval, coaching sessions, diagnosis questionnaires

· Build AI integration screens — report viewer, expert matching, recording uploads

· Create monitoring dashboards, cohort tracking, and analytics views

About Us

DOHE는 싱가포르에 본사를 두고 영국에 지사를 운영하는 글로벌 EdTech Championing Group으로, 에듀테크 스타트업이 사회적 가치를 만들고 글로벌로 성장할 수 있도록 에코시스템 (EdTech Hub) 구축 , 글로벌 액셀러레이션 프로그램 (Go-Together) , 데이터 기반 Methodology(Naviagator)를 제공하는 에드테크 전문 그룹입니다.

현재 EdTech Hub, Go-Together 등 내부 핵심 업무 시스템을 고도화하며 글로벌 팀과 함께 일할 시스템 엔지니어를 찾고 있습니다.

EdTech Hub IT Team

EdTech Hub는 전 세계 에듀테크 스타트업 커뮤니티를 지원하고, 교육 혁신 생태계 전반의 협력을 강화하기 위해 설계된 글로벌 플랫폼입니다. DOHE Global은 현재 전 세계 스타트업의 성장을 지원하는 통합 EdTech Hub 플랫폼을 처음부터 새롭게 구축하고 있습니다.

우리는 이 혁신적인 여정을 함께할 9개의 핵심 포지션에 합류할 전문 인재를 찾고 있습니다.


역할 소개

모던 프레임워크를 기반으로 디자인 시스템을 수립하고, 5개 포털과 EdTech Hub 전체 프론트엔드를 구축합니다. 역할별 접근 제어를 구현하고, AI 백엔드가 생성한 리포트와 매칭 결과를 사용자에게 전달하는 인터랙티브 UI를 만듭니다.

이 역할에서 하게 될 일

· 5개 포털 및 EdTech Hub 프론트엔드를 신규 개발합니다

· 공통 컴포넌트 라이브러리와 Design System을 구축합니다

· 역할별 접근 제어와 인증 연동을 구현합니다

· 다단계 승인, 코칭 세션, 진단 설문 등 복잡한 워크플로우 UI를 개발합니다

· AI 리포트 뷰어, Expert 매칭 결과, 녹취 업로드 등 AI 연동 화면을 구현합니다

· 모니터링 대시보드, 코호트 추적, Analytics 화면을 개발합니다

·

· Senior frontend engineer

· Significant relevant experience of building large-scale services with React / Next.js

· Hands-on TypeScript experiences

· State management and REST API / GraphQL integration experience

· Responsive web and cross-browser experience

· Business-level English fluency required — daily collaboration with a global team

You Might Thrive In This Role If You

· Design systems purist. You obsess over component consistency and reusability, and build systems hand-in-hand with designers.

· Complexity simplifier. You have a talent for turning multi-step processes into UIs users navigate without friction.

· Ecosystem explorer. You actively explore the evolving frontend landscape and experiment with new approaches.

· Multi-persona empath. You understand the context of five distinct user groups and design the right experience for each.

Tech Stack

Language TypeScript

Framework Next.js 14+ (App Router)

UI React · shadcn/ui · Tailwind CSS · Radix UI

State Zustand · TanStack Query

Testing Vitest · Playwright

Deploy Vercel · Netlify

Tooling Figma · GitHub · Cursor

시니어 프론트엔드 엔지니어

· React / Next.js 기반 대규모 서비스 개발 4년 이상

· TypeScript 실무 경험

· 상태 관리와 REST API / GraphQL 연동 경험

· 반응형 웹과 크로스 브라우저 대응 경험

· 비즈니스 수준의 영어 커뮤니케이션 능력 필수 — 글로벌 팀과의 일상적 협업

이런 분이라면 이 역할에서 빛날 겁니다

· 디자인 시스템에 진심인 분. 컴포넌트의 일관성과 재사용성에 집착하고, 디자이너와 긴밀하게 시스템을 함께 만들어가는 분입니다.

· 복잡함을 단순하게 만드는 분. 다단계 프로세스를 사용자가 헤매지 않는 UI로 풀어내는 데 재능이 있는 분입니다.

· 최신 생태계에 열려 있는 분. 프론트엔드 생태계의 변화를 적극 탐구하고, 새로운 접근법을 실험하는 분입니다.

· 다섯 가지 사용자를 공감하는 분. 서로 다른 사용자 그룹 각각의 컨텍스트를 이해하고, 최적의 경험을 설계하는 분입니다.

기술 스택

UI React · shadcn/ui · Tailwind CSS · Radix UI

We're looking for someone who enjoys both development and design. You'll work with code, build responsive websites, develop custom functionality and integrations, and create polished digital experiences that support business growth.

WordPress is our primary platform today, but we’re technology agnostic. We’re interested in developers who can bring new ideas, technologies and better ways of building for the future.

This is not a marketing coordinator role. This is a genuine development role where you’ll be actively building and improving websites every day.

You’ll be the primary website delivery resource across the Herga Group, working across new website builds, enhancements, landing pages, integrations and ongoing improvements for multiple brands and industries.

You’ll collaborate with Marketing, IT, Digital and business stakeholders, while being supported by experienced specialists across web development, digital engineering, SEO and digital growth.

Alongside our WordPress environment, you’ll have opportunities to contribute to eCommerce, integrations, automation, AI and the future evolution of our digital platforms.

Essential

title: Software NEW Senior Full Stack Platform Engineer (Cloud & AI Integration)Melbourne (HQ) / Sydney / Remote Australia View Role
description:
The Role

We are seeking a versatile Full Stack Engineer with strong architectural instincts. You will be instrumental in scaling our user-facing applications, robust backend services, and the high-throughput data pipelines that power our analytics. You will tackle the challenges of moving, storing, and processing heavy, multi-modal data efficiently, bridging the gap between our cloud infrastructure and our specialized AI microservices.

What You Will Do

  • Platform Development: Architect and build scalable, production-ready full-stack applications to serve industrial enterprise clients.
  • Data Pipeline Architecture: Design and optimize asynchronous, high-throughput systems to process heavy data payloads efficiently in the cloud.
  • AI/ML Integration: Build the infrastructure that connects our core web platforms with specialized backend AI processing services (including Computer Vision, LLMs, and classical analytics).
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Leverage cloud services to manage complex storage needs, message brokering, and scalable worker architectures.
  • Performance Optimization: Ensure the platform remains highly responsive and cost-effective while handling intensive analytical workloads and large-scale data visualization.

What We Are Looking For

  • Full Stack Expertise: Deep experience building scalable web applications within modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems (e.g., Node.js, Express, Next.js, React, or similar frameworks).
  • Cloud & Systems Architecture: Proven track record designing asynchronous, event-driven, or queue-based worker systems using major cloud providers (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
  • Database Mastery: Strong schema design and optimization skills using relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.) for complex analytical and spatial workloads.
  • Industrial/Heavy Data Experience: Experience building platforms that handle complex, heavy data structures (such as spatial data, 3D point clouds, sensor outputs, or large-scale imagery).
  • AI Integration Familiarity: Practical experience wrapping, deploying, or integrating Python-based machine learning models, computer vision APIs, or LLMs into production web environments.
  • Problem Solver: You thrive in a startup environment, enjoy taking end-to-end ownership of complex features, and can balance rapid iteration with scalable system design.

Where You’ll Work

Our head office is in Melbourne and we have a second office in Sydney. We are open to flexible and remote working arrangements anywhere in Australia for the right person, so where you are based should not stop you from applying.

You are welcome to work from either office if you would prefer to, and we will get you out to site from time to time so you can see the systems your work supports running in the field.

title: Principal DevOps Engineer for Industrial AI Cloud (m/f/d)

Principal DevOps Engineer for Industrial AI Cloud (m/f/d)

  • Full-time

T‑Systems is part of the Deutsche Telekom Group, with around 30.000 employees worldwide. We create technology with purpose to generate a positive impact on society. We are looking for curious talent, eager to learn, take on challenges, and contribute ideas that transform our customers’ experience.

We trust people: we offer autonomy, continuous support, and a collaborative environment where you can grow without limits. We are one global team, guided by respect, integrity, and a passion for doing better every day.

NVIDIA and Deutsche Telekom are jointly developing industrial AI cloud for Europe. This AI factory in Germany will host 10,000 GPUs across NVIDIA DGX B200 systems and RTX Pro Servers. Deutsche Telekom provides secure, sovereign and fast infrastructure, including data centers, operations, security, and AI solutions.
As DevOps Engineer Principal you will guide enterprise customers through onboarding, training, and early adoption of the AI platform. Your responsibility includes understanding customer requirements, supporting solution design, executing Proofs of Concept (PoCs), and ensuring smooth integration of customer workloads (LLMs, GPU compute, AI pipelines). You act as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers efficiently use their GPU clusters and AI toolchains.
We are looking for a DevOps Engineer Principal position who will play a key role in helping our enterprise customers successfully adopt and scale our AI platform. In this position you will guide clients through onboarding, training, and early-stage implementation of cutting-edge AI solutions. You’ll work closely with them to understand their technical and business needs, support the design of tailored architectures, and lead Proofs of Concept that validate real-world value. You will ensure smooth integration of complex workloads — from LLM deployment and GPU compute optimization to building end-to-end AI/ML pipelines. As a trusted technical advisor, you will empower customers to use their GPU clusters and AI toolchains efficiently, troubleshoot challenges, and adopt best practices that accelerate their AI journey.

What will you do?

  • Consult customers on all technical aspects related to GPU infrastructure and platform usage.
  • Lead onboarding and training, mentoring customer specialists on optimal usage of their GPU clusters and AI environments.
  • Design and implement PoCs, including environment setup, data processing pipelines, and deployment workflows.
  • Conduct requirement engineering, translating business needs into technical specifications.
  • Assist customers with performance optimization, troubleshooting, fine-tuning, and validation of delivered solutions.

title: Data Engineering Lead
description:
The Role

We`re looking for an experienced Data Engineering Lead to join our Data & Insight team and help shape the future of our data capabilities.

You`ll lead and develop a talented team of Data Engineers, providing technical direction and coaching while remaining hands-on with complex engineering challenges. You`ll play a key role in strategic transformation initiatives, including the continued evolution of our Databricks data platform.

This is an exciting opportunity to:

  • Lead and inspire a talented Data Engineering team.
  • Shape our data strategy and influence key technology decisions.
  • Modernise our data platform, including our Databricks environment.
  • Stay hands-on and solve complex technical challenges.
  • Make a real impact by delivering trusted, scalable data solutions that support business growth.

If you`re passionate about data, technology and people leadership, this is your opportunity to help shape our data future and make a lasting impact.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Provide technical leadership for scalable, reliable and secure data platforms and products.
  • Lead, mentor and develop a team of Data Engineers, promoting collaboration and technical excellence.
  • Ensure the stability, performance and continuous improvement of critical data platforms and pipelines.
  • Lead the migration from our existing data warehouse to Databricks.

  • Support Agile delivery, from prioritisation and sprint planning through to delivery.

What We're Looking for in You

Essential

  • Proven experience leading Data Engineering teams in complex enterprise environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience building and operating modern, cloud-based data platforms.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills, with extensive experience in Databricks, Spark and lakehouse architectures.
  • Strong understanding of data engineering, modelling and architecture best practices.
  • Experience delivering data solutions for reporting, analytics and data science.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on technical delivery.
  • Experience working in Agile environments.

Desirable

  • Experience delivering large-scale technology or business transformation programmes.
  • Experience with data migration, system modernisation or enterprise platform change.
  • Experience integrating data following acquisitions, mergers or major business change.
  • Familiarity with Tableau and low-code integration platforms such as SnapLogic.

What You'll Get in Return

  • A discretionary annual bonus so you can share in the company's success
  • 25 days' paid holiday and an annual holiday buying scheme, with 5 additional days awarded for long service
  • A generous pension scheme – employer contributions between 5% and 11% depending on how much you save

  • Lots of other great benefits including an annual ShareSave scheme, Employee Life Assurance, a discounts portal and more!

title: Data Platform Engineer- BPL-CIO
description:
Job Description Purpose of the role To drive technical excellence and innovation by leading the design and implementation of robust software solutions, providing mentorship to engineering teams, fostering cross-functional collaboration, and contributing to strategic planning to ensure the delivery of high-quality solutions aligned with business objectives.

Accountabilities Provision of guidance and expertise to engineering teams to ensure alignment with best practices and foster a culture of technical excellence. Contribution to strategic planning by aligning technical decisions with business goals, anticipating future technology trends, and providing insights to optimize product roadmaps. Design and implementation of complex, scalable, and maintainable software solutions, considering long-term viability and business objectives. Mentoring and coaching to junior and mid-level engineers to foster professional growth and knowledge sharing, elevating the overall skillset and capabilities of the organization. Collaboration with business partners, product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions and ensure a cohesive approach to product development. Innovation within the organization by identifying and incorporating new technologies, methodologies, and industry practices into the engineering process.

Vice President Expectations To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and elevate breaches of policies/procedures. If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements. If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others. OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi‑year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions. Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment. Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda. Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does. Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business. Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies. Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In‑depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions. Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes. Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes. All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Data Platform Engineer

Join us as a Data Platform Engineer and help make data platforms easier to build, operate and consume. As one of the first permanent engineers in a new platform team, you will create the AWS foundations that power BPL's enterprise data platform. You'll build reusable cloud services, automated delivery pipelines, security controls and operational tooling that allow engineering teams to move faster without compromising reliability, governance or resilience. Working alongside platform, data and security engineers, you'll turn common infrastructure requirements into reusable platform capabilities, reducing complexity for delivery teams and enabling a consistent, secure engineering experience across the organisation. If you're passionate about platform engineering, infrastructure as code, automation and creating paved roads that other teams love to use, this is an opportunity to shape both the platform and the engineering culture from the start.

Essential Skills

  • Terraform Engineering & Infrastructure-as-Code Excellence
  • Demonstrable expertise in: Reusable module design
  • Testing strategies (unit, integration and validation testing)
  • State management
  • Promotion between environments
  • Code quality, versioning and maintainability
  • Platform engineering best practices
  • CI/CD, Automation & GitOps
  • Excellent experience of building and evolving infrastructure delivery pipelines, including: GitHub Actions, Automated testing, Security controls in pipelines, Policy checks, Release automation, GitOps operating models
  • AWS Platform Engineering Hands‑on AWS engineering with a focus on: IAM and security patterns, Networking integration, Storage and encryption, Observability, Resilience and operational readiness, Automation and supportability
  • Databricks on AWS Experience with: Workspace deployment, Databricks Terraform provider, Identity integration, Storage integration, Network connectivity patterns
  • Platform Engineering / Internal Developer Platforms Experience building: Self‑service capabilities, Golden paths, Paved roads, Reusable engineering patterns, Internal platform products
  • Observability, Reliability & Operational Engineering Experience with: Monitoring and alerting, Operational telemetry, Incident management, Resilience testing, Recovery automation, Production support

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job‑specific technical skills.

The successful candidate will be based in London. Our offices are located at 1 Churchill Place and 7 Westferry Circus (new BPL office). We support a hybrid working pattern with 3 days per week office‑based presence expected.

Barclays’ payments acceptance business provides critical infrastructure to the UK economy, processing billions of pounds of payments annually for both small businesses and domestic and international corporate clients. In April2025, we announced a long‑term partnership with Brookfield Asset Management to grow and transform the payments acceptance business by broadening the range of services offered, enhancing the experience for both existing and prospective clients. Leveraging extensive client relationships and deep experience of UK payments, we will create an environment of continuous innovation - activated by Brookfield’s global private equity expertise in payments, technology, operational transformation and corporate carve‑outs - to ensure the business is strategically positioned for long‑term growth. Barclays will invest approximately £400m in the new business, the majority of which will be incurred during the first three years. Performance‑linked incentives will drive greater alignment between the partners, underpinning the long‑term commitment to the transformation. Barclays and Brookfield will work to create a standalone entity over time, continuing to use the Barclaycard Payments (BPL) brand and acting as the sole payments’ acceptance services provider to Barclays’ clients for a minimum of ten years. For more information on our partnership with Brookfield, please visit Barclays.com.

Our Work Experience is the combination of everything that's unique about us: our culture, our core values, our company meetings, our commitment to sustainability, our recognition programs, but most importantly, it’s our people. Our employees are self‑disciplined, hard working, curious, trustworthy, humble, and truthful. They make choices according to what is best for the team, they live for opportunities to collaborate and make a difference, and they make us the #1 Top Workplace in the area.

title: Sr AME Fabrication Engineer
description:
The Senior Advanced Manufacturing Engineer is responsible for leading the development, implementation, and optimization of manufacturing processes, equipment, and production systems to support new product introductions (NPI), plant transfers, capacity expansion, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives. This role provides technical leadership across cross-functional teams and drives improvements in safety, quality, cost, delivery, and productivity. Responsibilities align with Advanced Manufacturing Engineering activities including process design, capital equipment implementation, manufacturing readiness, and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead manufacturing process design and validation for new products.
  • Develop manufacturing routings, work instructions, Bills of Process, and production standards.
  • Define tooling, fixtures, handling equipment, and automation solutions.
  • Support Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) reviews.
  • Establish process parameters and acceptance criteria.

New Product Introduction (NPI)

  • Lead manufacturing readiness activities through APQP and NPDI gates.
  • Coordinate prototype, pilot, and production builds.
  • Conduct process risk assessments including PFMEA.
  • Support PPAP submissions and product launch activities.
  • Ensure manufacturing deliverables are completed on schedule.

Capital Equipment & Automation

  • Identify and justify advanced manufacturing technologies.
  • Develop capital expenditure requests and ROI analyses.
  • Lead equipment procurement, installation, validation, and startup.
  • Implement automation, robotics, vision systems, and productivity improvements.

Continuous Improvement

  • Lead Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma initiatives.
  • Improve productivity, throughput, quality, and material utilization.
  • Reduce labor costs, scrap, rework, and process variation.
  • Drive standardization across manufacturing sites.

Project Leadership

  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Coordinate activities between Design Engineering, Quality, Operations, Supply Chain, and Maintenance.
  • Track project milestones, risks, budgets, and deliverables.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentoring to engineers and technicians.

Manufacturing Support

  • Resolve complex production and quality issues.
  • Conduct root cause analysis and corrective actions.
  • Support plant transfers and capacity expansions.
  • Serve as technical advisor for manufacturing operations.

Required Qualifications Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechatronics, or related field.

Experience

  • 7+ years of manufacturing engineering experience.
  • 3+ years supporting NPI or APQP projects.
  • Experience leading capital equipment or automation projects.
  • Experience in sheet metal fabrication, assembly, thermal products, or related manufacturing environments preferred.

Technical Skills

  • APQP, PFMEA, Control Plans, PPAP.
  • Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies.
  • Process capability studies (Cp, Cpk, Pp, Ppk).
  • Statistical Process Control (SPC) and MSA.
  • Manufacturing cost analysis.
  • CAD systems and equipment layout development.
  • Project management tools and ERP systems.
  • Automation, robotics, PLCs, or vision systems preferred.

Leadership Competencies

  • Strong project leadership.
  • Cross-functional collaboration.
  • Technical problem-solving.
  • Data-driven decision making.
  • Effective communication with global teams and suppliers.
  • Mentoring and development of junior engineers.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • NPI launch performance.
  • Productivity improvement.
  • Cost savings realization.
  • FPY / RTY improvement.
  • Scrap and rework reduction.
  • Capital project execution.
  • Manufacturing readiness achievement.
  • Safety and quality performance.

description:
CRM Program Manager (contract - remote)

Team: Consumer Marketing

Reports to: Head of Consumer Marketing

Level: Manager (program-level ownership)

About Cambly

Cambly is a global language learning platform that connects learners with tutors for real conversation practice, supported by AI-powered learning tools. We help students around the world build confidence and fluency in English.

About the Role

We're looking for a CRM Program Manager to lead Cambly's customer relationship management strategy and execution — delivering the right message to the right customer at the right time, via the right channel. This is a global role covering Cambly's markets across Latin America, Europe/Middle East, and Asia. You will run one CRM strategy with market-specific channel and messaging execution. You'll own CRM across email, in-app, push, and messaging apps, including expansion into local chat platforms such as WhatsApp, WeChat, and KakaoTalk.

This role combines strategic program management, cross-functional leadership, and CRM platform expertise to drive acquisition, engagement, and retention based on deep analysis of user behavior. You'll own the CRM roadmap, platform strategy, audience strategy, deliverability health, major CRM initiatives (including AI integrations), and performance measurement across regions. You'll partner with creative, growth, product, data, engineering, and regional teams, and work closely with operational specialists who execute day-to-day campaign setup.

What You'll Do

CRM Strategy & Program Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end CRM strategy across email, in-app, push, and messaging apps, aligned to acquisition, engagement, and retention KPIs.

  • Build and maintain the CRM roadmap, balancing evergreen lifecycle programs, promotional campaigns, and strategic initiatives.

  • Own the messaging-app channel strategy by market: WhatsApp (e.g., Brazil, Turkey, Arabic-speaking markets), WeChat (China), KakaoTalk (Korea), and other local platforms as markets warrant. Lead each from evaluation and pilot through rollout.

  • Set the global CRM framework and define what can be localized by market (channel mix, timing, offers, tone) and what stays standard.

  • Serve as the single point of accountability for CRM outcomes and leadership reporting.

CRM Platform & Vendor Management

  • Evaluate and manage messaging providers and official business account setups per platform (e.g., WhatsApp Business API providers, WeChat Official Accounts, KakaoTalk business channels), including template approvals and platform policy compliance.

  • Own platform relationships (e.g., Iterable), including contracts, roadmap alignment, feature adoption, and renewals.

  • Drive strategic CRM innovation projects, such as AI/LLM integrations with the CRM stack, from discovery through rollout and measurement.

  • Identify gaps across the CRM stack and champion investments that reduce cost, improve efficiency, or unlock new capabilities.

Audiences & Lifecycle Journeys

  • Partner with PMs and engineers to co-design lifecycle programs, in-product messaging surfaces, event instrumentation, and journey delivery mechanics.

  • Define audience segmentation and lead qualification frameworks — who we reach, via which channel, and at which lifecycle stage.

  • Own audiences and lists across markets: segmentation, hygiene, suppression, and ongoing maintenance.

  • Develop customer journey and audience insights that improve profitability, delivery, and engagement.

  • Design and oversee automated journeys, personalization, and experimentation standards (subject lines, send times, cohorts, journey structures), including promotional updates.

Analytics, Measurement & Optimization

  • Own CRM KPIs, dashboards, and reporting across all channels.

  • Report CRM performance by market and channel, with cross-market comparisons in the WBR.

  • Own email deliverability health (bounces, spam complaints, warming, IP/domain reputation), partnering with engineering and ESPs.

  • Design and lead CRM experiments and turn learnings into durable program improvements.

  • Tie CRM performance to business outcomes (LTV, retention, activation, payback) with actionable recommendations.

Cross-Functional Program Management

  • Lead planning, execution, and retros for major campaigns (promotions, product launches, regional initiatives).

  • Partner with product and data teams to make every initiative measurable end-to-end — event tracking, data pipelines, attribution, and metric integrity.

  • Coordinate workstreams across marketing, product, engineering, data, and regional stakeholders.

  • Document CRM processes, playbooks, and standards so execution is repeatable.

  • Secure creative resourcing before committing to timelines; write clear creative briefs, and step in on messaging and copy when needed.

AI, Automation & Innovation

  • Automate reporting, monitoring, and manual workflows using AI, scripts, and no-code/low-code tools.

  • Use AI to deliver high-quality, culturally accurate localization and scale content without sacrificing brand voice.

  • Lead AI adoption within CRM — personalization, copy generation, segmentation, and journey optimization — and share learnings across marketing.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in CRM, lifecycle, or retention marketing, ideally at a consumer subscription, mobile, or edtech company.

  • Hands-on expertise with a modern CRM/ESP platform (e.g., Iterable, Braze, ), including journey building and segmentation.

  • Proven track record owning CRM strategy and roadmap with measurable impact on acquisition, engagement, and retention.

  • Strong analytical skills — comfortable with dashboards, experimentation, and SQL or similar tools.

  • Working knowledge of email deliverability best practices.

  • Experience running multi-market or international CRM programs; familiarity with messaging apps like WhatsApp, WeChat, or KakaoTalk is a plus.

  • Excellent cross-functional program management and stakeholder communication skills.

  • Strong writing skills and the ability to brief creative teams or draft copy directly.

  • Curiosity and hands-on experience using AI and automation to improve marketing workflows.

What Success Looks Like

  • CRM is a clearly defined, strategically led function with a published roadmap and measurable impact.

  • Audiences are well segmented and maintained; deliverability is strong and proactively managed.

  • CRM is meaningfully expanded onto local chat platforms, driving incremental engagement and revenue.

  • Journey and audience insights drive higher-profitability segments and better engagement — not just more sends.

  • CRM results are clearly and consistently represented in the Weekly Business Review.

  • Product, data, and engineering see CRM as a true technical partner — every initiative is instrumented from day one.

  • The CRM stack is used to its full potential, and major initiatives are delivered end-to-end.

  • Manual workflows are increasingly automated, and AI powers high-quality localization and content at scale.

title: Senior Consultant
description:
Har du noen års erfaring som utvikler og er klar for å sette ditt fingeravtrykk på noen av de mest sentrale løsningene vi møter i vår digitale hverdag? Ønsker du å spille en avgjørende rolle for teamet ditt og prosjektets fremdrift, og være involvert i alle deler av prosessen - fra design og utvikling til sikring av at vi leverer et produkt av høy kvalitet til kunden?

Netcompany søker nå Senior Consultants som er klar for å utfordre seg selv i en rolle med ansvar for at kundens krav og behov omsettes til solide IT-løsninger som skaper verdi. Hos oss får du jobbe med digitalisering som skaper verdi i både offentlig og privat sektor - fra barnevern og helse til mobilitet og luftfart, for kunder som Møller Mobility Group og Avinor.

Hvem er du?
Vi ser etter deg som ønsker å utgjøre en forskjell og har den tekniske verktøykassen i orden, med en naturlig nysgjerrighet for nye teknologier. Du er opptatt av gode løsninger og kodekvalitet, er hjelpsom og deler gjerne din kunnskap med andre.

Du trives i tverrfaglige team og finner det gjerne naturlig å ta lederansvar for dine teammedlemmer.

Videre ser vi for oss at du

  • Har høyere formell utdannelse innen IT
  • Har flere års relevant erfaring (minimum 2 år)
  • Har fullstack-kompetanse med tyngde i backend (Java, C# e.l.)
  • Behersker norsk og engelsk - skriftlig og muntlig

Hvorfor jobbe hos oss?

I tillegg til at du vil jobbe sammen med dyktige folk i et sterkt og innovativt fagmiljø, kan vi tilby følgende:

  • Kontinuerlig utvikling og gode karrieremuligheter
  • Faglige aktiviteter gjennom vårt kompetanseutviklingsprogram Netcompany Academy, samt temakvelder, globale faggrupper og sertifiseringer.
  • Et flust av sosiale aktiviteter som for eksempel fredagspils, kinoklubb, e-sportlag og en haug med ulike aktivitetsgrupper.
  • Konkurransedyktig lønn og betingelser, gode forsikringer og pensjonsordning

Vi er Netcompany
Netcompany er et IT-konsulentselskap som leverer forretningskritiske IT-prosjekter og hjelper kunder med digital transformasjon via digitale plattformer, kjernesystemer og infrastruktursystemer. Ved å kontinuerlig støtte oppunder og utfordre våre konsulenter har vi skapt et innovativt og kunnskapsbasert miljø som er lidenskapelig opptatt av å være kodenære og helt i forkant i systemutviklingsfaget. Vi tar ansvar i alle aspekter av et prosjekt - uavhengig om det er nyutvikling av en forretningskritisk IT-løsning eller forvaltning av en mobil løsning.

Våre ansatte er nøkkelen til vår suksess, derfor bruker vi mye tid og ressurser på å utvikle medarbeiderne våre til de beste i bransjen gjennom et inkluderende, positivt og faglig sterkt miljø. Hos våre kunder tar vi ansvar og arbeider målrettet, og utenfor arbeidstiden har vi mange arrangementer og aktiviteter som styrker fellesskapet på tvers av team og prosjekter. Vi har stor variasjon i arrangementer, fra brettspillkveld til tur til Jotunheimen, så det er noe for alle og enhver.

Vi tar ansvar, helt enkelt.

Synes du dette høres spennende ut?
Ta kontakt med Frederikke Sundberg (fredsun@netcompany.com) dersom du har spørsmål om stillingen eller er åpen for en uforpliktende prat.

Alle kvalifiserte kandidater er velkomne til å søke uavhengig av kjønn, kjønnsuttrykk, seksualitet, funksjonshemming, alder, religion og livssyn, politisk ståsted, nasjonalitet, etnisk eller sosial bakgrunn.

I Netcompany er vi opptatt av å skape en tilrettelagt og inkluderende arbeidsplass for alle. Dersom du av ulike grunner trenger tilpasninger eller ytterligere støtte under rekrutteringsprosessen hos oss, vennligst send en e-post til Julie på tilpasninger.no@netcompany.com, så vil vi bistå deg.

title: Vice President – Human Capital & Culture
description:

The Role

The Vice President of Human Capital & Culture will define and lead the group-wide people strategy, covering talent acquisition, leadership development, performance management, and organizational design. This role will act as a strategic partner to the board and executive leadership on people-related matters. A key focus will be building leadership pipelines and succession plans across business units. The VP will oversee HR governance, policy standardisation, and labour compliance across geographies.
