title: Data Center Technical Operations Engineer, AWS Data Center Engineering Operations
description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain - and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Infrastructure Operations (Data Center) Team is the backbone of AWS, supporting the rapidly growing AWS business and customers 24/7. We are committed to maintain the physical infrastructure of AWS, ensuring the standards for operational performance in the areas of safety, security, availability, productivity, capacity, efficiency, and cost.

We are looking for a Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) Technician with experience in critical facilities management, and a result-driven individual with strong technical understanding and the drive and vision to take our data center engineering operations to the next level. The DCEO Technician is responsible for engineering operations including risk management and mitigation, planning, implementation of corrective and preventative maintenance for critical infrastructure and vendor management within our AWS Data Center environment. They are responsible for day-to-day operational excellence, maintenance of the critical infrastructure, supervising specialist vendors, acting as first responders to incidents, and becoming subject matter experts for the facility.

Key job responsibilities

  • Meet daily hours of operations, on call requirements and response during rotations.
  • Manage minor and major planned and unplanned site works for critical infrastructure, with a solid understanding of the works involved, risks, mitigation and seeking approvals within relevant SLA's as required.
  • Responsible for the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation.
  • Prepare reports on all aspects of the data center facility infrastructure operations and maintenance.
  • Generate change management requests & incident management tickets for DCEO activities.
  • Coordinate with DCO managers (IT), Networking, Logistics, Safety, Security and other business leaders and operating partners to execute projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability, sustainability and efficiency.
  • Review and follow the documentation relevant to technical support of business & facility operations.
  • Implement projects to increase current facility capacity, efficiency, sustainability & reliability.
  • Support operating partners in the resolution of any infrastructure engineering issues

A day in the life

  • Support troubleshooting facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA).
  • Perform rack installs, rack decommissioning, and facility management.
  • Provide operational readings and key performance indicators to make sure uptime is maintained
  • Performance and oversight of maintenance and operations on all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center.
  • Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.

About the team

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating - that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

  • 1+ years of experience in data center operations or electrical/mechanical systems
  • Experience with HVAC, UPS, generators, or power distribution systems
  • Ability to work rotating shifts including nights, weekends, and holidays
  • Basic understanding of electrical safety procedures
  • Ability to read and interpret technical documentation and schematics

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering,
  • Mechanical Engineering, or related technical field
  • Experience working in a data center or critical facility environment
  • Familiarity with BMS (Building Management System)
  • or EPMS (Electrical Power Monitoring System)
  • Experience with preventive maintenance procedures for critical infrastructure
  • Knowledge of LOTO (Lockout/Tagout) safety procedures
  • Experience troubleshooting UPS, PDU, or generator systems
  • Ability to obtain relevant electrical or mechanical certifications
  • Strong communication skills in English (written and verbal)

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Senior Managing Consultant – Data Engineer - (Databricks)| Brisbane
description:
Build modern data solutions. Lead client outcomes. Help grow our Queensland capability.

At Altis Consulting, we're looking for a hands-on Data Engineer who enjoys being close to both the technology and the client.

This is a role for someone who can take a business problem, shape the right technical approach, and lead it through to a practical outcome. You'll work across modern data platforms and engineering solutions while building trusted relationships with clients and helping develop the consultants around you.

What you'll do

  • Design scalable data platforms, pipelines, integration and analytics solutions.
  • Work across modern cloud technologies including Databricks, Snowflake and the Microsoft/Azure ecosystem.
  • Translate complex business requirements into clear technical solutions.
  • Guide and mentor consultants and contribute to a strong engineering culture.
  • Build trusted relationships with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities to create additional value for clients and contribute to proposals and solution shaping.

What you'll bring

You'll have strong experience across data engineering, architecture or analytics consulting and be comfortable operating directly with clients.

We're particularly interested in experience across:

  • Modern data engineering and data modelling
  • Cloud data platforms - Databricks, Snowflake, Azure or comparable technologies
  • Databricks experience essential
  • SQL and modern data integration/ELT patterns
  • Data quality, governance and sustainable engineering practices
  • Leading projects or small technical teams
  • Consulting, advisory or client-facing delivery

You don't need to have worked with every technology we use. We're more interested in strong foundations, sound technical judgement and an ability to learn.

The person we're looking for

You enjoy solving ambiguous problems, can challenge thinking respectfully and know when a technically impressive solution isn't necessarily the right business solution.

You'll be comfortable talking architecture with engineers one minute and explaining the value of the solution to an executive stakeholder the next.

Why Altis?

For more than 25 years, Altis has focused on one thing: helping organisations create better outcomes through data.

We're Australian-owned and technology-agnostic, which means our consultants can focus on solving the right problem rather than selling a particular platform.

At Altis you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Work across varied and challenging Data & AI engagements
  • Learn from experienced specialists across consulting, engineering, analytics and AI
  • Build your capability through ongoing learning and career development
  • Work in a collaborative environment where you're encouraged to challenge ideas and contribute your own
  • Work flexibly through our hybrid model
  • Access health and wellbeing support for you and your family
  • Access paid parental leave and our reward and recognition program

Our values - Be Curious, Own It, Lead with Heart and Discover a Way - shape how we work with our clients and with each other.

Your next move doesn't need to tick every box

Different experiences and perspectives make our teams stronger.

If you need adjustments or support at any stage of our recruitment process, let our Talent Acquisition team know and we'll work with you.

title: Project Coordinator – Engagement (Data and Technology)
description:

As Project Coordinator, Engagement (Data and Technology), you will provide essential coordination to support collaboration between lived experience leaders and the Data Connect + program. Working closely with the Senior Manager of Consumer Involvement and the wider Strategic Programs team, you will ensure the smooth implementation of effective practice and engagement across the program. Your responsibilities include serving as a key point of contact for lived experience leaders, coordinating a smooth recruitment process, and supporting the preparation and delivery of consumer-led research activities.

  • Working alongside the Data Connect + team to track project-related milestones, deliverables and key requirements
  • Building and sustaining trusted and respectful working relationships across the life of the project
  • Identify potential process improvement opportunities, in relation to the collection, collation and analysis of data for reporting
  • Promote harmonisation and be pro-active in identifying and optimising collaborative opportunities across different lived experience leaders and researchers

We do this in alliance with our 10 joint venture members who, to name a few, include Peter MacCallum Cancer Centre, The Royal Melbourne Hospital, WEHI, The Royal Children’s Hospital and Western Health – for more detailed information: about-us/what-is-the-vccc-alliance/alliance-members/

  • 15 days personal / carer’s leave;
  • Solid market salary boosted by NFP salary packaging and tax-free meals/accommodation card;
  • Supportive small-team environment with a clear vision and inspiring strategic direction.

VCCC Alliance Values

United: we connect and support to empower sustainable change

Respectful: we are respectful of each other and the cancer community and accountable for our contribution

Bold: we cultivate ideas and dare to innovate

Patient-Centred: we place patients with cancer at the centre of all we do

Equity & Inclusion

title: Partneransvarlig til 3F
description:
Vil du udvikle partnerskaber, der skaber reel værdi for 3F's medlemmer?

I 3F søger vi en erfaren partneransvarlig, der kan drive og udvikle nogle af vores vigtigste strategiske partnerskaber.

Vi leder efter en profil, der kan balancere kommerciel forståelse med medlemsfokus. Du skal kunne udvikle stærke relationer til vores samarbejdspartnere, identificere nye muligheder og omsætte dem til konkrete produkter, ydelser og tilbud, som medlemmerne oplever som relevante og værdifulde.

Du bliver en del af et nyetableret team for produkter og partnerskaber, hvor du sammen med fem dygtige kolleger får en central rolle i arbejdet med at udvikle og styrke 3F's medlemsfordele.

Arbejdsopgaver:

Du får ansvar for en portefølje af strategiske partnerskaber og samarbejdsaftaler, som du udvikler med fokus på medlemsværdi, relevans og forretningsmæssigt potentiale.

Du identificerer nye muligheder for produkter, ydelser og medlemsfordele, forhandler kommercielle aftaler og følger op på mål, aktiviteter og resultater.

Du analyserer brug og effekt af eksisterende tilbud og omsætter dine indsigter til konkrete forbedringer og nye initiativer. Samtidig udarbejder du beslutningsoplæg og samarbejder på tværs af organisationen og de lokale afdelinger for at sikre en stærk implementering og forankring.

Din vigtigste opgave bliver at sikre, at partnerskaberne skaber størst mulig værdi for 3F's medlemmer og samtidig understøtter 3F's strategiske mål.

Om dig:

  • Har erfaring med at drive, udvikle og forhandle strategiske partnerskaber.
  • Har arbejdet med kommercielle samarbejder, forretningsudvikling eller partner management.
  • Har dokumenteret erfaring med kontraktforhandling og aftaleudvikling.
  • Arbejder struktureret og datadrevet og bruger indsigter aktivt til at prioritere og udvikle indsatser.
  • Er stærk til at skabe relationer og navigere i komplekse samarbejder med mange interessenter.
  • Trives i krydsfeltet mellem strategi, forretning og interessenthåndtering.
  • Kan omsætte analyser og indsigter til konkrete anbefalinger og handlinger.

Derfor skal du vælge 3F:

I 3F arbejder vi hver dag for at skabe værdi for vores medlemmer. Vores partnerskaber er en vigtig del af den ambition, fordi de giver adgang til produkter, services og fordele, som bidrager til medlemmernes hverdag.

Som partneransvarlig får du mulighed for at arbejde med nogle af vores vigtigste samarbejdspartnere og være med til at forme fremtidens medlemsfordele. Du får stor indflydelse på udviklingen af området og bliver en del af et ambitiøst team med høje faglige ambitioner og et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab.
Hos 3F bliver du ansat under overenskomst med bl.a. god løn og arbejdsgiverbetalt pension. Arbejdspladsen er centralt beliggende i København – tæt ved Vesterport station.

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, kan du kontakte kommunikations- og loyalitetschef Ilse Lærke Kristensen på mail ilse.kristensen@3f.dk eller mobilnummeret 31213478.

Ansøgning:

Vi går ind for mangfoldighed og opfordrer alle kvalificerede til at søge stillingen.

Send din ansøgning og CV ved at klikke på ”søg stilling” senest 14. oktober 2026.

Vi forventer at afholde 1. samtaler i uge 43 og 2. samtaler i uge 44.

Tiltrædelse den 1. december 2026.

Hvis du vil vide mere om 3F som arbejdsplads eller om vores rekrutteringsforløb, kan du klikke her.

Job Summary

General Atomics Electromagnetic Systems (GA-EMS) designs and manufactures first-of-a-kind electromagnetic and electric power generation systems. GA-EMS’ expanding portfolio of specialized products and integrated system solutions support critical fleet, space systems and satellites, missile defense, power and energy, and process and monitoring applications for defense, industrial, and commercial customers worldwide.

We have an exciting opportunity for a Quality Inspector to join our team in Tupelo, MS!

Under limited supervision this position is responsible for inspecting a wide variety of parts, assemblies, tooling ﬁxtures and material to ensure compliance with customer requirements, company speciﬁcations, and quality requirements.

Sets up, operates, inspects, tests, and adjusts new and reworked tools, dies, gauges, jigs and ﬁxtures for conformance to engineering drawings and speciﬁcations. Maintains, processes, and compiles a variety of conﬁdential and sensitive electronic and hard copy reports, records and statistics.

Assignments are typically non-routine where judgment and assessment are required to resolve moderately complex issues. May conduct inspections at customer or vendor sites.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITES:**

- Inspects machined parts, components, assemblies and materials to ensure compliance with appropriate regulatory guidelines (Military Standards, ASTM, AWS, ANSI, and ASME Code). Provides various electronic and hard copy reports of inspections and notifies appropriate parties including project engineers.
- Sets up and operates measuring and test equipment to include Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD & T).
- May operate Coordinate Measurement Machines (CMM) equipment or other portable metrology equipment to achieve part acceptance, including equipment set up, inspection techniques, for final dimensional inspections or in-process manufacturing.
- May prepare, update and maintain computer databases.
- Observes testing and provides the quality oversight necessary to verify compliance with requirements/standards.
- May interact with and provide responses to regulatory agencies and customers during their audits and review of company inspection, and calibration activities.
- May monitor and verify quality in accordance with statistical process or other control procedures.
- May coordinate the procurement of standard materials, services and parts for inspections.
- Responsible for observing all laws, regulations, and other applicable obligations wherever and whenever business is conducted on behalf of the Company.  Expected to work in a safe manner in accordance with established operating procedures and practices.
- Travel may be required.
- Other duties as assigned or required.

We recognize and appreciate the value and contributions of individuals with diverse backgrounds and experiences and welcome all qualified individuals to apply.

Job Qualifications

- Typically requires an associate's degree, trade school certificate, military training, or equivalent in quality inspections or certification by a professional group such as ASQ or AWS, and three or more years of progressive experience in electrical, mechanical, electromechanical or metrology inspection and calibration. May substitute additional experience in lieu of formal education and training.

- Strong communication skills to effectively interface with all levels of employees including management.
- Ability to interpret complex information and respond to a variety of complex issues.
- An intermediate to Subject Matter Expert level of knowledge on Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD & T).
- Must be proficient with hand inspection tools such as micrometers, calipers, height gages, plug and ring gages, profilometers, radius gages.
- Experience with optical comparators, Keyence vision or scanners, and Micro-Vu preferred.
- Experience with Coordinate Measuring Machines, portable ARMS, and/or Laser Tracker equipment (LEICA models or similar) to achieve part acceptance is preferred.
- Strong data entry skills and proficiency with Microsoft Office suite is highly desirable.
- An intermediate level of knowledge of coordinate metrology software is preferred (i.e. PC-DMIS, Spatial Analyzer, Polyworks).
- The ability to work independently or in a team environment is essential as is the ability to work extended hours as required.
- Experience with ISO 9001, AS 9100/9102, and Department of Defense (DOD) quality assurance program requirements in a manufacturing environment are highly desirable.
- Ability to obtain and maintain DoD clearance is desired.

title: Finance Data Engineer (Senior Manager)
description:
UKI Finance RP

Finance Data Engineer

The practice

Finance is one of the most demanding and valuable environments in which to apply modern technology. You will work with complex enterprise data, mission-critical processes and high-impact decisions, using AI, data and engineering to reshape how organisations plan, control performance and allocate resources. The opportunity goes beyond building technically strong solutions: you will see how those solutions influence cash, profitability, risk and business growth, and take them from experimentation into trusted, production-ready capabilities. Working in Finance Reinvention allows you to remain close to leading-edge technology while developing an understanding of the CFO agenda, gaining exposure to senior decision-makers and building the commercial judgement needed to solve enterprise-wide challenges. This combination of deep technical capability, finance-domain expertise and measurable business impact creates a differentiated career path that is difficult to develop in a purely technology-focused role.

Purpose of the role

Responsible for the finance data and ontology layer on which agentic solutions depend. Builds the entities, relationships, definitions, lineage and data contracts sourced from live ERP and EPM systems to a standard that supports controlled and auditable agent behaviour. The role owns governed finance data products, semantic models and retrieval-ready data services that are secure, permission-aware, observable and suitable for AI, analytics and decision intelligence.

Responsibilities

  • Build and extend the finance ontology covering supplier, invoice, customer, receivable, journal, account, cost centre and forecast line, and the relationships between them, including controlled vocabularies, business glossaries, hierarchy history, ownership and lifecycle versioning.
  • Engineer pipelines from SAP, Oracle, Workday and EPM platforms into governed data products, supporting structured and unstructured sources, batch and incremental ingestion, APIs, files and change-data-capture patterns as appropriate.
  • Build entity-resolution and master or reference-data capabilities that reconcile identifiers, definitions and hierarchies across source systems and preserve source-to-target mappings.
  • Establish lineage and evidence sufficient for audit, so that agent output can be traced to source, with automated data-quality checks, finance reconciliations, completeness and freshness measures, observability, alerts and recoverable operations.
  • Define data contracts between delivery pods, and between Accenture delivery and client platform teams, including schemas, quality thresholds, access rules, service levels, versioning and change-control expectations.
  • Experience deploying software or data products on Azure, AWS or GCP, DataBricks, Snowflake, Palantir etc using relevant cloud services and at least one of containers, Kubernetes or serverless patterns.
  • Work with AI Engineers on retrieval and grounding, ensuring models receive appropriately scoped context, including chunking and embedding strategies, hybrid or graph retrieval, permission-aware filtering, provenance and retrieval evaluation.
  • Implement security and privacy controls across the data lifecycle, including role- or attribute-based access, row or document-level permissions, masking or tokenisation, retention, tenant isolation and audit logging.
  • Apply software and DataOps practices including Git, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code where relevant, performance tuning, cost optimisation and production support.
  • Collaborate with finance SMEs, data owners, architects and governance teams to agree definitions, resolve data issues and embed sustainable stewardship and operating ownership.
  • Data engineering

Essential experience

  • Production data engineering, including SQL, Python, a modern data platform such as Databricks, Snowflake or Fabric, and orchestration tooling, with practical experience of ETL/ELT, data testing, Git and CI/CD; PySpark or dbt experience is beneficial.
  • Working knowledge of finance data structures, including chart of accounts, entity hierarchy, sub-ledger to ledger relationships, intercompany and period close, together with actual, budget and forecast data, currencies, consolidation and management hierarchies.
  • Strong data modelling discipline and the ability to justify and maintain definitional standards, including canonical or semantic models, data contracts, schema evolution, metadata, lineage and data-quality controls.
  • Experience extracting and reconciling data from enterprise applications or complex operational systems using APIs, files, database interfaces or change-data-capture patterns.
  • Experience deploying software or data products on Azure, AWS or GCP, DataBricks, Snowflake, Palantir etc. using relevant cloud services and at least one of containers, Kubernetes or serverless patterns. (AI engineer - desirable)
  • Understanding of secure data engineering, including access control, encryption, secrets, privacy, retention and the handling of sensitive or regulated data.
  • Ability to work with finance SMEs and technical teams to translate business definitions and controls into implementable data products and acceptance criteria.
  • At least 10 years' relevant professional experience

Desirable

  • Knowledge graph, semantic layer or ontology engineering experience, including technologies or standards such as Neo4j, RDF/OWL, SKOS, SPARQL or GraphRAG.
  • Data quality, master data management or lineage tooling experience, including entity resolution, business glossaries, catalogues or platforms such as Collibra, Purview or Unity Catalog.
  • Exposure to SOX or external audit requirements, GDPR, model-risk controls or regulated-data environments.
  • Detailed knowledge of one or more finance-platform data models, such as SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Fusion, Workday Financials, Anaplan, OneStream or SAP Analytics Cloud.
  • Experience evaluating retrieval quality for AI workloads, including embeddings, vector stores, hybrid search or reranking.

title: A.I. Research Engineer
description:
Our Client Company Overview

QOVES is a biomedical startup that focuses on improving patient experiences in cosmetic medical clinics through software. In simple speak, we make software that uses A.I., computer vision, recommendation algorithms and other to predict how patients may look like after cosmetic surgery and to diagnose whether the surgery is even beneficial. Our goal is to turn the process of consultation for cosmetic surgery into a well defined, clinical procedure of diagnosis and visualisation through our software integrations with clinics.

Your Role

In simple terms, you will be in charge of managing the technical development of the product directly under the CTO for A.I. related matters. This involves conducting research into the latest papers and approaches into visualization and generative networks, finetuneing existing products and deploying endpoints to production to work with the rest of the team.

Position: Research A.I. Engineer

Location: Remote / London (preferred), sponsorship possible

Employment Type: Full-timeOur

Culture

We take our work seriously and reap the rewards equally amongst our team. We're after team members that want to strive for the best and be recognised as such in their field:

  • Curious, intellectual, confident - Team members that are confident in their decisions; a self-assured confidence that comes from years of experience and independent research. You're able to call out wrong decisions and stand behind your own with conviction.
  • Work hard, play hard we often have to work 60+ hour weeks and expect the same from our team. When it needs to be done, we do it but in return we recognise and reward team players for their dedication to the craft.
  • Meritocracy, always you own and earn your destiny. The best argument wins, not the loudest voice or the most senior team member.

Why Work at QOVES
  • We're solving a real problem with real implications - the healthcare system is overworked, A.I. integration will help dramatically ease the triage burden.
  • We have the resources to achieve our mission. We have raised a sizable seed round backed by local and foreign investors to fund our product development.
  • We are developing cutting-edge AI technology. The systems being built rely on our latest internal and external research in generative and computer vision fields to accurately diagnose medical anomalies from photographs of patients. Succeeding here will provide you a strong backing into future companies leveraging these A.I. discoveries to build newer products.
  • We have an endless supply of customers and interest. With our social platforms getting 40 million+ unique viewers a month, the top celebrity doctors on our waitlists and endless celebrities as our current customers, we've built enough influence in our field over 4 years to be the largest in solving the facial diagnostic problem. We have the head start to reach the multiple billions.
  • Work with two established founders to solve a generational problem.

Your Role to Shape QOVES

At QOVES as a Founding AI Engineer, you will help build the most advanced AI facial diagnostic pipeline in the world. It's no easy task but you won't be alone!

Your qualifications

You have demonstrated the ability to build world-class AI/LLM applications, with a strong emphasis on building visualisation systems (GANs, Diffusion Models...):

  • 3+ years of work experience deploying LLM/ML models to production
  • Technical experience with visual generative models, especially in Generative Adversarial Networks.
  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI, Math, Physics, or similar or equivalent additional work experience
  • Excellent communication skills to interact with founding team and customers
  • Ability to understand and implement technical state-of-the-art research papers
  • Proficiency to write production-level code for AI/LLM based applications
  • Proficiency with advanced Python workflows, including (Pytorch + Langchain/LlamaIndex or similar libraries, Scikit-learn, pandas)
  • Proficiency with version control (Git)
  • Experience implementing pipelines for visualization models (GANs, Diffusion Models)

title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer

Mexico City · 90% Remote Mid-Senior · 3–5 years experience Reports to: Data Lead

About the role

We’re looking for a Data Engineer to help build and scale the data infrastructure behind a fast-growing payments platform in Mexico.

You’ll work with high-volume, business-critical data and own meaningful parts of the data platform end to end—from ingestion and modeling to quality, monitoring, and reliability.

What you’ll do

  • Build and maintain batch and near real-time data pipelines from transactional systems, banks, card networks, and partners.

  • Design reliable, observable, and scalable data flows with clear SLAs.

  • Build layered data models from raw > curated > business-ready.

  • Create trusted datasets for metrics such as transaction volume, approval rates, chargebacks, and settlements.

  • Implement data quality, testing, monitoring, and alerting.

  • Work with sensitive data following PCI DSS and Mexican financial regulations.

  • Partner with Analytics, Data Science, Risk, and Fraud teams to support reporting and ML models.

  • Monitor platform performance, reliability, and cloud costs.

  • Participate in incident response and blameless post-mortems.

  • Use AI coding assistants as part of your daily engineering workflow, while validating their output.

What we’re looking for

  • 3–5 years of experience as a Data Engineer or similar role, with production data pipelines.

  • Strong experience owning data systems end to end.

  • Advanced SQL and strong Python skills.

  • Hands‑on experience with Apache Airflow and dbt.

  • Experience with AWS or GCP and data warehouses such as Redshift, BigQuery, or Snowflake.

  • Solid knowledge of data modeling, including dimensional and layered/medallion architectures.

  • Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL/MySQL and NoSQL databases.

  • Good engineering practices: Git, code reviews, testing, CI/CD, and Docker.

  • Daily experience with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar.

  • Fluent Spanish and professional working English.

  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

  • Experience in payments, fintech, banking, or other high-volume environments.

  • Kafka, Debezium, Spark, or Flink.

  • Data quality and observability tools such as Great Expectations or Monte Carlo.

  • Terraform, Iceberg, or Delta Lake.

  • Experience supporting ML pipelines or feature engineering, especially for fraud or risk.

  • Exposure to LLM use cases such as embeddings, vector search, or text-to-SQL.

  • Familiarity with PCI DSS or the Mexican payments ecosystem, including SPEI, card networks, and acquiring.

Why join?

You’ll work on data where reliability really matters: every transaction represents someone's money. The role combines data engineering, fintech, AI, and high-scale infrastructure, with the opportunity to have direct ownership over critical parts of the platform.

title: Gaming DevOps Engineer
description:
Are you an experienced DevOps Engineer looking for your next career opportunity? The Gaming Area within Product Development is now hiring! The Gaming Area at Betsson Group focuses on Game Play and Game Discovery across all our brands and markets. We aim to offer the best gaming products in the industry and an exciting user experience when playing on our sites. We cover game lobbies, gaming initiatives, provider integrations and more.

THE WOW

Our Gaming platform is the core of everything we do. It supports all our gaming sites and is central to the company strategy.

You will be part of preparing our journey to containerization, improved delivery via cloud deployment, increasing the scalability of our systems while also maintaining their high quality. To accommodate new requirements, we are constantly re‑evaluating our systems design and working on exciting new features. You will be part of a passionate team, which is building an industry leading, scalable, multi-brand platform to support 25+ online brands! Our brands are used by hundreds of thousands of users and growing.

To sum it up: you will be taking our Gaming platform, which is used by a worldwide audience, to a new level!

A taster of what you will be involved with:

  • Working with cutting edge technology enabling our Cloud Journey
  • The DevOps Engineer for our Gaming Department will be responsible for supporting development teams (both Backend and Frontent focused), and will be instrumental in enhancing CI/CD pipelines, improving monitoring and observability, and supporting & mantaining other custom infra solutions.
  • Take ownership of CI/CD pipelines, guiding developers to improve automation, reliability, and test coverage. Lead the migration from Octopus to GitHub Actions and foster a culture of developer‑led deployment
  • Design and evolve monitoring systems with Prometheus/Grafana (or future alternatives), integrating observability into CI/CD workflows. Ensure robust tracing, logging, and metrics correlation across services.
  • Support and extend custom‑built infrastructure components to handle increased traffic and complex routing. Collaborate with frontend and backend teams to ensure performance, scalability, and security.
  • Work closely with all Gaming teams and DevOps engineers focused on infrastrucutre and operations. Provide tooling and guidance to developers across environments.

What we're looking for:

  • Experience with GitHub Actions and Octopus; strong focus on deployment automation, speed, reliability, and test coverage. Ability to guide developers and foster ownership of CI/CD workflows.
  • Proficiency with Prometheus/Grafana; capable of building dashboards, improving alerting, and integrating monitoring into CI/CD. Understanding of observability practices including tracing, logging, and metrics correlation.
  • Experience with custom‑built NGINX setups; able to extend routing rules to support increased traffic and complex routing needs.
  • Strong knowledge of AWS (EC2, ALB, VPC, EKS); experience managing infrastructure using Terraform and modules.
  • Proven experience setting up and managing Kubernetes clusters, ideally with AWS EKS and Rancher RKE.
  • Ability to write scripts in Python, Bash, PowerShell or similar for automation and tooling.
  • Proficient in Git and versioned source control practices.
  • Strong cross‑functional collaboration skills; able to work with Gaming teams and Infra/Ops DevOps engineers.
  • Solid understanding of DevOps culture and ITIL best practices. Problem‑solving mindset with ability to resolve complex technical issues efficiently.
  • Excellent problem‑solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex technical issues and provide effective solutions in a timely manner.
  • Act as a technical enabler for development teams, providing tooling, guidance, and support across environments. Champion DevOps best practices and empower teams to take ownership of their delivery pipelines

Who We Are

Betsson Group is one of the largest companies within the Global iGaming space and can trace our heritage as far back as the 1960’s. We’re Swedish and publicly listed too with our Operational HQ located on the Mediterranean Island of Malta. Malaga is our newest tech hub where we are building one of the leading software engineering teams in Spain.

We strive to deliver the best customer experience in the industry. As a market leader within iGaming we offer online gaming products across 12+ jurisdictions and 20+ brands.

You will be part of a passionate team, which is building an industry leading, scalable, multi‑brand platform used by hundreds of thousands of our customers!

What we offer

Much like riding a rollercoaster, sometimes life at Betsson can be lightning fast with twists and turns but always FUN! Then again, what else would you expect from a business 75% millennial and 1700 strong, spread across 7 offices with over 1,000 based out of our Malta HQ alone! We recognise it may not be for the faint‑hearted, but if you’re a go‑getter, initiator and adrenaline junkie, always striving to push the boundaries and challenge yourself, then you’ll fit right in.

  • 25 working days of paid vacation.
  • Private health and life insurance.
  • Flexible compensation package for transport, meals, and more!
  • Hybrid work policy for the best of office and home.
  • Up to 10 days per year working remotely from abroad.
  • €300 yearly wellness allowance.
  • Office perks to make your day easier.
  • Referral program with a bonus for successful hires.
  • Intensive summer schedule in August for extra flexibility and work‑life balance.

In addition to all of this, you will be part of the multi-cultural Betsson community enjoying team‑building events, our Friday bars, our social clubs, parties and other events. There is always something fun to look forward to!

title: Senior Backend Developer (PHP & SQL)
description:
Turn the insurance world upside down as a Senior Backend Developer (PHP & SQL)

We are InShared: an online insurer that does everything just a little differently. We started as a disruptor in the Dutch insurance market and are now expanding internationally. Using smart technology, we make insurance simple, fast and fair. Our ambition? To build the best digital insurance platform in the world.

Today, we are a team of 350 people, and we're continuing to grow. To support that growth, we're looking for a Senior Backend Developer who enjoys combining hands‑on development with technical ownership and wants to help modernize one of the most business‑critical parts of our platform.

What will you be doing?

As a Senior Backend Developer, you will join the team responsible for InShared's financial platform. This platform powers our billing, collections and payment processes and is essential to the day‑to‑day operation of the business. Together with your team, you'll be responsible for ensuring customers are billed correctly, payments are processed successfully and collection processes run smoothly. This includes integrations with payment providers and external partners such as Mollie, Buckaroo, accounting systems, collection agencies, Independer and international aggregators.

A large part of the platform has been built over many years using PHP and SQL. Many business rules and financial processes currently live within the database layer. As a result, we're looking for a developer who is comfortable not only writing application code, but also understanding, maintaining and improving complex SQL logic.

You’ll help keep our existing platform reliable while contributing to the long‑term roadmap to modernize and simplify the architecture. This is not a lift‑and‑shift migration. Our billing and collections platform processes millions of euros and supports critical monthly business operations, which means modernization will happen gradually over the coming years.

Besides developing new functionality, you will also:

  • Take ownership of business‑critical financial processes
  • Analyse and resolve production incidents
  • Support service desk tickets when needed
  • Improve integrations with internal and external systems
  • Contribute to architectural improvements and technical modernization
  • Help us move towards a more modern CI/CD and Continuous Delivery approach

We all benefit. And so will you!

Besides the opportunity to help shape the future of insurance, we offer you a salary between €60.000 and €80.000 per year (including vacation allowance). But working at InShared comes with even more benefits:

  • 31 paid holidays (full‑time employment) and the option to exchange extra leave
  • A workspace in our office villa surrounded by nature
  • A fully equipped home office (€1,000 every 5 years)
  • Monthly internet and remote work allowance
  • A good pension plan, including a solid partner and survivor’s pension
  • Travel allowance of €0.23 per kilometer (from 10 km to 75 km one way) or an NS Business Card with OV-bike
  • Personal development budget of €750 per year - saving up is allowed! (max 3 years)
  • Well‑being budget of €200 per year
  • And much more...

What do you bring?

  • Extensive experience developing applications in PHP
  • Strong SQL programming skills and experience working with complex database logic
  • The ability to read, understand and improve existing SQL functions, procedures and business rules
  • Experience with at least one modern PHP framework such as Laravel or Symfony
  • A pragmatic mindset and willingness to work in both legacy and modern environments
  • Ownership and a strong sense of responsibility for business‑critical systems
  • Experience with CI/CD, cloud platforms or platform modernization is a plus
  • Experience within financial services is a plus, but certainly not required
  • Excellent communication skills in English

Most importantly, we are looking for someone who enjoys learning, likes taking responsibility and gets energy from solving complex technical and business challenges.

title: Referral Triage Specialist (Internal Position)
description:
Internal Applicants Only!

Join Us in Transforming Lives Every Day

At OneLegacy, every moment counts. As the nation's largest organ, eye, and tissue recovery organization, we are dedicated to saving lives and sharing hope. Guided by our values of integrity, compassion, stewardship, diversity and inclusion, urgency, innovation and excellence, and collaboration, our team works tirelessly to honor every gift of donation. This is more than a job; it’s an opportunity to make a profound impact on countless lives.

Job Type: Full-time, Non-exempt

Hours: 12-hour shifts: 8PM-8AM; 7 days in a two week period, including alternating weekends.

Travel: Occasionally required to travel by personal auto or air to meeting sites and other locations.

Summary of Functions:

The Referral Triage Specialist (RTS) performs the initial response to organ referrals as well as dispatches clinical and non-clinical staff on “new” and “continue to follow” referrals. The RTS will ensure consistency in referral related processes and facilitate communication, both internally and with external
partners. The RTS will adhere to established policies/practices and operate in a manner consistent with a Subject Matter Expert (SME).


The RTS oversees the initial intake of the daily referral activity including initial referral response, referral acuity and determination of referral escalation/de-escalation, site visit documentation, quality assessments and collection of data.
The RTS will demonstrate fiscal responsibility with appropriate utilization of clinical resources, including staff activity, assignments, and by monitoring referral case performance metrics.


The RTS must be able to communicate professionally as well as direct staff through the decision-making process. The RTS will strive to continuously improve the quality of OneLegacy practices, performance, and service to our hospital partners, our donors, and their families. The RTS will actively foster an organizational culture that is based on collaboration, support, process improvement and constructive feedback.

Duties & Responsibilities:

Essential Job Functions:

Referral Management

  1. Supports the organization’s Standards of Professional Conduct as outlined in OneLegacy’s policies and procedures, mission, vision, and values of the organization.
  2. Follows OneLegacy’s values in integrity, excellence, service, fiscal responsibility, teamwork, and cohesiveness.
  3. Exhibits leadership, professional behavior and serves as a role model.
  4. Provides direction to field staff ensuring consistency of practice with OneLegacy policies, procedures, and standards in collaboration with the Medical Director, On-call Supervisor, Organ Procurement (SOP) and/or Administrator on Call (AOC).
  5. Consults Medical Director and/or Medical Intensivist. Ensures field staff adheres to Intensivist team recommendations and direction.
  6. Collaborates with other departments such as Family Care Services, Donation Development, Donor Allocation and Tissue Recovery to ensure all necessary personnel are dispatched to appropriate hospitals at the appropriate time to support OneLegacy activity.
  7. Collaborates with Procurement Transplant Coordinators (PTC/APC) and Referral Clinical Coordinators (RCC) to resolve issues, uphold governing standards and build working relationships.
  8. Functions as SME on all OneLegacy policy and procedures for referral management.
  9. Consults with On-call SOP or AOC for any situations that fall out of the normal course of activities of policies and procedures.
  10. Works with the on-call SOP, to schedule Orientees for field experiences including activities to enhance the understanding of donation and transplantation.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (SPECTR) - Clearance Required
description:
Overview

LMI is seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to deploy, integrate, and extend SPECTR, our mission-focused asset visibility and sensor platform supporting Department of Defense customers. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who can work directly with users, understand operational problems, and rapidly turn requirements into working technical solutions. You’ll operate at the intersection of software engineering, systems integration, and field delivery—configuring deployments, integrating customer systems and data, troubleshooting across the stack, and building new capabilities when configuration alone isn’t enough.

This position requires an active Secret clearance. LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Remote (U.S.-Based) | 50–75% Travel Required

We’re looking for an engineer who likes building where the mission happens. You’ll work directly with DoD customers and alongside our Product, Mission Engineering, and core engineering teams to get SPECTR working in real-world environments. Some problems will require configuration. Others will require an API integration, script, deployment change, or new software capability. Your job is to figure out what’s needed, build it, validate it with users, and help turn field solutions into repeatable product capability.

Responsibilities

  • Deploy, configure, integrate, and validate SPECTR in customer environments.

  • Work directly with DoD users to understand mission workflows, technical constraints, and operational pain points.

  • Integrate SPECTR with customer systems, APIs, databases, data sources, networks, and mission applications.

  • Build production-quality integrations, APIs, scripts, automation, and software capabilities to solve field requirements.

  • Troubleshoot issues across applications, databases, containers, cloud infrastructure, networking, and connected edge systems.

  • Support technical demonstrations, pilots, field tests, and operational deployments.

  • Partner with Field Product Leads to translate operational needs into technical solutions and Capability Requests.

  • Work with core engineering teams to transition useful field-developed capabilities into the SPECTR product.

  • Document configurations, technical solutions, and lessons learned to make future deployments faster and more repeatable.

  • Travel approximately 50–75% to DoD installations and other customer locations.

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For

  • Active DoD Secret clearance.

  • 4+ years of software engineering, systems integration, solutions engineering, or similar technical experience.

  • Strong development skills in C#, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar languages.

  • Experience developing and integrating REST APIs and working with relational databases/SQL.

  • Hands-on experience deploying and troubleshooting production software.

  • Experience with Linux, Docker, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS/AWS GovCloud.

  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals and distributed system troubleshooting.

  • Ability to translate ambiguous customer requirements into working technical solutions.

  • Strong communication skills and comfort working directly with technical and operational DoD stakeholders.

  • Ability to operate independently, solve problems quickly, and work effectively in field environments.

  • U.S. Citizenship required.

  • Ability to travel 50–75%.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience delivering software or integrated systems in DoD environments.

  • Experience with RFID, IoT, sensor systems, edge computing, or asset tracking.

  • Experience with .NET/C#, AWS GovCloud, Kubernetes, Terraform, or GitLab.

  • Familiarity with RMF/ATO, IL5/IL6, or other DoD cybersecurity requirements.

  • Experience deploying applications in disconnected, bandwidth-constrained, or edge environments.

  • Experience rapidly prototyping solutions directly with customers.

  • Security+, AWS, Kubernetes, or related certifications.

  • Active Top Secret clearance.

Why This Role Matters

SPECTR has to work where the mission happens—not just in a development environment. You’ll shorten the distance between “the customer needs this” and “it works in the field,” while helping turn lessons from each deployment into a stronger, more scalable product.

title: Senior Backend Data Engineer, Content Intelligence
description:
The Experience team designs Spotify's consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

The Content Intelligence Product Area is a core part of Spotify's Content Platform within the Experience mission. We build systems that create deep, machine-readable understanding of content across audio, video, text, and images before it reaches users. This enables automation, safety, and entirely new product experiences. Our work powers content enrichment, quality analysis, annotation platforms, and scalable intelligence systems that allow teams across Spotify to build without needing direct content understanding expertise.

We're looking for a Senior Backend Data Engineer to help build and scale the systems powering content understanding across Spotify. This role sits at the intersection of backend engineering, distributed data systems, ML infrastructure, and applied AI. You'll take end-to-end ownership of significant engineering problems while working alongside other Engineers.

What You Will Do

  • Design, build, and evolve scalable backend and data systems powering Spotify's content intelligence capabilities
  • Take end-to-end ownership of significant engineering projects, from technical design and architecture through implementation and operation
  • Build reliable infrastructure for large-scale content processing across audio, video, text, and images
  • Create RFCs and contribute to architectural decisions within your squad and across connected systems
  • Develop reliable and cost-efficient systems for high-throughput data and content-processing workloads
  • Work with distributed data systems and large-scale content-management infrastructure
  • Partner closely with other Engineers to plan and deliver technical solutions
  • Contribute to AI and LLM-enabled workflows and infrastructure, including systems for content understanding, enrichment, and processing
  • Evaluate and integrate AI capabilities into production systems at scale
  • Build a strong understanding of adjacent systems and contribute to a shared on-call rotation
  • Contribute to technical quality and engineering best practices across the team

Who You Are

  • You have 5+ years of relevant engineering experience, with strong experience in backend and/or data engineering
  • You have deep expertise in either backend or data engineering and are comfortable working across both disciplines
  • You have experience building and scaling large-scale distributed systems
  • You have strong programming experience in Java, Scala, and/or Python
  • You understand how to design systems with scalability, reliability, performance, and cost in mind
  • You're comfortable taking end-to-end ownership of complex engineering problems
  • You can translate technical problems into designs, RFCs, and executable engineering plans
  • You communicate effectively and enjoy collaborating with engineering, product, and technical stakeholders
  • You're comfortable operating in an environment where backend, data, ML infrastructure, and AI increasingly overlap
  • You're able to participate in a shared on-call rotation
  • Experience with ML infrastructure, AI/LLM systems, agents, model evaluation, or integrating model APIs at scale is a plus
  • Exposure to large-scale multimedia processing, audio processing, search, or recommendation systems is a plus

Where You'll Be

This role is based in London or Stockholm

We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

Learn about life at Spotify

Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what's playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It's in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.

At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we're here to support you in any way we can.

  • Extensive learning opportunities, through our dedicated team, GreenHouse.

title: Manager Data Engineer (Azure)
description:
Company description

Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner helping established organizations get to their future, digitally enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. Overview

We are looking for a Big Data Manager / Data Engineering Lead with 8+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Big Data, or Data Warehousing to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-scale, cloud-native data solutions on Microsoft Azure.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on Azure Databricks, Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Apache Spark, Scala, SQL, and streaming technologies. You will lead a team of 3-4 Data Engineers, providing technical direction, design guidance, code reviews, mentoring, and delivery oversight while remaining close to solution architecture and engineering.


Responsibilities

Your Impact

  • Design scalable Azure cloud-native data solutions and define technical approaches for enterprise batch and streaming data pipelines using Azure Databricks, ADLS, Apache Spark, Scala, and SQL.
  • Lead a team of 3-4 Data Engineers, providing technical direction, mentoring, code reviews, design guidance, delivery coordination, and support removing technical blockers.
  • Build and standardize reusable data engineering components and patterns supporting batch and streaming ingestion, transformation, data quality, and movement across raw, curated, and consumption layers.
  • Implement reliable and maintainable Databricks and ADLS pipelines while addressing performance, scalability, resilience, logging, monitoring, testing, and other non-functional requirements.
  • Collaborate with architects, analysts, QA, client stakeholders, and upstream/downstream application teams to translate business and technical requirements into solution and implementation designs.
  • Debug and optimize existing pipelines and codebases, identifying opportunities for automation, performance improvement, scalability, reliability, operational efficiency, and reduced run cost.
  • Drive engineering delivery from backlog planning and estimation through QA/UAT, deployment readiness, production implementation, operational handoff, and troubleshooting.

Qualifications

Skills & Experience

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering, Big Data Engineering, Data Warehousing development, or related data-platform engineering, including delivery of production data solutions.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with Azure Databricks, Apache Spark, ADLS, Scala, and SQL, including Spark performance optimization and SQL transformation/tuning.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing enterprise-grade ETL/ELT pipelines, including reusable ingestion and data transformation patterns.
  • Strong understanding of batch and streaming architectures, including Spark Structured Streaming or comparable streaming implementation patterns.
  • Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring a small engineering team, with the ability to manage 3-4 Data Engineers, guide technical decisions, review code/designs, unblock engineers, and maintain delivery accountability.
  • Experience translating business and technical requirements into solution designs and technical designs, including appropriate consideration of scalability, reliability, performance, maintainability, and data quality.
  • Experience working within Agile delivery models and collaborating across engineering, architecture, data, QA, and client/business stakeholder groups.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD, testing, source control, observability, logging/monitoring, deployment, and production-support practices for modern data platforms.

Set Yourself Apart With

  • Python / PySpark development experience.
  • Broader experience across the Microsoft Azure data ecosystem.
  • Experience with MongoDB or other NoSQL technologies.
  • Experience designing or implementing data governance and data quality frameworks.
  • Experience in the Healthcare domain, particularly working with claims, clinical, eligibility, provider, or member data and HIPAA-aware data handling.
  • Experience communicating complex technical decisions and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical client stakeholders.

title: At Your Service Center Associate, Reno Meadowood - Part Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an At Your Service Center Colleague, you are at the heart of delivering a seamless and personalized shopping experience. You’ll support all At Your Service activities, including Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS), merchandise returns, order pickups, and other assigned tasks - all while upholding Macy’s service standards.

This role requires strong multitasking abilities, problem-solving, attention to detail, and a customer-first mindset. You’ll thrive in a fast-paced environment where flexibility is key, including working a variety of shifts such as nights, weekends, and holidays.

This role goes far beyond just being a cashier. Here, the customer is at the heart of everything we do - every day, all day. If you're passionate about selling, reaching goals, working as a team, and creating amazing experiences through genuine hospitality, this could be the perfect fit for you! You’ll also help keep the shopping space clean, organized, and inviting so every customer feels welcome the moment they walk in.

How Our At Your Service Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Every day starts with a positive example. As an At Your Service Colleagues (AYS), you come in energized and ready to make an impact - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting teammates with warmth, and helping ensure the At Your Service areas is clean, organized, and ready for customers. You help set the pace by reviewing sales goals, learning about new arrivals and top-selling items, and staying up to date on trends and promotions - so you’re prepared to support the team and engage customers confidently.
  • In the At Your Service area, you lead through action - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships. Assist customers in all aspects of total store fulfillment, including By Online and Pick Up in Store, be proficient in all systems needed to complete transactions, and ensure the collection area is organized so the customer pick-up experience is friction-free
  • You help maintain a shoppable space by recovering merchandise and keeping the pickup and return areas clean while ensuring timely completion and curbside delivery of Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS) orders.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Makes prompt, sound decisions in real time to effectively address customer needs and resolve issues
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics
  • You can handle electronic devices with no problem

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands.
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs. stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level.
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment.
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

This job description is not all-inclusive and may not apply to colleagues covered by a collective bargaining agreement. Macy's Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to an inclusive work environment.

We are building Ventós’ Data & AI function and are looking for someone who wants to play an active role in its development from the very beginning.


We are looking for a profile with professional experience, a strong technical foundation, analytical skills, curiosity, and a desire to continue growing. You don’t need to be a specialist in a single discipline: the role will work cross-functionally across data, analytics, and artificial intelligence, addressing real business challenges.


You will work directly with the Head of Data & AI, in coordination with IT, business teams, and technology partners.


Responsibilities:

  • Explore and understand data from the ERP and other corporate systems, identify data quality inconsistencies, and help resolve them.
  • Build and maintain data loading, transformation, and validation processes.
  • Contribute to the design of data models and semantic models.
  • Develop and enhance Power BI reports, models, and dashboards, as well as existing Analysis Services cubes, troubleshooting issues and incorporating new business requirements.

  • Create tests and evaluation mechanisms to validate data and AI solutions.
  • Document developments and work with version control.

Requirements

  • A minimum of 2 years of professional experience in data, analytics, or artificial intelligence projects, or in software development strongly related to data. Ideally, we are looking for profiles with between 2 and 4 years of experience.
  • A university degree or master’s degree in a technological, quantitative, or data-related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience working with databases, data transformation, and ETL/ELT processes.
  • Strong knowledge of SQL and Python, good software development practices, and experience working with Git.
  • An interest in artificial intelligence and LLMs. If you have worked on any projects using these technologies, even personal ones, we would love to hear about them.

Technology Environment

You will work in an environment that includes, among others, the following technologies:



  • SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and Microsoft Analysis Services.
  • Power BI.
  • Python and FastAPI.
  • Visual Studio Code and Visual Studio.
  • Git.

Nice to Have

You are not expected to have expertise in all of these areas, but experience or exposure to any of the following would be a plus:



  • Azure or Microsoft Fabric.
  • Dimensional modeling and semantic layers.
  • REST APIs and data service development.
  • Docker and Linux.
  • ERP systems or Dynamics 365 Business Central.
  • LLMs, RAG, embeddings, AI agents, or MCP.
  • Machine Learning, inference, or optimization.

Additional Information

We offer a benefits package which includes:



  • Remote work: 1 full day and 2 afternoons per week.
  • Flexible working hours.
  • Free language classes and access to other training courses.
  • Health insurance.
  • Shared spaces for after-work activities.

title: Software Architect
description:
At ADGA, our teams support Government and industry partners on projects that protect critical systems and strengthen operational readiness. We are seeking a Software Architect with knowledge of systems of systems design, and solid DevOps background. The role is to support the development of the Royal Canadian Navy (RCN) Cloud-Native training environment. Require someone with strong triage and self/time management skills as the RCN develops, pivots to right fit solutions.

Exhaustive Cloud-Native architecture knowledge is not immediately required, there is initial project scope to support development of the successful candidate with promising transferable, adaptive knowledge and skills. Within this role individuals with the required knowledge and/or transferrable skills will have the opportunity to develop the capabilities to deliver the requirements listed below.

This posting is for an anticipated position expected to commence in the next few months to accommodate the required security clearance process, we are accepting applications in advance. If you hold Secret clearance, this will speed up the process.

Key Requirements:

  • Develop Cloud-Native architecture for the Royal Canadian Navy Cloud component systems and the Synthetic Training hub, so that each can be deployed as collaborative self-contained units relying only on public or private Cloud-Native infrastructure.
  • Find or recommend Horizon or Synthetic Training Hub Open Source or Commercial components available as containers or from which containers can be built.
  • Create Horizon and Synthetic Training Hub documentation including but not limited to: block level architectural component design diagrams, network traffic diagrams and firewall rulesets documenting allowed traffic flow between components, swim-lane diagrams showing authentication states of relevant personas, for each required workflow, and tables identifying how each component system implements each required security control, or how the component inherits the security control implementation from its containing environment.
  • Develop IaC Deployments for Navy Organizational infrastructure required to support Cloud and Synthetic Training Hub pipelines.
  • Develop Cloud-Native IaC deployments for Navy Cloud component systems and the Synthetic Training hub, so that the RCN or CAF can easily size and tune its deployments to meet performance requirements, reduce cost and easily re-deploy on demand deliverable systems should new requirements or emergency situations requiring rapid re-deployment.
  • Build TLA components from source when required, to create enable container creation.
  • Develop TLA Component containers for use in Horizon Kubernetes deployments.
  • Develop Synthetic Training Hub containers to deliver co-operative multi-user M&S scenarios and their required user experience infrastructure.
  • Must have a Bachelor’s Degree from a Canadian University (or recognized by the Canadian Information Centre for International Credentials (CICIC)) or a recognized College Technical Diploma in field of Sciences, Engineering, Computer Science, or Mathematics.
  • Experience working in a Cloud Native environment strongly preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience as a Software Developer
  • At least 4 years recent experience as a Software Architect designing, developing, and deploying software systems, as well as experience working on multiple projects with the following:
    • Deriving functional requirements in Software Architecture systems
    • Designing complex software systems which includes software and IT architecture
    • Developing complex software systems including software and IT architecture
    • Working in a Microsoft, and Unix/Linux operating system environment
    • Integrating and testing software in a Software Architecture system
    • Generated, updated, and maintained software design documentation
    • Determining and implementing IT infrastructure
  • Must currently hold or be eligible to obtain and maintain a Secret (Level II) Canadian Federal Government Security clearance VCR and Controlled Goods clearances.
  • Work can be done remotely from within Canada.
  • The posted salary reflects an employee compensation model; consultant rates will be adjusted accordingly. We will consider candidates for either employment or consultant arrangements. Consultants will be required to hold a Controlled Goods clearance and Insurance.

If you require accommodations during any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know. We are happy to work with you to meet your needs.
