title: Retail Customer Experience Associate, Willow Grove Park - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As a Customer Experience Colleague, you will create exceptional, personalized shopping experiences for our customers. You’ll prioritize customer satisfaction by actively engaging with shoppers across all touchpoints - both in-store and online - and drive cross-category sales to support overall business goals. With a deep understanding of fashion, fit, and function, you will make tailored product recommendations and leverage digital tools to enhance the customer journey. You also will work across different departments daily, often transitioning between multiple areas throughout the day.

In this role, you’ll also play a key part in client relationship building through outreach tools like My Client and social media. Your collaborative approach with peers, store leaders, and brand partners will help identify opportunities, resolve challenges, and elevate the overall customer experience. In addition to service and selling, you’ll support operational excellence through floor readiness, event execution, merchandise setup, and opening/closing procedures.

A positive, can-do attitude, strong communication skills, and a passion for delivering high-caliber service will be key to your success in this role.

How Our Selling Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Our colleagues begin each day energized and ready to make an impact. They wear their name badge with pride, greet teammates with a warm hello, and help ensure the sales floor is clean, organized, and prepared for customers. Before getting started, they review their sales goals, learn about new arrivals and top-selling items, and stay up to date on current trends and promotions - so they’re fully informed and ready to engage, educate, and sell with confidence.
  • On the floor, they focus on the customer - offering a warm welcome, making eye contact, and creating friendly, personal conversations to create customer relationships to bring the customers back.
  • Throughout the day, they maintain a shoppable space by recovering the floor and fitting rooms, updating signs and pricing, and supporting any needed merchandise moves.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics
  • You can handle electronic devices with no problem
  • At least 2 years of selling or customer experience preferred

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs., stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

title: Two Post Doctoral positions on the drivers of green capital accumulation in global value chains – GreenWorlds ERC Advanced project
description:
Copenhagen Business School (CBS) invites applications for two 3-year Post Doctoral positions on the drivers of green capital accumulation in global value chains, located at the Department of Management, Society and Communication (MSC).

The selected candidates will contribute to the ERC Advanced research project Green Worlds: The material and normative drivers of green capital accumulation in global value chains (GreenWorlds), led by Professor Stefano Ponte.

Overall Project Focus

The GreenWorlds project investigates a core tension in the global economy: how capitalism adapts to ecological pressures and normatively legitimizes itself while maintaining its core logic of capital accumulation alongside the carbon economy. To explore this, the project examines how a variety of ‘green worlds’ of value and valuation emerge, consolidate and decline. Green worlds are different sets of internally coherent principles that are drawn upon by value chain actors to deal with challenges and critiques. They are flexibly assembled by a variety of actors in different value chains and situations to enact justifications related to framing products and/or operations as ‘green’.

The research project asks: What counts as green and for whom? What kinds of practices underpin different green worlds – and how do they shape value chain governance? What are the main features of the green regime of accumulation that crystallizes around these worlds? How does this regime in turn support or disrupt dominant green worlds in particular locations and value chains, and in time—reinforcing, adjusting or breaking a green cycle of capital accumulation?

By comparing selected agro-food value chains (avocados, biodiesel, coffee and wine) in five countries (Argentina, Colombia, Indonesia, Italy and South Africa), the project seeks to explain the contradictory entanglement of ecological concern and capital accumulation, and the limits and possibilities of green transformations.

As part of GreenWorlds, the Post Doctoral candidates will contribute to activities such as:

  • Conducting literature reviews and theoretical analysis for publication in top-tier academic outlets.

  • Conducting and participating in field research (especially by carrying out key informant interviews, focus group discussions, and participant observation).

  • Collaborating in coding of qualitative data (including the basics of natural language processing)

  • Presenting, writing and publishing academic papers in peer-reviewed international journals, also in collaboration with the other members of the team

  • Engaging in public outreach activities (e.g., blog posts, Linkedin entries, short videos, podcasts).

  • Post Doc 1 would be expected to work empirically on two agro-food value chains (wine and biodiesel), especially in Argentina but also globally.

  • Post Doc 2 would be expected to work empirically on two agro-food value chains (wine and avocados), especially in South Africa but also globally.

Qualifications

The applicant has obtained a PhD or equivalent by the start date of the Post Doctoral position. In assessing applications, particular emphasis will be placed on research potential – both theoretical and empirical.

The Post-Doctoral positions are non-tenured positions for a 3-year period with research obligations.

To meet the research obligations, the selected candidate is expected to be on site and take part in departmental activities.

Emphasis is placed on research relevant to the job description.

Applicants should have:

  • A PhD in the social sciences (e.g., political science, sociology, economic geography)
  • Experience with qualitative fieldwork
  • Knowledge of the academic literature on international political economy, and/or environmental politics, and/or pragmatic sociology/convention theory, and/or global value chain analysis
  • High-level English Language proficiency
  • Willingness to reside in Denmark and engage regularly with the CBS research community
  • For Post Doc 1, ability to conduct fieldwork in Spanish is required

The Department

The Department of Management, Society and Communication (MSC) brings together scholars from a range of research areas within management, communication and the broader social sciences and humanities, studying organizations in global environments and the interaction and interdependencies of business, society and government. They share a common interest in studying organizations in global environments and the relations of organizations to the wider society. Information about the department may be found at www.cbs.dk/msc.

MSC is a significant supplier of research-based teaching to a broad portfolio of programs, which includes undergraduate, graduate and doctoral teaching and supervision as well as executive education in the fields of:

  • Responsible management, leadership and governance
  • Corporate responsibility and sustainability
  • Business and development (with an emphasis on the emerging/growth economies context)
  • Organisational communication (corporate communication, strategic communication, leadership communication, marketing communication, international business communication)

Copenhagen Business School has a broad commitment to the excellence, distinctiveness and relevance of its teaching and research programmes. Candidates who wish to join us should demonstrate enthusiasm for working in an organisation of this type.

For further information please contact:

  • Academic Contact: Professor Stefano Ponte spo.msc@cbs.dk
  • HR and hiring process contact: jobcall.msc@cbs.dk

Appointment and salary will be in accordance with the Ministry of Finance’s agreement with the Central Academic Organisation.

The application must be sent via the electronic recruitment system, using the link.

The application must include:

  1. Cover letter (summary of research skills) discussing your alignment with the research objectives of GreenWorlds
  2. An independently written and original (this means no generative AI usage) 3-year project proposal related to the research objectives of GreenWorlds (max 5 pages / 2,000 words excluding references).
  3. Complete publication list (mark up to 5 for assessment with *)
  4. Copies of selected publications (English only)
  5. Documentation of fieldwork and, if relevant, research management experience
  6. Transcript(s) and all academic diplomas
  7. A full and up-to-date CV
  8. Names and contact details of up to 3 academic referees

It must be clearly indicated in the cover letter as well as the project proposal if the application concerns Post Doc project 1 or Post Doc project 2. If an applicant wishes to apply for both positions, a separate project description must be submitted for each.

Recruitment procedure

The Recruitment Committee will shortlist a minimum of two applicants. The shortlisted applicants will be assessed by the Assessment Committee. All applicants will be notified of their status in the recruitment process shortly after the application deadline.

The applicants selected for assessment will be notified about the composition of the Assessment Committee and later in the process about the result of the assessment.

Once the recruitment process is completed each applicant will be notified of the outcome of their application.

Copenhagen Business School must receive all application materials by the application deadline.

Copenhagen Business School invites all qualified candidates to apply for the position. An appointment committee will review the applications and invite a selection of qualified candidates to an interview.

One of CBS’ strategic goals is the promotion of diversity, which is why every effort has been made to ensure a recruitment process that reduces potential bias. Applicants are therefore encouraged not to include a photo or unnecessary personal information in their application.

Details about Copenhagen Business School and the department are available at www.cbs.dk.

title: Full stack Engineer
description:
Full stack Engineer - Integrations

Manila • Ho Chi Minh • Lisbon • Sao Paolo • Buenos Aires • Jakarta • Cape town • Lagos Lagoon • Singapore • Dubai • Cairo • Taipei • Mexico • Budapest

Engineering

Remote

Full-time

Fireflies.ai is the leading #AI teammate for meetings, trusted by over 20 million users across more than 500,000 organisations from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises. Whether in sales, project management, marketing, operations, or product development, Fireflies is revolutionising team collaboration by capturing knowledge, automating repetitive tasks, and enhancing productivity before, during, and after every meeting.

Recognised as a category-defining platform, Fireflies has achieved unicorn status with a valuation exceeding $1 billion. This year, Ramp named Fireflies the 6th most popular AI platform, joining the ranks of OpenAI, Midjourney, and Anthropic. Chances are, you’ve already seen Fireflies in action quietly powering one of your recent meetings.

The Integrations team plays a crucial role in integrating Fireflies with external apps and systems. By building and managing integrations, this team ensures that Fireflies’ data flows seamlessly between platforms, enhancing productivity for users. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a passion for connecting ecosystems are key for this team.

What You'll Do:

  • Develop integrations that connect Fireflies data to various external platforms and ensure smooth data flow between Fireflies and third-party applications
  • Optimise and maintain existing integrations
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver seamless user experiences.
  • Utilise API frameworks to expand the capabilities of Fireflies' ecosystem

What You Need:

  • A minimum of 3+ years of experience in a software development role as a full-stack engineer
    • Our tech stack is mostly Node.js (Express), GraphQL, MongoDB, GCP, Kubernetes
  • Experience shipping fast, reliable, secure applications using modern development tools
  • You have experience working on apps that have supported 10,000+ concurrent users, where you built scalable infrastructure
  • Passion for productivity tools and supporting power users
  • Experience as an API/Integrations Engineer in a startup would be a plus

Qualities we look for:

  • You have the raw intellectual horsepower and the ability to learn quickly
  • You contribute to open source (share your GitHub)
  • You can design and build scalable infrastructure
  • You have experience with real-time apps that use something like OT or CRDT (ref)
  • You understand sound architecture principles and can build end-to-end
  • Meaningful time spent as a Senior engineer or higher
  • Passion for productivity tools and supporting power users

Values that are important to us:

  • You should be a great communicator and culture maintainer.
  • Take a look at our culture document
  • You’re data-driven and customer-focused
  • You value fast & incremental engineering cycles
  • You maintain design excellence and minimise complexity
  • You measure your results & automate when possible
  • You get 10% better at something every week
  • You have an internal compass and take accountability & initiative
  • We value overcommunication, candid feedback and a results-driven culture

Perks and benefits:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Work remotely from anywhere
  • Opportunities to move laterally within a team and grow rapidly
  • Paid time off and flexible leave policy
  • A "no boss" culture that empowers you to take ownership
  • Flexible working hours to fit your lifestyle
  • LGBTQ+ friendly
  • Fun international offsite to connect and recharge
  • Tech reimbursements to support your work

About us:

At Fireflies.ai, we’re revolutionising the way teams interact with AI in their daily work. Our inclusive culture champions security, innovation, customer experience, and growth. Backed by $19 million from top-tier investors like Canaan, Khosla Ventures, and angels from Slack, Facebook, Dropbox, Amazon, and Salesforce, Fireflies is driven by a passionate 100+ member global team spanning 20+ countries and every timezone. We’re building a world-class, global-first team, and we dogfood our product to do so.

We are an equal opportunity employer and strongly value diversity at our company because our team will be stronger with different perspectives and experiences. title: Material Supply (Temporary)
description:
Your opportunity is here.

Division: Warehousing

Location: Calgary, AB

Duration: 12 Months

What We Offer:

  • Salary starting at $31.44 per hour

  • Paid vacation at 6%

  • An engaging, hands-on experience in the gas utility sector.

  • A culture based on caring, integrity, agility, collaboration, and striving for excellence.

  • This temporary position has the potential to open the door to other opportunities within our company.

Why Work Here:

Joining the ATCO Team means being part of a community of people inspiring change on a global scale. It’s meaningful work that can only be accomplished by helping each other, as we collectively look to the future. Collaborating and being professional, down to earth, and caring for one another and for the communities we serve – is central to our core values and cultivates a sense of belonging. We treat people with respect, entrust them to always be their best and take every opportunity to ensure they feel part of our community.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Material Supply to join our Warehousing team! Under the direction of a supervisor, you will be responsible for the shipping, receiving, storing, issuing, transferring, and accounting for materials.

We’re looking for someone who cares about their work and strives for more each day. Someone who challenges the status quo, embraces change, and thrives in a collaborative work environment. If you are someone who approaches work with passion, curiosity, and the courage to innovate, then this role is for you.

At ATCO Gas, we are committed to providing extraordinary service to our customers. We value collaboration, innovation, and dedication to achieving results.

What You’ll Do:

  • Receive, inspect as to condition and/or specification, and record on appropriate forms, all materials delivered from suppliers through orders.

  • Select, pack, ship, or issue, and record materials used by other departments or agencies.

  • Receive and record materials returned from other departments within the company and determine suitability for inventory, reconditioning, or scrap. Arrange for reconditioning as necessary.

  • Assist with any activities assigned for major projects including picking orders, tagging and securing in-storage for use on the specified dates.

  • Schedule material deliveries or pick-ups as necessary and maintain accurate records of all shipments.

  • Perform material counts for both cyclical and group inventories as required. Assist with any recounts that may be necessary.

  • Respond to material inquiries received from other departments, including scheduling material delivery or pick up and advise on material in stock.

  • Contact Suppliers to order inexpensive, repetitive materials as required.

  • Operate heavy equipment, trucks, forklifts, material handling equipment and related machinery and equipment as required.

  • Assist in administering materials documentation, files and reports.

  • Perform housekeeping duties.

  • Advise Inventory Control about shortages or potential shortages of inventory materials as necessary.

  • Investigate any Corrective Action Reports that may be received and initiate C.A.R.s as required.

  • Must possess a thorough working knowledge of all procedures and methods of handling Gas Meters if applicable.

  • May be required to perform delivery and pickups as required.

  • Assist in monitoring Expiry dates on P.E. Pipe, P.E. fittings and risers etc. if applicable.

  • Assist third party contractors directly for the supply of materials, including meters, if applicable.

  • Check all Account numbers given by internal customers for accuracy.

  • Assist in training and direction of new seasonal warehouse staff as required.

  • Perform other related duties as required

What You’ll Bring:

  • High School Diploma or GED is required.

  • Ability to achieve competency in the operation of a forklift and other powered mobile equipment related to the job.

  • Must have a valid Alberta First Class “5” driver’s license.

  • Working knowledge of standard PC office applications and related mainframe systems (Word, Excel, Oracle) would be an asset.

  • Ability to communicate effectively and professionally with internal and external customers.

  • Must have the physical strength to lift heavy materials.

  • Must maintain a strong focus on security and safety, including understanding and implementation of appropriate company safety policies and procedures.

Operational Requirements:

  • May be transferred to other work locations (operating centers and warehouses) within the Calgary area.

  • This position is a Safety-Sensitive position and has additional pre-employment requirements.

We would like to thank everyone for their application; however, only those being considered for an interview will be contacted. Successful candidates may be required to complete a criminal, education and employment background check and other skills assessments as needed for the position.

ATCO Gas is part of ATCO Ltd. ATCO delivers inspired solutions for a better world. We are a diversified global corporation with investments in the essential services of Structures & Logistics, Utilities, Energy Infrastructure, Retail Energy, Transportation and Commercial Real Estate. Learn more about how we build communities, energize industries and deliver customer-focused solutions like no other company in the world at .

title: At Your Service Captain, Green Acres - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As the At Your Service Captain, you are an advocate for the customer and a role model for your colleagues. As an elevated hourly colleague, you are an expert in customer satisfaction , problem-solving, and building brand loyalty. You will drive results through promotional and Omni selling initiatives, such as By Online Pickup in Store and Curbside services. Under the supervision of a People Leader, you will play a key role in communicating expectations and priorities to our colleagues. Advancement opportunities include Sales and Customer Experience Manager.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

What You Will Do

  • As an advocate for the customer, you will role model and provide fast feedback on how to make every customer experience outstanding

  • Ensure high-level of customer service through problem-solving and customer-focused resolutions, such as converting a return into an exchange

  • Enhance the in-store customer experience by promoting our Macy's mobile app

  • Meet with People Leaders throughout the day to plan and monitor total store activities

  • Lead colleagues in the execution and completion of assigned tasks

  • Provide People Leaders continuous feedback that drives a positive customer experience and improves our processes.

  • Perform store opening and closing procedures, including accessing the alarm system and settling the registers

  • Lead and participate in the upkeep of the At Your Service area, processing customer orders, and maintaining back of house areas to our standards for By Online Pickup in Store and Curbside services.

  • Keep current on updates to services, promotions and policies

  • Educate colleagues on point of sale technology, radio frequency equipment, and applications used to assist in fulfillment of customer orders.

  • Perform all applicable sales and/or support duties in addition to above

  • Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality

  • Proficient in communicating effectively with customers and providing clear direction to colleagues

  • Self-starter in adapting quickly to changing customer expectations and needs

  • Resourceful and able to adapt quickly to changing priorities and deadlines

  • 1-2 years of direct retail experience preferred

  • High school diploma or equivalent

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • Prolonged periods (at least two consecutive hours) of standing/walking around the store or department

  • Frequent use of computers and handheld electronic equipment\

  • Reaching, including above eye level, crouching, kneeling, stooping and color vision

  • Lifting and moving items weighing up to 30lbs.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

title: Beauty Brand Expert - Elizabeth Arden, Tysons Corner Center - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Job Overview

As a Beauty Brand Expert at Macy’s, you are the go-to authority for your assigned brand, responsible for driving sales, elevating the customer experience, and leading with passion, expertise, and style. You serve as both a product educator and beauty enthusiast - creating personalized routines, demonstrating new trends, and helping customers look and feel their best.

In this role, you’ll inspire teamwork, coach fellow Beauty Advisors, and lead by example through exceptional service and product knowledge. You’ll foster customer loyalty, build relationships through clienteling, and execute brand strategies, events, and training in collaboration with store leadership and vendor partners. With a deep understanding of your brand and strong business acumen, you’ll analyze sales data, identify opportunities, and deliver results in a fast-paced, goal-driven environment.

How Our Beauty Brand Expert Leaders Spend Their Day…

  • Every day starts with a positive example. As a Beauty Brand Expert Leader, you come in energized and ready to inspire your team - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting colleagues with genuine warmth, and ensuring your counter is polished, organized, and fully prepared to welcome customers.   • You know that service starts with each other. You model collaboration, honesty, and care - supporting your peers so the whole team can better serve our customers and communities.

  • Plan and execute in-store and vendor-led events to drive traffic and engagement
  • Maintain brand standards through proper merchandising, hygiene, and stock replenishment
  • Collaborate with vendors, personal stylists, and store leadership to optimize outcomes
  • Resolve customer concerns in a professional and customer-first manner
  • Stay informed on new launches, best-sellers, and beauty trends to support team education
  • Manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment with strong attention to detail
  • Demonstrate sound judgment, and a passion for the beauty industry
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • 3–5 years of relevant retail, beauty, or leadership experience preferred
  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs., stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. title: Project Manager - QA/QC | Asset Development | Real Estate
description:
Job Requisition ID: 179714

Established in the 1930s as a trading business, Al-Futtaim Group today is one of the most diversified and progressive, privately held regional businesses headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Structured into five operating divisions; automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and healthcare; employing more than 35,000 employees across more than 20 countries in the Middle East, Asia and Africa, Al-Futtaim Group partners with over 200 of the world's most admired and innovative brands. Al-Futtaim Group’s entrepreneurship and relentless customer focus enables the organization to continue to grow and expand; responding to the changing needs of our customers within the societies in which we operate.

By upholding our values of respect, excellence, collaboration and integrity; Al-Futtaim Group continues to enrich the lives and aspirations of our customers each and every day


Overview Of The Role:

The QA/QC Manager is pivotal in ensuring construction quality and compliance across projects, directly protecting the company's investment by minimizing defects and rework costs. The role demands mastery of the Quality Management System, leadership in monitoring various entities' compliance, and strategic execution of continuous improvement initiatives tailored to project specifications and standards. Success in this position involves effective collaboration with project teams, supervision consultants, and contractors, alongside robust documentation management and regulatory adherence, ultimately culminating in seamless project handover and client satisfaction.


What You Will Do:

Quality Management System

  • Develop, implement, and maintain the Quality Management System (QMS) across assigned projects in accordance with company procedures and international quality standards.
  • Ensure successful implementation of QMS across all assigned projects.

Supervision and Evaluation

  • Monitor and evaluate the performance of Supervision Consultants to ensure effective quality control, timely inspections, contract compliance, and proper administration of quality processes.
  • Hire good calibres for the supervision team and enhance documentation cycle and quality of submittals.
  • Increase quality audits and ensure compliance with company policies, Health & Safety requirements, environmental regulations, Egyptian Building Codes, and applicable international quality standards.

Contractor Compliance

  • Monitor Contractors' compliance with approved drawings, technical specifications, method statements, Egyptian Codes, and contractual requirements.
  • Reduce rejected or approved with comments submissions and ensure reduction in recurring quality defects through continuous improvement initiatives.

Documentation Management

  • Manage the complete QA/QC documentation cycle ensuring proper recording, tracking, filing, and retrieval of all quality records.
  • Ensure documentation compliance rate and audit readiness.
  • Review and monitor Inspection Requests (IRs), Material Inspection Requests (MIRs), Method Statements, Material Submittals, RFIs, Mock-ups, and Testing Reports.
  • Review, monitor, and ensure timely closure of Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), Corrective Action Requests (CARs), Preventive Actions, and Quality Observations.

Project Collaboration

  • Participate in project milestone inspections, snagging, de-snagging, practical completion, and final handover processes.
  • Ensure snag closure rate before handover and compliance with company quality objectives.



Required Skills To Be Successful:

  • Proficiency in quality management systems and document control processes.
  • Strong command of Microsoft Office and AutoCAD.
  • Excellent analytical and reporting skills.
  • Leadership and people development.


What Qualifies You For The Role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or architectural engineering.
  • Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in Quality Assurance & Quality Control within the construction or real estate development industry.
  • Proven experience delivering large-scale residential, commercial, mixed-use, and infrastructure developments in Egypt.
  • Extensive knowledge of Egyptian Building Codes, construction specifications, and international quality standards.

About Al-Futtaim Group Real Estate


The real estate development and operations arm of Al-Futtaim, Al-Futtaim Group Real Estate is responsible for a multi-billion-dollar portfolio across MENA. With high-quality residential, business, retail, tourism, educational and healthcare developments, the master developer caters to the diverse needs of cities and communities in the region. From origination, conception, development, sales, procurement and construction of mega-projects and the leasing, operation and management of these projects after completion, Al-Futtaim Group Real Estate (AFGRE) has been developing and managing owned landbanks, unlocking the economic potential of the region and contributing to future development for more than 40 years.
Our focus is to enable and invest in meaningful relationships to make our properties the best places to live and work, build additional products and services and enable partnerships to create true value to our customers throughout their entire experience with us.
AFGRE is responsible for master planning of all projects in its portfolio, including two large scale mixed use destinations: Dubai Festival City and Cairo Festival City.

title: Senior Data Engineer | Technical Consultant
description:

This is an opportunity to work on meaningful projects that directly support Defence capability while collaborating with highly skilled local and international teams across data engineering, software development, systems integration and operational support.

Job Description: We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer | Technical Consultant for a Canberra-based role supporting Defence projects and customers. This is a pivotal position within the Operations Team, offering the opportunity to work at the intersection of data engineering, analytics, systems integration and emerging technologies. You will play a key role in transforming complex operational data into actionable insights, enabling informed decision-making for Defence users in mission-critical environments. Working closely with project managers, engineers, software developers and Defence stakeholders, you will design and implement data integration solutions, optimise data workflows, and contribute to the delivery of innovative capabilities across a diverse project portfolio. As a senior member of the team, you will also provide technical leadership, mentor other engineers, engage directly with customers, and contribute to ongoing business growth through your expertise and industry knowledge.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Transform Defence data into actionable insights that support operational success and informed decision-making.
  • Design, build and manage data integration pipelines across multiple systems and platforms.
  • Integrate and process data from disparate sources, ensuring information is accessible, accurate and operationally relevant.
  • Utilise low-code and no-code integration tools such as Node-RED, Apache NiFi and related technologies to develop and maintain workflows.
  • Structure, cleanse and transform data for reporting, analytics, dashboards and visualisation platforms.

title: At Your Service Center Associate, Chesterfield Town Center - Part Time
description:

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. As an At Your Service Center Colleague, you are at the heart of delivering a seamless and personalized shopping experience. If you're passionate about selling, reaching goals, working as a team, and creating amazing experiences through genuine hospitality, this could be the perfect fit for you! You’ll also help keep the shopping space clean, organized, and inviting so every customer feels welcome the moment they walk in.

How Our At Your Service Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Every day starts with a positive example. As an At Your Service Colleagues (AYS), you come in energized and ready to make an impact - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting teammates with warmth, and helping ensure the At Your Service areas is clean, organized, and ready for customers. You help set the pace by reviewing sales goals, learning about new arrivals and top-selling items, and staying up to date on trends and promotions - so you’re prepared to support the team and engage customers confidently.
  • In the At Your Service area, you lead through action - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships. Assist customers in all aspects of total store fulfillment, including By Online and Pick Up in Store, be proficient in all systems needed to complete transactions, and ensure the collection area is organized so the customer pick-up experience is friction-free

  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Makes prompt, sound decisions in real time to effectively address customer needs and resolve issues

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands.

  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment.
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

description:

Coordinates patient flow for physicians and ensures continuity of high level of patient care and efficient patient flow by ensuring the healthcare team following clinical standards of excellent care.
Primary Duties and Responsibilities:
  • Performs clinical duties, as appropriate, such as taking vital signs, setting up and assisting with minor procedures, blood pressure, point of care testing, etc
  • Assists physicians with clinical procedures, such as injections/aspirations, casting, wound management, verifying and preparing medications, and prepping the patient
  • Prepares charts for upcoming clinics
  • Retrieves and enters patient data for MRIs, X-Rays, EMGs, etc
  • Coordinates surgery scheduling as needed
  • Ensures rooming of patients in a timely matter in order to maintain clinic flow for physicians and physician assistants
  • Receives incoming patient calls and returns patient calls in a timely matter
  • Records accurate, complete, legible and timely documentation as needed in the patient’s medical record
  • Provides patient education related to treatment recommendations
  • Assists physicians and physician assistants with ordering medications and diagnostic testing
  • Scribes for physicians and physician assistances
  • Completes patient paperwork in a timely manner
  • Follows correct procedures for handling and disposing of biohazardous, infectious, and pharmaceutical waste
  • Prepares, cleans and sterilizes, and/or reprocesses, instruments and maintain equipment, according to organizational standards
  • Anticipates and proactively plans for practitioner and patient needs
  • Provides open and timely communication and information to patients, families, and practitioners (as appropriate)
  • Reports pertinent observations and information, both written and verbal, to appropriate staff
  • Assists in orientation of new team members
  • Maintains all necessary certifications and licensure, including first aid and/or CPR, state licensure, national certifications, and continuing education
  • Stays up to date on required trainings such as OSHA, Medicare fraud/waste training, blood borne pathogens training, and sexual harassment training
  • Maintains strict patient confidentiality and follows all HIPAA guidelines
  • Other duties as assigned
Competencies:
Service: We align our actions and decision making with the organization’s guiding platform keeping our patients at the center of all we do.
Change Agent: We support and contribute to positive change in the organization.
Communication and Interpersonal Relations: We communicate honestly and with compassion to build connections with our patients and each other.
Effectiveness: We take ownership of work, doing the right thing for our customer and doing it well.
Organizational Culture:
All OrthoIllinois employees focus on service by putting the mission, vision, and value statements into practice and using the guiding principles of Compassion, Respect, Trust, Integrity, Innovation, Education Fiscal Responsibility, Practice Independence, Accountability, and Empowerment to direct their interactions and decision making. Employees promote and model the service standards to create lasting impressions, extraordinary moments, exceptional on-stage experiences, and meaningful and compassionate connections.
Education and Experience Requirements:
  • High School Diploma or GED, required
  • Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA), Certified Medical Assistant (CMA), Certified Athletic Trainer (ATC), Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN), or ability to obtain Registered Orthopedic Technician (ROT) certification successfully within 6 months from date of hire and maintain certification renewal every 2 years, required
  • One year of experience in a similar role, preferred
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft and Google Suites, preferred
Environmental/Working Conditions:
Working environment is in an office/clinic setting.
Physical/Mental Demands:
  • Stand, walk, sit for extended periods of time
  • Sit, stoop, and kneel
  • Excellent vision, hearing, smell, and balance
  • Requires lifting, carrying, or moving heavier objects (i.e. pushing or pulling up to 100 pounds and lifting and carrying up to 50 pounds
  • Possess full range of motion in shoulders and arms, including reaching above or below the shoulder.
This description is intended to provide only basic guidelines for meeting job requirements. Responsibilities, knowledge, skills, abilities and working conditions may change as needs evolve.

title: Backend Engineer - Data Acquisition
description:
Our Mission: Why Lighthouse?

At Lighthouse, we’re on a mission to revolutionize commercial strategy as hospitality’s most powerful AI platform. We take the world's largest hotel data network and transform it into real-time intelligence that drives action. We don't just deliver insights; we empower businesses to make decisions that move revenue.

With $370M in Series C funding and over $100M in ARR, we are scaling at lightspeed. Our 850+ teammates across 35 countries aren't just building software—they are leveraging cutting-edge AI to help hoteliers be the first to act. Tens of thousands of hotels across 185 countries trust Lighthouse to execute their commercial strategy, including every one of the top 15 global chains and thousands of independent hotels that consistently outperform their markets. With Lighthouse AI, the intelligence gets deeper. Decisions get smarter. Actions get faster. We help hoteliers be first to act.

Lighthouse Values: Our guiding light

We are Lumineers. Our shared values keep us on a collaborative path fostering a cultural and customer centric environment

  • Pursuit of greatness: We’re innovators who care deeply about our customers’ success. Our team brings their best work, stays curious, and delivers excellence through attention to detail
  • Meaningful work matters: We make every moment count by knowing what to deliver, why it matters, and how it drives Lighthouse forward
  • Elevate each other: We don’t just work together - we grow together. What unites us is understanding each other as people and working toward shared goals

We’re more than just a workplace – we’re a community. Collaborative, fun, and deeply committed, we work hard together to revolutionize the hospitality sector. Are you ready to join us and shine brighter in the industry’s most exciting rocket-ship?

Job Details

  • Engineering
  • Spain - Barcelona
  • Full-Time/Remote

What you will do

You’ll join our Crawler Engineering team as a Backend Engineer focused on data acquisition. This is a building role: you'll design and develop high-performance systems, mostly in Rust, that collect billions of data points from the web. The work sits where backend engineering meets how the web works: HTTP stacks, proxies and browser tooling. When a data source blocks an approach, you'll dig into what's happening on the wire and find another way forward. You'll also help make our infrastructure "agent-friendly", so other teams can safely build on it with AI.

Where you will have impact

  • Design, build and improve backend systems for data acquisition that handle close to 200 million requests a day.
  • Work on our in-house proxy layer and browser tooling: request routing, connection handling and protocol-level behaviour.
  • Investigate hard crawler problems, test alternative approaches when one gets blocked, and turn what works into robust, reusable systems.
  • Build clear interfaces and guardrails so other teams and AI agents can use what you build reliably.
  • Own the quality of your code, including code written with AI assistance: tests, observability and maintainability.
  • Work closely with crawler engineers, DevOps and Security to ship solutions that are secure and scalable.

About our team

The Crawler engineering team makes sure Lighthouse customers get fresh, high-quality rates, ranking and supply data. We handle close to 200 million requests a day across 200+ data sources, so the team carries a big responsibility for keeping our crawling infrastructure reliable, efficient and ahead of a web that keeps changing.

What's in it for you?

  • Flexible working environment: Work from home or at one of our global offices.
  • Flexible time off: Autonomy to manage your work-life balance.
  • Alan Healthy benefits: 160€/month for food or nursery.
  • Payflow App: Access your earned salary in advance at no cost to you.
  • Flexible retribution: Optional benefits through tax-free payroll deductions for food, transportation and/or nursery.
  • Wellbeing support: Subsidized up to 80% ClassPass subscription.
  • Comprehensive health insurance: 100% Alan coverage for you, your spouse, and dependents.
  • Collaborative team: High-bar, friendly, creative, and passionate colleagues.
  • Career development: Workshops, frameworks, tools, training, and processes to realize your full potential.
  • Impactful work: Shape products relied on by 85,000+ users worldwide.
  • Competitive compensation: Proactively maintained to value your work.
  • Referral bonuses: Earn rewards for bringing in new talent.

Who you are

  • You have hands on experience building, deploying and running production backend services in a cloud environment.
  • You're experienced with a systems language such as Rust or C/C++, or you have a strong track record in another backend language and a real drive to go deep in Rust.
  • You have a solid grasp of how the web works under the hood: HTTP, TCP/IP, TLS and proxies.
  • You have an R&D mindset. You're curious about how browsers and network stacks work internally, you're comfortable with ambiguity, and you'd rather prove a hypothesis than assume it.
  • You have strong analytical and debugging skills. You're comfortable with packet captures, profilers and reading other people's source code.
  • You communicate clearly, share your opinions, welcome feedback and work well in a team.
  • You're fluent in English.

Technologies you will work with

Rust, TypeScript/Node.js, Python, Google Cloud, Kubernetes, Prometheus, Grafana, Claude Code.

Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Thank you for considering a career with Lighthouse. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace that values equal opportunity for all. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender, race, religion, sexual orientation, and disability. Our commitment to equality is part of our culture. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point during the application or interview process, please notify your recruiter.

Not ticking every box? No problem! We value diverse backgrounds and unique skill sets, and we encourage individuals from all walks of life to apply. If your experience looks a little different from what we’ve described, but you're passionate about what we do and are a quick learner, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Field Construction Coordinator (Associate - Senior Level)
description:
Salary Range: $114,112 - $124,736
Relocation: No

About Us

Oncor Electric Delivery Company LLC, headquartered in Dallas, is a regulated electricity transmission and distribution business that uses superior asset management skills to provide reliable electricity delivery to consumers. Oncor (together with its subsidiaries) operates the largest transmission and distribution system in Texas, delivering power to nearly 4 million homes and businesses and operating more than 145,000 miles of transmission and distribution lines in Texas.

Summary

The Field Construction Coordinator is responsible for the coordination of contract resources for the safe, timely, and efficient construction/maintenance of electric distribution facilities and meter/service activities to meet both Oncor Electric Delivery timelines, Terms and Conditions, and Service Level Agreements. The Field Construction Coordinator acts as a liaison between Oncor Electric Delivery and various contractor resources to ensure appropriate staffing levels are sufficient to meet construction/maintenance dates and regulatory Terms and Conditions. A key aspect of the role will be to resolve issues and answers questions from field related to construction/maintenance projects, service orders and etc.

We are considering applicants with multiple experience levels and skills. Please see below for experience requirements for each level.

Key Responsibilities

  • Adheres to company prescribed safety policies
  • Promote a positive image of Oncor Electric Delivery to public
  • Promotes Safety in workplace for both contract and company employees
  • Understanding of contractual arrangements
  • Assign projects to contract crews
  • Verify sufficient construction resources are in place to meet requirements and/or acts to secure required resources thru proper process
  • Request material kits and interfaces with Material Coordinators to ensure proper materials are available to meet construction requirements
  • Update status of all construction activities on daily basis to ensure accurate records
  • Complete and submit Contractor Performance Evaluations. Ensure safety compliance, adherence to Oncor Electric Delivery standards of construction, job site restoration and construction records and information are completed by and received from contract resources. Pre-construction, during construction and post construction
  • Participate in various types of construction meetings as required. Including but not limited to; Design Personnel, Power Management and Distribution System (PMDS) Managers, Vegetation Management, City Officials, Dallas Area Rapid Transit (DART), Third Party Contractors, Developers, and Customers
  • Address construction issues as necessary to ensure timely construction of safe and efficient distribution system
  • Ensure proper construction practices are followed to minimize cost of projects
  • Verify proper permits are obtained for construction activities
  • Ensure all environmental laws and procedures are followed
  • Verify construction practices comply with all prescribed ordinances, company policies, governmental regulations and the Electric Service Guidelines
  • Communicate status of projects to interested parties as required
  • Proper disposition of “As-Built” information
  • Performs routine “On Call” rotation and emergency restoration
  • Verify accounting for invoices including Operations and Maintenance (O&M) -vs.-Capital and ensure proper tax status is correctly indicated
  • Verify accuracy of contractor invoices
  • Ensure On Time completion for assigned projects
  • Coordinate service restoration with the Distribution Operations Center (DOC) as required
  • Interact with different work groups while meeting the customer’s deadline and maintaining a positive working relationship
  • Performs all essential aspects and functions of the job as well as any other specific job requirements

Skills

  • Capacity to coordinate numerous projects over large geographic area
  • Excellent communication skills both written and verbal
  • Basic computer skills with preference in Outlook, Word, Excel, and etc.
  • Knowledge of safe work practices relating to confined space entry, trench safety and Occupation Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) regulation
  • Knowledge of underground and overhead Distribution Construction practices including but not limited to: Design, method of construction, specification and procedure and the Electric Service Guidelines

Education and Experience

  • High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent required
  • Field Construction Coordinator Level Associate 1 - Associate 2: 3 or more years of directly related technical utility work experience is required
  • Field Construction Coordinator Level Senior: 5 or more years of directly related technical utility work experience is required

Measures of Success

  • Safe completion of projects
  • Timely completion of assigned projects (Terms and Conditions)
  • Accuracy of invoicing certification
  • Accurate documentation and timely status updates of projects
  • Cost control

Benefits

At Oncor, we offer a comprehensive set of benefits, compensation and performance management programs designed specifically to attract, retain, motivate and reward our high-performing workforce. Our supportive and inclusive culture allows every team member the opportunity to thrive and make a difference. We invest in our employee’s success and well-being by offering such things as:

  • Annual incentive program
  • Competitive health and welfare benefits (medical, dental, vision, life insurance)
  • Ability to earn wellness incentives (up to $2,300 in 2026 as an Employee only) and other wellbeing resources.
  • 401k with dollar-for-dollar company match up to 6%
  • 401k match for student debt program
  • Cash balance pension plan
  • Adoption Assistance
  • Mental health resources
  • Employee resource groups
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Competitive vacation, 10 company holidays and 2 personal holidays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Salary continuation for up to 6 months for approved employee illness or injury
  • Other perks such as commuter benefits, electric vehicle incentive program, appliance purchase plan

Participation in benefit programs for employees in collective bargaining units is subject to the applicable collective bargaining agreement.

title: Devops engineer
description:
Functie

Functietitel: Devops Engineer/ Senior Application Engineer

Je maakt deel uit van een multidisciplinair technisch projectteam en bent verantwoordelijk voor de analyse van bestaande Enterprise-applicaties, maatwerkcomponenten en technische afhankelijkheden. Je brengt de huidige applicatiearchitectuur in kaart, beoordeelt de impact van technische wijzigingen en levert een belangrijke bijdrage aan de voorbereiding van migratie-, moderniserings- en lifecycletrajecten. Vanuit jouw technische expertise adviseer je over uitvoerbaarheid, impact op het applicatielandschap en benodigde maatregelen om een veilige en beheersbare transitie mogelijk te maken.

Werkzaamheden

  • Analyseren en documenteren van de bestaande applicatiearchitectuur en technische inrichting.
  • Inventariseren en beoordelen van maatwerkcomponenten en de technische kwaliteit hiervan.
  • Analyseren van interfaces, API’s en koppelingen met interne en externe systemen.
  • Vaststellen en documenteren van technische afhankelijkheden binnen het applicatielandschap.
  • Uitvoeren van impactanalyses ten aanzien van migraties, upgrades en technische wijzigingen.
  • Ondersteunen bij de ontwikkeling van een teststrategie.
  • Bijdragen aan technische validaties en uitvoerbaarheidsanalyses.
  • Adviseren over de technische uitvoerbaarheid van voorgestelde oplossingsrichtingen.
  • Signaleren van technische risico’s, knelpunten en aandachtspunten binnen het applicatielandschap.
  • Afstemmen met architecten, ontwikkelaars, beheerders en overige technische stakeholders.

Gewenst profiel

  • Ervaren Senior Application Engineer met ruime kennis van complexe Enterprise-applicaties.
  • Ervaring met softwareontwikkeling, integraties en lifecycle management.
  • Analytisch sterk en in staat complexe applicatielandschappen te vertalen naar heldere analyses en concrete adviezen.
  • Brede technische kennis en vermogen om technische afhankelijkheden en impact te beoordelen.

Organisatie

Gemeentelijke organisatie De gemeentelijke organisatie bestaat uit 5 clusters, een bestuurs- en concernstaf, 7 stadsdelen en 1 stadsgebied. De stadsdelen besturen samen met de gemeenteraad, burgemeester en wethouders de stad Amsterdam. De 5 clusters zijn: Ruimte en Economie, Sociaal, Stadbeheer, Bedrijfsvoering, Digitalisering, Innovatie en Informatie. De clusters hebben expertise op een specifiek terrein, zoals sport, jeugd of parkeren. Zij werken beleid uit tot stadsbrede kaders waarbinnen de stadsdelen het uitvoerende werk kunnen doen. Ook bieden zij directe ondersteuning aan bewoners die dit nodig hebben, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van participatie of werk. De stadsdelen houden zich onder andere bezig met de inrichting van straten en pleinen, groen en parken en welzijnswerk in de buurt. Ze zorgen ervoor dat wat ze doen, past bij de behoeften in hun stadsdeel en bij het beleid voor de hele stad. Meer informatie over de gemeentelijke organisatie is te vinden op: https://www.amsterdam.nl/.

De opdrachtgever

De afdeling Informatievoorziening werkt voor het gehele Cluster Ruimte en Economie en ondersteunt de directies binnen het cluster met betrouwbare en toekomstbestendige informatievoorziening. De afdeling ontwikkelt, beheert en vernieuwt de applicaties en IT-voorzieningen die burgers, bedrijven en medewerkers ondersteunen bij de uitvoering van gemeentelijke dienstverlening op het gebied van erfpacht en uitgifte. Binnen Informatievoorziening Erfpacht & Uitgifte is het VES-team verantwoordelijk voor het beheer, de doorontwikkeling en de technische continuïteit van een aantal bedrijfskritische applicaties die de primaire processen van de directie Erfpacht & Uitgifte ondersteunen. De medewerkers werken in multidisciplinaire Agile-teams waarin beheer, ontwikkeling en vernieuwing van de informatievoorziening integraal worden uitgevoerd. De komende periode staat de organisatie voor een omvangrijk technisch voorbereidings- en validatietraject gericht op de continuïteit en toekomstbestendigheid van het applicatielandschap. In dit kader worden tijdelijke gespecialiseerde professionals ingezet voor het uitvoeren van technische analyses, architectuurvalidaties, platformonderzoeken.

Eisen

  • De aangeboden kandidaat beschikt over minimaal 3 jaar aantoonbare ervaring met SQL Server, Microsoft.net en Enterprise applicaties
  • De aangeboden kandidaat beschikt over minimaal 3 jaar ervaring met onderhoud en analyse van complexe applicaties waarbij sprake is van API integraties
  • De aangeboden kandidaat beschikt over kennis van en ervaring met erfpachtapplicatieketen van een G4 gemeente met Hermes, OpenText Content Server (Livelink), OpenText Directory Services (OTDS), OpenText Process Server (OTPS), HMS Oracle, HPS Oracle, Edge, Reporting SQL en de onderlinge samenhang en integraties tussen deze componenten
  • De aangeboden kandidaat heeft in de afgelopen 5 jaar minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring als Software Engineer
  • De aangeboden kandidaat beschikt minimaal over een hbo werk- en denkniveau
  • De aangeboden kandidaat is in het bezit van een erkende hbo diploma

Gunningscriteria

  • De aangeboden kandidaat beschikt over minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring met legacy modernisering
  • De aangeboden kandidaat beschikt over minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring met enterprise applicatielandschappen
  • De aangeboden kandidaat beschikt over minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring binnen de overheid
  • De aangeboden kandidaat beschikt over minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring met lifecycle management

Competenties

  • Analytisch vermogen Gevorderd niveau
  • Omgevingsbewustzijn Gevorderd niveau
  • Klantgerichtheid Gevorderd niveau
  • Samenwerken Gevorderd niveau
  • Resultaatgerichtheid Gevorderd niveau
  • Verantwoordelijkheid Gevorderd niveau

Je sollicitatie dient uiterlijk 14 oktober 2026 om 06:00 uur

title: SOFTWARE DEVELOPER SENIOR STAFF HO
description:

  • Perform code reviews, debugging, and root-cause analysis of defects
  • Support agile development activities including sprint execution and backlog tasks

  • Memahami metodologi pengembangan proyek IT (SDLC, Agile/Scrum, atau Waterfall) serta familiar dengan Jira, Confluence, Figma, atau tools sejenis.
  • Memiliki kemampuan analitis, problem solving, komunikasi, dan stakeholder management yang baik serta bersedia ditempatkan di Surabaya.

About the Company

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh.

We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.

Visit our official webpages: https://www.japfa.com/ https://www.japfacomfeed.co.id/

“Growing Towards Mutual Prosperity” is the company's strong belief in the nurturing of mutually rewarding relationships based on trust and integrity.

JAPFA aims to be the leading dependable provider of affordable protein foods in Emerging Asia by building on the foundation of our excellent teamwork and proven experience for the benefit of all stakeholders.

title: At Your Service Center Associate, Orland Square - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an At Your Service Center Colleague, you are at the heart of delivering a seamless and personalized shopping experience. You’ll support all At Your Service activities, including Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS), merchandise returns, order pickups, and other assigned tasks - all while upholding Macy’s service standards.

This role requires strong multitasking abilities, problem-solving, attention to detail, and a customer-first mindset. You’ll thrive in a fast-paced environment where flexibility is key, including working a variety of shifts such as nights, weekends, and holidays.

This role goes far beyond just being a cashier. Here, the customer is at the heart of everything we do - every day, all day. If you're passionate about selling, reaching goals, working as a team, and creating amazing experiences through genuine hospitality, this could be the perfect fit for you! You’ll also help keep the shopping space clean, organized, and inviting so every customer feels welcome the moment they walk in.

How Our At Your Service Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Every day starts with a positive example. As an At Your Service Colleagues (AYS), you come in energized and ready to make an impact - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting teammates with warmth, and helping ensure the At Your Service areas is clean, organized, and ready for customers. You help set the pace by reviewing sales goals, learning about new arrivals and top-selling items, and staying up to date on trends and promotions - so you’re prepared to support the team and engage customers confidently.
  • In the At Your Service area, you lead through action - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships. Assist customers in all aspects of total store fulfillment, including By Online and Pick Up in Store, be proficient in all systems needed to complete transactions, and ensure the collection area is organized so the customer pick-up experience is friction-free
  • You help maintain a shoppable space by recovering merchandise and keeping the pickup and return areas clean while ensuring timely completion and curbside delivery of Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS) orders.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Makes prompt, sound decisions in real time to effectively address customer needs and resolve issues
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics
  • You can handle electronic devices with no problem

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands.
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs. stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level.
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment.
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!
