**Job Description:**

The Business analyst provides business analytics and reporting to manufacturing operations on production programs. Identifies and develops metrics by working with users and stakeholders to understand data visualization and reporting requirements. Translates business results into meaningful metrics and recommendations aimed at improving performance. Responsible for performing financial and business performance analysis. Defines configuration specifications and business analysis requirements. May partner with leaders to assess needs and define requirements.

**Essential Functions:**

- Develop and maintain monthly performance reporting by evaluating historical data trends and forecasting future performance metrics to support data-driven decision making.
- Conduct detailed cost analysis across program financials, identifying key focus areas and delivering actionable recommendations to leadership to drive continuous improvement.
- Perform Basis of Estimate (BOE) development and learning curve analysis by researching comparable programs and applying analytical methodologies to support accurate cost estimating.
- Leverage business intelligence and enterprise tools such as Power BI, MS Office, and ERP systems (e.g., PeopleSoft, COBRA, EMPOWER) to input, manage, and transform data into meaningful reports and dashboards.
- Design and develop advanced data analysis solutions, including automated reporting tools, Excel macros, and VBA-based applications to streamline analysis of program financials.
- Establish and maintain baseline cost planning inputs by gathering manufacturing execution plan data to develop and monitor monthly cost and schedule performance indices.
- Facilitate action plan closure meetings, ensuring accountability, timely follow-up, and resolution of open action items across stakeholder groups.
- Prepare and deliver high-quality reports, presentations, spreadsheets, and executive-level documents that clearly communicate complex data findings to diverse audiences.
- Coordinate and support cross-functional meetings and events, managing logistics and ensuring effective communication across teams.
- Collaborate closely with Operations Managers, Manufacturing and Quality Engineering teams, and Program Management Leadership to align financial analysis with operational goals and program objectives.
- Ability to obtain Secret Security Clearance.

**Qualifications:**

- Requires practical knowledge of job area. Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of 2 years of prior related experience. Graduate Degree or equivalent with 0 to 2 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 6 years of prior related experience.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

- Experience with Earned Value Management Systems (EVMS) and applying EVM principles to track project cost, schedule, and performance metrics.
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex formulas, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, and data modeling, with demonstrated ability to design clear and compelling tables, graphs, and charts for business reporting.
- Proficient in Power BI, including building and maintaining interactive dashboards, reports, and data visualizations; experience connecting and transforming data sources, using DAX formulas, and delivering actionable insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Proficient in relational database tools such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, and Microsoft SQL Server, with experience writing complex queries, manipulating large datasets, and optimizing data pipelines for reporting and analysis.
- Experience developing Excel Macros and VBA automation to streamline repetitive processes and improve reporting efficiency.
- Experience writing technical proposals and Basis of Estimates (BOEs), including cost narratives and supporting data analysis.
- Strong ability to manage and prioritize multiple assignments simultaneously while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
- High attention to detail with a commitment to data accuracy and quality assurance.

title: Associate Director - Fire Engineering (Data Centers)
description:
Company Description

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

AECOM's Enterprise Capabilities is seeking an experienced and bilingual Associate Director – Fire Engineering(Data Centers) to join our Fire Suppression Engineering team in Bogota, Colombia. This role will be pivotal in designing fire suppression systems, particularly for Data Centers.

The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to:

  • Lead fire suppression design for Data Centers (clean agent, double-interlock preaction, water mist, wet/dry systems, fire pumps, tanks, fire hydrants, fire water distribution).
  • Develop basis-of-design, calculations, hydraulic network models, equipment sizing, and detailed drawings/specifications.
  • Ensure compliance with NFPA, FM Global, and applicable building codes; interpret client standards and AHJ requirements.
  • Define protection strategies for white space, electrical rooms, battery/UPS, generators, fuel systems, and special hazard areas.
  • Oversee QA/QC reviews, interdisciplinary coordination (architectural, structural, electrical, mechanical), and BIM model integration.
  • Manage RFIs, submittals, and technical clarifications during procurement and construction.
  • Lead client engagements: requirements capture, technical presentations, design reviews, change management, and stakeholder alignment.
  • Standardize templates, details, calculation methods, and design guides; implement continuous improvement and lessons learned.
  • Plan and manage scope, schedule, and budgets; support proposals, estimates, and resourcing for multi-site programs.
  • Mentor and develop team members; enforce safety, quality, and information management best practices.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, civil, Fire Protection, or related engineering discipline.
  • 8+ years of fire suppression design experience, including 5+ years delivering mission-critical/Data Center projects.
  • Demonstrated expertise with NFPA, FM Global standards, and local code application.
  • Proficiency with Revit MEP and AutoCAD; hands-on with hydraulic calculation tools.
  • Proven team leadership and project delivery experience (scope, schedule, budget, risk).
  • Strong client-facing communication skills; ability to lead design reviews and negotiate technical decisions.
  • Bilingual fluency in Spanish and English (written and spoken).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Fire Protection or Mechanical Engineering.
  • Professional licensure in Colombia and/or international credential (e.g., NFPA CFPS, PE/FPE or equivalent).
  • Deep Data Center expertise (Tier III/IV, N+1/2N strategies, white space/ancillary areas, battery energy storage protection).
  • Experience with FM Global engagement and AHJ approvals for special hazards and large-campus fire water systems.
  • Advanced BIM coordination skills (Navisworks, /ACC/Forma/Bluebeam) and model-based QA/QC workflows.
  • Commissioning/integrated testing leadership and turnover package development for hyperscale programs.
  • Experience standardizing global design content, catalogs, and modularization/prefabrication approaches.

Additional Information

Relocation assistance is not available for this position.

Sponsorship for Colombia work authorization is not available for this position, now or in the future.

description:

At Altis Consulting, we're looking for a hands-on Data Engineer who enjoys being close to both the technology and the client.

This is a role for someone who can take a business problem, shape the right technical approach, and lead it through to a practical outcome. You'll work across modern data platforms and engineering solutions while building trusted relationships with clients and helping develop the consultants around you.

What you'll do

  • Design scalable data platforms, pipelines, integration and analytics solutions.
  • Work across modern cloud technologies including Databricks, Snowflake and the Microsoft/Azure ecosystem.
  • Translate complex business requirements into clear technical solutions.
  • Guide and mentor consultants and contribute to a strong engineering culture.
  • Build trusted relationships with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities to create additional value for clients and contribute to proposals and solution shaping.

What you'll bring

You’ll have strong experience across data engineering, architecture or analytics consulting and be comfortable operating directly with clients.

We’re Particularly Interested In Experience Across

  • Modern data engineering and data modelling
  • Cloud data platforms - Databricks, Snowflake, Azure or comparable technologies
  • Databricks experience essential
  • SQL and modern data integration/ELT patterns
  • Data quality, governance and sustainable engineering practices
  • Leading projects or small technical teams
  • Consulting, advisory or client-facing delivery

You don't need to have worked with every technology we use. We're more interested in strong foundations, sound technical judgement and an ability to learn.

The person we're looking for

You enjoy solving ambiguous problems, can challenge thinking respectfully and know when a technically impressive solution isn't necessarily the right business solution.

You’ll be comfortable talking architecture with engineers one minute and explaining the value of the solution to an executive stakeholder the next.

title: Compound Management Intern
description:
Compound Management Specialist (Part-time Internship)

Time Commitment: 1-2 days per week

Location: Boston, MA

About Proxima

Proxima is a frontier AI and data generation company discovering the next generation of proximity therapeutics by making protein interactions programmable. Our platform brings together foundation-model machine learning, a scalable data generation engine, and a partnership track record exceeding $5B in collaborations across the world’s leading biopharma and tech organizations. We’ve recently closed an oversubscribed seed round with an elite group of VCs including DCVC, NVIDIA’s NVentures, AIX, Yosemite among others.

Neo-1 is our all-atom foundation model that combines state-of-the-art structure prediction and molecular generation in a single system. Neo-1 enables rapid exploration of chemical and structural space for high value, previously intractable targets, and in particular unlocks small molecule proximity therapeutics like molecular glues with AI for the first time.

In parallel, we are developing an advanced structural interactomics platform built on proprietary XLMS technology and a lab equipped with next-generation mass spectrometry instrumentation. This platform produces proteome-scale maps of protein interactions and helps identify small molecules that modulate proximity. Together with Neo-1, it creates an integrated system capable of co-folding protein complexes while generating candidate small molecules to influence those interactions.

Proximity-based therapeutics represent one of the most promising frontiers in modern drug discovery with the potential to treat previously intractable diseases and target ‘undruggable’ proteins. We’re building the tech and the team to make that happen. Come join us!

What you'll do

  • Manage daily chemical repository routines, encompassing the receipt, registration, and intake logging of novel materials into Mosaic

  • Process assay-ready samples, including mass measurement, preparation of DMSO stocks, serial dilutions, microplate reformatting, and liquid handling automation configuration

  • Ensure repository data accuracy through periodic audits, reconciling physical chemical assets with database records while managing cold-chain storage organization

  • Uphold chemical safety protocols, regulatory guidelines, and hazardous material handling procedures while driving continuous enhancement of operational workflows

Your skills

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's program in chemistry, biochemistry, biology, or a related scientific discipline (junior or senior standing)

  • Practical bench experience acquired via academic laboratory coursework, undergraduate research, or industry internships, including gravimetric analysis and micro-pipetting

  • Meticulous documentation practices and precision in experimental record-keeping

  • Proficiency in computational spreadsheets (Excel, Google Sheets), with prior exposure to laboratory information management systems (LIMS) being advantageous

  • Understanding of standard laboratory safety regulations and hazardous reagent management

  • Strong organizational capability, reliability in executing written experimental SOPs, and proactive judgment

  • Strong communication skills and ability to operate within a dynamic environment

Desirable Qualifications

  • Experience operating robotic liquid handling platforms, high-throughput microplate screening, or complex dilution series

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Operator Team
description:
Join a fast-growing, listed company with a purpose! Fastned owns and operates a network of 400+ fast charging stations across 10 European countries, allowing electric vehicle drivers to charge their car with 100% green energy in just 15 minutes. Our goal is a European network of 1000 fast charging stations in prime locations, where all electric vehicles can charge with renewable energy from the sun and wind. We have recently been voted best charging network in the UK, France and the Netherlands. If you want to make a difference and work in an informal, international scale-up environment with future prospects, then read on!

Your role

Fastned aims to accelerate the transition towards sustainable mobility by giving freedom to electric drivers. As a Senior Backend Engineer in the Operator team, you will help build and evolve the software that enables Fastned to operate one of Europe’s most reliable fast-charging networks.

The team owns Revolt Admin, Fastned’s internal operations platform used by Customer Operations, Network Operations and Field Operations to manage and monitor stations, chargers, charging sessions, users and payments. By improving this platform, you will have a direct impact on the scalability and reliability of Fastned’s network.

You will work closely with frontend engineers, product management, product design, other engineering teams and internal stakeholders. This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys taking ownership, navigating ambiguity and turning complex operational challenges into pragmatic, reliable solutions.

Your overall responsibilities include

  • Designing, developing, testing and reviewing reusable, maintainable and scalable code for Revolt Admin and Fastned’s operational platforms;

  • Delivering core Operator milestones that improve Revolt Admin, reliability of Fastned’s charging infrastructure;

  • Working AI-first: using AI-augmented engineering, agentic workflows and AI tooling as a natural part of how you design, build, test and review, with judgement for where AI is a multiplier and where humans stay in the loop;

  • Taking ownership from discovery to post-production;

  • Taking operational responsibility for what you build, including monitoring, alerting and incident analysis;

  • Helping improve engineering methodologies and best practices, and mentoring others as a senior engineer and technical sparring partner in the Operator team.

Who we are looking for

In order to be successful in this role, you bring a strong sense of ownership and a pragmatic, proactive mindset. You enjoy working in a collaborative scale-up environment where things can change quickly and where taking initiative matters.

Additionally, you tick the following boxes:

  • You have 7+ years of professional backend experience, with strong hands-on Kotlin and/or Java experience.

  • You have experience building and operating microservices in production, using REST APIs, cloud platforms and relational databases.

  • You are familiar with event-driven architectures and technologies such as Kafka.

  • You have hands-on experience working with Elasticsearch.

  • You care about reliability, maintainability and the operational impact of the software you build.

  • You communicate clearly, collaborate easily across teams and enjoy mentoring others.

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity, making pragmatic trade-offs and taking ownership beyond your immediate team.

  • You use AI tooling as part of your engineering workflow, with sound engineering judgement.

  • You are fluent in English and have an affinity with Fastned’s mission.

Nice to have

  • Experience in e-mobility, energy, charging infrastructure or another operationally complex domain.

  • Experience building software for internal, network or field operations.

  • Experience with taking technical leadership for a project or domain.

Join us in building a better future

We work hard to change the world, but we don't forget to recognise & celebrate our successes, big and small. We focus on work-life balance, provide genuine work flexibility, and have family-friendly policies in place.

Electric mobility is new territory for you? Don’t worry!

As part of your onboarding, you will participate in a series of exciting workshops where you will learn everything about our industry and fast-charging infrastructure.

Our benefits package includes:

  • Stock option plan - we believe in shared value creation.

  • Pension plan (fully covered by Fastned).

  • A training and development budget of €3,000 per year per employee, because development and training are important to us and our sector offers endless opportunities.

  • In order to experience and enjoy the EV life, you get access to our fully electric vehicle fleet (all charging expenses covered), which is also for private use.

  • 29 holidays. Additionally, we give you two mission days you can use to contribute to Fastned’s mission or to support a cause that is important to you.

  • Going the extra mile for parents: We provide you with personalised coaching support before, during, and after parental leave, facilitated by Foundree.

  • Understanding women's health is beneficial for all of us, fostering empathy, improving communication, and creating a more inclusive workplace. That's why we teamed up with Flouria, providing you with quick access to a broad range of women's health professionals.

  • Daily lunches, snacks & drinks are provided at our office locations.

  • Next to fun events year-round, we throw notorious Christmas parties and organise an amazing yearly trip abroad with all employees.

  • Other perks include flexible working hours, full travel compensation and the working gear of your choice.

Interested in making an impact?

We would love to have a conversation with you!

Here’s the next steps of the hiring process:

  • Screening call with Recruiter

  • Codility assignment and technical interview with our Senior Engineers

  • Culture-fit conversation with the team

  • Closing Coffee Chat with our Head of Engineering / Director of Product & Engineering


Then, it’s time to welcome you on board to Fastned!

Fastned stands for equity and inclusion. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, gender identities, sexual orientations, religions, neurodiversity, disabilities, parental status or any other protected characteristic that makes you unique.

If you have questions or need further information regarding your application, please contact our recruitment team via recruitment(at)fastned.nl

title: Full Stack Web Software Developer
description:
Hi there! We’re a small team of skilled tech-enthusiasts working on a handful of large software projects primarily in the finance, property and telco industries.

We work remotely in our Roam virtual office, with a daily 9am standup and the usual fortnightly agile sprints. We offer our clients the highest standards in software design, development and support—so we all possess a keen attention to detail and a desire to provide a great service, within the boundaries of what’s realistic.

With many businesses keen to take full advantage of AI, a lot of our focus is on implementing agentic systems to ensure our clients stay well ahead in the AI race. We’re looking for new team members as excited about building the future as we are.

The role

In short: Angular focused with Java capability

We’re looking for somebody to join us in building and improving our clients’ modern web applications, while also contributing to APIs, application logic, data and production support. Our current work includes Angular, TypeScript, Java and Spring, but we hire for transferable engineering ability rather than exact framework history.

AI-assisted tools are part of modern development, but they do not replace expertise. You must be able to test assumptions, review generated work critically and take responsibility for every change you deliver.

What you’ll do

  • Build accessible, responsive and intuitive web interfaces using Angular, TypeScript, HTML and CSS.
  • Design maintainable components, application state, forms, validation and API integrations.
  • Develop and maintain back-end services, REST APIs, application logic and data integrations.
  • Write meaningful automated tests and review code for correctness, security, performance and maintainability.
  • Take ownership of features from clarification and estimation through release and improvement.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders: understand the underlying need, challenge requests constructively and explain options and trade-offs.
  • Use AI tools appropriately, verify their output and protect client data, credentials and proprietary code.
  • Contribute to code reviews, team learning and continuous improvement of delivery practices.

What we’re looking for

  • Commercial experience delivering production web applications.
  • Good knowledge of Angular best practices, and the ability to work with Java on the back-end.
  • Demonstrable depth in at least one side of the stack, plus enough experience on the other side to understand, change and debug an end-to-end feature.
  • Experience building or maintaining back-end services in Java, C#, Node.js, Python or a comparable server-side technology.
  • Practical knowledge of REST APIs, databases, data modelling, validation, error handling and common web security risks.
  • Confidence with Git, code review, automated testing and debugging—including production incidents.
  • The judgement to evaluate code critically, whether written by you, a colleague or an AI tool.
  • Clear communication, ownership, attention to detail and the ability to work independently while seeking input when needed.
  • Real examples of collaborating with clients or stakeholders and handling disagreement constructively.

You do not need commercial experience in every technology we use. We will consider a front-end specialist with limited back-end exposure—or the reverse—where there is credible evidence of transferable fundamentals, practical cross-stack capability and the ability to grow. This is not suitable for someone who can work only at one layer and cannot investigate an end-to-end issue.

Useful, but not essential

  • Google Cloud Platform, CI/CD or containerisation.
  • Consultancy or client-facing delivery experience.

Life at Sprint

We offer a flexible, trusting environment where motivated people can do their best work, keep learning and see the impact they create for clients. We value practical solutions, high standards and open collaboration—not technology for its own sake.

Additional benefits include:

  • Bupa health insurance option or cash alternative (after probation period).
  • 22 days holiday + bank holidays (31 days total).
  • Fast and fair progression for high performance.

We aim to complete the process within four weeks. Every candidate follows the same stages and is assessed against the same evidence-based criteria.

Application and verification

We review your CV, short introduction and public professional profile on LinkedIn.

Introductory screen — 5 to 10 minutes

A structured conversation about your recent work, motivation, availability and fit with the essential criteria.

Structured interview — 60 minutes

We ask every candidate questions covering delivery, cross-stack depth, production debugging, client judgement, quality and responsible AI use.

Practical review and presentation

You review a small, representative web codebase and present your findings.

Decision and feedback

The interviewers score the evidence independently before comparing notes. We then make a prompt decision and confirm the outcome.

title: Rakennusalan asiantuntija, kuntotutkimukset, sisäilma ja kosteudenhallinta
description:
Insinööritoimisto 2K Oy on rakennusalan asiantuntijatoimisto. Teemme kosteus- ja sisäilmateknisiä kuntotutkimuksia, kuntoarvioita, asbesti- ja haitta-ainekartoituksia, kosteuden- ja puhtaudenhallinnan koordinointia sekä rakennuttamista ja valvontaa. Hankkeet ovat sekä korjaus- että uudisrakentamista. Tilaajina on julkista sektoria, yrityksiä ja yksityisiä.

Toimipisteet ovat Joensuussa ja Kuopiossa. Teemme töitä tarpeen mukaan koko Suomen alueella, mutta pääpaino on Itä- ja Keski-Suomessa.

Haemme nyt uutta tekijää joukkoomme. Toimipiste voi olla kumpi tahansa, sen mukaan kumpi sinulle paremmin sopii.

Työ

Vastuu hankkeista arvioidaan osaamisen ja oman haluamisen mukaan. Työ on monipuolista ja tehtävänkuva voi koostua mm. seuraavista osa-alueista:

– kosteus- ja sisäilmatekniset kuntotutkimukset

– kuntoarviot

– asbesti- ja haitta-ainekartoitukset

– kosteuden- ja puhtaudenhallinnan koordinointi (KOPU)

– rakennuttajan tehtävät hankesuunnittelusta takuuaikaan

– rakennustöiden valvonta

Kohteina on julkisia rakennuksia, liike- ja toimitilakiinteistöjä sekä asuinkohteita. Iso osa työstä on raportointia, mihin sisältyvät tutkimusraportit, muistiot ja lausunnot.

Toivomme sinulta

Rakennustekniikan koulutusta, eli esim. RI, DI tai LVI-insinööri. Ajokortti ja auton käyttömahdollisuus tarvitaan.

Eduksi katsottavia pätevyyksiä ovat mm.:

– Rakennusterveysasiantuntija (RTA)

– Kosteudenhallintakoordinaattori

– Asbesti- ja haitta-aineasiantuntija

– Rakennuksen kuntoarvioija (PKA)

Näitä ei tarvitse olla valmiina. Jokaiselle tekijälle tehdään oman osaamisen kehittämisen ohjelma, missä kuunnellaan työntekijän omia toiveita esim. kouluttautumisesta.

Mitä tarjoamme

– Vakituinen kokoaikainen työ. Palkkaus sovitaan kokemuksen ja osaamisen mukaan. Kerromme haarukan heti, kun pystymme arvioimaan kokemuksesi ja osaamisesi.

– Suunnittelu- ja konsulttialan ylempien toimihenkilöiden työehtosopimus.

– Liukuva työaika. Osittainen etätyö on mahdollista ja siitä sovitaan henkilökohtaisesti. Kohdekäynnit, mittaukset ja näytteenotot tehdään paikan päällä, raportointia voi tehdä muualta.

– Monipuolinen työnkuva, johon on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa.

– Oman osaamisen kehittämisen ohjelma ja pätevöitymiskoulutukset yhtiön kustannuksella.

– Vahvuutena meillä on tiivis ja yhtenäinen työporukka. Vaikka ollaan pieni toimija, olemme mukana monessa maakunnan kärkihankkeessa.

Aloittaa voi milloin vain. Sovitaan ajankohta yhdessä.

Hakeminen

Lähetä hakemus ja CV osoitteeseen miikka.korhonen@insinooritoimisto2k.fi viimeistään 10.11.2026. Kerro hakemuksessa kumpi toimipiste kiinnostaa.

Hakemus on täysin vapaamuotoinen. Hakemuksessa voit halutessaan osoittaa oman raportointikykysi, koska iso osa työstä koostuu myös tästä.

Luemme hakemukset sitä mukaa kuin niitä tulee ja haastattelemme jo hakuaikana. Kannattaa siis lähettää hakemus heti kun se on valmis. Otamme yhteyttä jokaiseen hakijaan hakuajan päätyttyä.

– Kuopio: Mikko Martiskainen, p. 020 7346 228

title: Senior Security Researcher
description:
About Us

﻿Zenity is the leader in AI Agent Security and the first company to bring an agent-centric security platform to market. As enterprises accelerate AI agent adoption, we are establishing the security framework for how AI agents are secured and governed at enterprise scale.

We deliver full-lifecycle visibility, governance, detection, prevention, and response for AI agents from build time to runtime, across SaaS, home-grown platforms, and end-user devices. Backed by $180M+ in total funding, including a $125M Series C led by Norwest, with participation from SoftBank Vision Fund 2 and Microsoft's M12, Zenity is trusted by Fortune 500 and Global 2000 enterprises worldwide.

Join us in shaping how AI agents are secured at enterprise scale.


﻿About the Role

We’re seeking a Senior Security Researcher to drive end-to-end research initiatives that strengthen Zenity’s detection capabilities. In this role, you’ll investigate emerging attack surfaces, craft and implement innovative detection logic, and test your findings in real-world environments. It’s a hands-on position ideal for someone eager to transform research insights into effective, production-grade security defenses.


﻿Responsibilities

  • Research AI Agent and LLM-related risks, such as prompt injection and jailbreaking and implement sophisticated detection strategies.
  • Conduct research on cloud, web, and API security to uncover new threats and attack vectors.
  • Develop, refine, and design world-class detection logic and rules to enhance Zenity's runtime protection.
  • Perform threat-hunting activities across large data sources to identify emerging attack patterns
  • Drive full-cycle research: from hypothesis and experimentation to production validation.
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to deliver actionable insights.

Requirements

  • 4+ years in security research, including cloud, web, or API security.
  • Experience in detection engineering and building or working with detection-driven security products.
  • Strong coding and data analytics skills in scripting and programming languages such as Python, JavaScript and bash, and proficiency with SQL-like queries.
  • Solid grasp of security principles, cloud security, and runtime defense.
  • Curiosity, creativity, and a self-driven approach to research.
  • Experience tinkering with LLMs and AI security - a strong plus.

title: Senior Consultant – Data Engineer | Melbourne
description:
Build modern data solutions and take greater ownership of client delivery.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Engineerwho combines strong technical foundations with the confidence to work directly with clients and help turn complex requirements into practical, scalable solutions.

This is a hands‑on consulting role for someone who wants to stay close to the technology while taking greater ownership across delivery, client engagement and solution design. You’ll work across modern data and analytics projects, contribute throughout the full delivery lifecycle, and build experience across a range of platforms, industries and client environments.

If you’re ready to broaden your technical exposure, strengthen your consulting capability and have more influence over how solutions are shaped and delivered, this could be a great next step.

What you’ll do

You’ll work alongside clients and Altis teams to understand business challenges, shape the right technical approach and deliver high-quality data and analytics solutions.

You’ll:

  • Deliver Data & Analytics solutions from discovery and requirements through to implementation and support
  • Work directly with clients to understand business needs and translate them into practical technical solutions
  • Contribute to workshops, solution design sessions and technical reviews
  • Design and build data pipelines, data models, database structures and data stores
  • Integrate and analyse data from multiple sources to support reporting, analytics and decision‑making
  • Develop reports, dashboards, visualisations and actionable insights
  • Apply strong SQL, data modelling and engineering practices across client projects
  • Support testing, deployment, User Acceptance Testing and post‑production activities
  • Contribute to project planning, estimation and delivery scheduling
  • Take ownership of your work while supporting and sharing knowledge with others
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders
  • Help clients successfully adopt the solutions we deliver through training and knowledge transfer

The experience you’ll bring

We’re looking for someone with strong Data & Analytics foundations, hands‑on delivery experience, and the confidence to contribute meaningfully in a client environment.

Your experience may include:

  • Data & Analytics solution delivery
  • Strong SQL capability
  • Data modelling and database design
  • Data integration and modern ETL/ELT approaches
  • Data pipeline development
  • Experience with cloud technologies, such as Snowflake, Databricks and/or Google Cloud
  • Reporting, analytics and visualisation solutions
  • Translating business requirements into technical solutions
  • Working directly with clients or business stakeholders
  • Testing, implementation and production support

You don’t need to have worked with every technology we use. We’re more interested in strong technical foundations, sound judgement and your ability to learn and adapt across different client environments.

Why Altis?

For more than 25 years, Altis has focused on one thing: helping organisations create better outcomes through data.

We're Australian-owned and technology‑agnostic, which means our consultants can focus on solving the right problem rather than selling a particular platform.

At Altis you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Work across varied and challenging Data & AI engagements
  • Learn from experienced specialists across consulting, engineering, analytics and AI
  • Build your capability through ongoing learning and career development
  • Work in a collaborative environment where you're encouraged to challenge ideas and contribute your own
  • Work flexibly through our hybrid model
  • Access health and wellbeing support for you and your family
  • Access paid parental leave and our reward and recognition program

Our values — Be Curious, Own It, Lead with Heart and Discover a Way — shape how we work with our clients and with each other.

Your next move doesn't need to tick every box

If the role sounds like the direction you want your career to take but you don't meet every requirement listed, we'd still encourage you to apply.

Different experiences and perspectives make our teams stronger.

If you need adjustments or support at any stage of our recruitment process, let our Talent Acquisition team know and we'll work with you.

Ready to see your career differently? We'd love to hear from you.

title: Architect (Digital Workplace)
description:
Architect (Digital Workplace)

About the Role

Our client is a prestigious, large-scale organization in Singapore with a massive, highly diverse user ecosystem, currently undergoing a strategic digital workplace transformation.

This is a senior role accountable for shaping, governing, and delivering the enterprise digital workplace strategy. This position requires a blend of technical mastery in identity services, collaboration platforms, and endpoint management, combined with strong leadership and stakeholder engagement skills. The role is outcome driven, ensuring secure, seamless, and productive end user experiences that enable business growth and innovation.

Duties and Responsibilities

Scope of Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Governance

• Define and execute a multi-year End User Computing (EUC) roadmap aligned with organizational strategy.

• Establish governance frameworks for identity, access, and endpoint services.

• Drive modernization initiatives that support hybrid work, digital collaboration, and workforce productivity.

• Lead market analysis and technology forecasting to drive continuous innovation, presenting business cases for the adoption of next generation features and solutions.

Identity & Access Management

• Lead enterprise wide identity lifecycle management programs, ensuring compliance with security standards.

• Deliver SSO, federation, and identity governance solutions that simplify access while strengthening security.

• Implement measurable improvements in access provisioning, de provisioning, and audit readiness.

• Manage identity lifecycle processes including provisioning, de-provisioning, and privileged access management. This will cover all organizational identities, including permanent staff, contractors, external partners, and machine etc.

Collaboration Services

• Own the strategy and delivery of enterprise collaboration platforms (messaging, conferencing, authentication, authorisation).

• Ensure collaboration tools are secure, scalable, and user friendly, driving adoption across the workforce.

• Deliver measurable outcomes such as reduced tool fragmentation, improved user satisfaction, and enhanced productivity metrics.

Endpoint Management

• Lead enterprise endpoint strategy covering device lifecycle, patching, compliance, and performance monitoring.

• Implement modern endpoint management solutions (MDM, UEM) to support diverse device ecosystems.

• Deliver outcomes such as reduced downtime, improved endpoint security posture, and optimized cost of ownership.

Stakeholder & Change Management

• Act as the liaison between IT leadership, business units, and external vendors.

• Translate technical strategies into business outcomes and value propositions for executive stakeholders.

• Drive change management programs to ensure smooth adoption of new technologies and processes.

Team & Talent Leadership

• Mentor a high performing EUC team with deep technical and governance expertise.

• Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

• Ensure succession planning and talent development aligned with organizational needs.

Expected Deliverables & Outcomes

• Identity Services: Enterprise wide rollout of unified identity platform with measurable improvements in security, compliance, and user experience.

• Collaboration Tools: Consolidation and optimization of collaboration platforms, resulting in higher adoption rates and reduced operational costs.

• Endpoint Management: Deployment of modern endpoint management solutions with demonstrable improvements in device compliance, patching speed, and reduced incidents.

• Governance & Compliance: Establishment of robust IAM governance frameworks, achieving audit readiness and regulatory compliance.

• Stakeholder Engagement: Clear communication of EUC strategy and outcomes to executive leadership, with measurable stakeholder satisfaction.

• Operational Excellence: Delivery of KPIs such as reduced mean time to resolve EUC incidents, improved employee productivity scores, and cost savings through optimized licensing and infrastructure.

Qualifications

• A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

• A minimum of 10 years of experience in a large-scale enterprise end user environment, with a proven track record of translating strategic vision into executable architecture and operational models.

• Proven expertise in:

o Identity & Access Management (IAM), governance, SSO, federation.

o Collaboration platforms (enterprise messaging, conferencing, productivity suites).

o Endpoint management (MDM, UEM, device lifecycle).

• Strong knowledge of compliance, risk, and security frameworks.

• Demonstrated ability to deliver enterprise scale outcomes in complex organizations.

• Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

To Apply,

Please submit your resume to our recruitment team. We will be in touch with suitable candidates to discuss the opportunity in greater detail.

Data Privacy Notice

By submitting your application or resume, you consent to our company collecting, using, and processing your personal data for the purpose of evaluating your suitability for this role.

Be part of a dynamic, supportive and collaborative work environment.

What we do

The Telecommunications and Network Engineering (TNE) Branch sits within the Infrastructure and Operations (I&O) Division in the Technology and Digital Programs (TDP) Group.

The branch is responsible for delivering modern, resilient and high-performing network and telecommunications services that empower our staff, partners and customers to connect, collaborate and deliver with confidence – from anywhere, anytime.

Our focus is on innovation, security and reliability - ensuring the right technology foundations are in place to support the agency’s digital ambitions and the Australians who depend on our services.

The branch delivers Network, Telecommunications, Gateway and Data Centre connectivity for Services Australia and shared service partners. Our Network covers more than 1,000 locations across Australia and supports secure Tele-Platforms, Networks and Gateway Services for other Government agencies.

Our core branch operations enable the agency to deliver secure and reliable IT solutions and services to customers, partners and staff.

About the role

Infrastructure Engineering Experts manage and maintain ICT infrastructure platforms and services, including design, configuration, deployment, security and operations.

Infrastructure Engineering Experts use deep technical knowledge to deliver reliable, secure and high-performing services. They provide authoritative technical advice, support operational direction and lead the management of complex infrastructure environments.

At the EL1 level, the role operates with a high degree of independence, setting priorities, managing outcomes and influencing decisions in line with business objectives. The role may lead staff, drive improvement and contribute to broader organisational outcomes.

We are recruiting across two technical streams:

  • Data Centre & Network
  • Gateway Services

Both roles require leadership and management skills

  • Lead and manage a team to increase performance and engagement through coaching, capability development, performance management, and health and well‑being support.
  • Lead and evaluate operational practices to ensure continuous improvements; contribute to strategic planning.
  • Effectively engage and communicate technical information with internal and external stakeholders with varying technical understanding and literacy.

Candidates may apply for one or both streams

Where applying for both, applicants should demonstrate relevant skills, knowledge and experience across each stream.

Data Centre & Network

The Data Centre & Network stream, commonly referred to as Data Centre Network (DCN), is responsible for the secure, reliable and high-performing network foundations that support Services Australia’s critical systems and services. The team manages complex data centre networking environments, including Cisco ACI, Nexus switching, F5 application delivery, IPAM/DDI and related infrastructure. DCN plays a key role in maintaining availability, resilience, cyber compliance and lifecycle management across production environments, while supporting major infrastructure changes, technology refreshes and continuous improvement through automation and modern network engineering practices.

Gateway Services

Gateway Services stream is responsible for managing the secure internet gateway connectivity for Services Australia and its shared services agencies/departments. The Gateway Services team plays a vital role in securing networks by managing and controlling data flows between different security domains. The team enforces security policies and helps protect our systems from external threats.

The team specialises in internet routing, enterprise networking techniques including Cisco ACI and Nexus switching, firewall management, DNS solution, proxy management including the secure web gateway and other cutting‑edge network security platforms.

We ensure the gateway infrastructure adheres to governance policies and compliance requirements in accordance with the Information Security Manual (ISM), Essential Eight (E8) and Protective Security Policy Framework (PSPF).

title: At Your Service Center Associate, Washington Square - Part Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an At Your Service Center Colleague, you are at the heart of delivering a seamless and personalized shopping experience. You’ll support all At Your Service activities, including Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS), merchandise returns, order pickups, and other assigned tasks - all while upholding Macy’s service standards.

This role requires strong multitasking abilities, problem-solving, attention to detail, and a customer-first mindset. You’ll thrive in a fast-paced environment where flexibility is key, including working a variety of shifts such as nights, weekends, and holidays.

This role goes far beyond just being a cashier. Here, the customer is at the heart of everything we do - every day, all day. If you're passionate about selling, reaching goals, working as a team, and creating amazing experiences through genuine hospitality, this could be the perfect fit for you! You’ll also help keep the shopping space clean, organized, and inviting so every customer feels welcome the moment they walk in.

How Our At Your Service Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Every day starts with a positive example. As an At Your Service Colleagues (AYS), you come in energized and ready to make an impact - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting teammates with warmth, and helping ensure the At Your Service areas is clean, organized, and ready for customers. You help set the pace by reviewing sales goals, learning about new arrivals and top-selling items, and staying up to date on trends and promotions - so you’re prepared to support the team and engage customers confidently.
  • In the At Your Service area, you lead through action - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships. Assist customers in all aspects of total store fulfillment, including By Online and Pick Up in Store, be proficient in all systems needed to complete transactions, and ensure the collection area is organized so the customer pick-up experience is friction-free
  • You help maintain a shoppable space by recovering merchandise and keeping the pickup and return areas clean while ensuring timely completion and curbside delivery of Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS) orders.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Makes prompt, sound decisions in real time to effectively address customer needs and resolve issues
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics
  • You can handle electronic devices with no problem

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands.
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs. stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level.
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment.
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

This job description is not all-inclusive and may not apply to colleagues covered by a collective bargaining agreement. Macy's Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to an inclusive work environment.

title: Learning Therapist
description:
About Us

Cooper Norcross Health, formerly Cooper University Health Care, is a leading academic health system affiliated with Cooper Norcross Medical School of Rowan University. Headquartered in Camden, New Jersey, Cooper Norcross Health has revenues of more than $3 billion and an A+ credit rating from both S&P and Fitch Ratings.

Cooper Norcross Health has nearly 14,000 team members, including more than 2,200 nurses, more than 1,200 employed physicians representing 95 specialties and subspecialties, and more than 700 advanced practice providers.

The health system operates MD Anderson Cancer Center at Cooper as well as four hospitals – its 663-bed flagship Cooper Norcross University Hospital in Camden, its 229-bed Cooper Norcross University Hospital Cape Regional in Cape May Court House, Children’s Hospital at Cooper Norcross Health in Camden, and The Recovery Village Cherry Hill at Cooper, a substance abuse rehabilitation and inpatient treatment facility, in partnership with Advanced Recovery Systems.

Cooper Norcross University Hospital in Camden is the only Level 1 Trauma Center in South Jersey and the busiest in the region. The hospital has been recognized as a top-performing regional hospital by U.S. News & World Report’s Best Hospitals annual survey for eight years.

More than 2.54 million patients visit Cooper Norcross Health facilities annually. Its ambulatory network encompasses three outpatient surgery centers, seven urgent care centers, a wound care center, and more than 130 physician, physical therapy, and radiology offices extending from the Delaware River to the New Jersey shore.

Cooper Norcross Health, a not-for-profit health system, was named one of America’s Best Large Employers for 2026 by Forbes, ranking among the top 200 in the nation. Visit CooperHealth.org to learn more.

title: Senior Data Engineer (Python / AWS / ML Pipelines)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Data Engineer (Python / AWS / ML Pipelines) based in New Zealand.

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will build and operate large-scale data and machine learning pipelines in a production environment.

You will work across data engineering, cloud infrastructure, and machine learning operations to turn models into reliable production workflows.

The role focuses heavily on Python, AWS, ETL, workflow orchestration, and scalable ML infrastructure.

You will collaborate closely with Data Scientists and ML Engineers to productionize forecasting and data-driven solutions.

You will also help improve the reliability, performance, and observability of critical data pipelines.

Working within distributed Agile teams, you will contribute to architecture decisions and technical improvements across the data platform.

This is an opportunity to work on challenging production systems while continuing to develop your cloud and ML engineering expertise.

Accountabilities

  • Build, maintain, and improve production-grade data and machine learning pipelines supporting forecasting and data-driven decision-making.
  • Develop ETL and data-processing workflows using Python, ensuring they are scalable, reliable, and maintainable.
  • Design and orchestrate workflows using technologies such as Apache Airflow and AWS Step Functions.
  • Use AWS Glue for data processing, transformation, and pipeline execution.
  • Support the deployment and operationalization of machine learning models using AWS SageMaker.
  • Work closely with Data Scientists and ML Engineers to move models and analytical solutions reliably into production.
  • Monitor pipeline health and performance, troubleshoot production issues, and implement improvements to reliability, scalability, and efficiency.
  • Contribute to architectural and technical decisions related to the data platform, ML infrastructure, and production workflows.
  • Collaborate effectively with distributed, cross-functional Agile teams and contribute ideas that improve engineering practices and delivery.

Requirements:

  • Strong professional experience with Python and its application to data engineering and production systems.
  • Proven experience building and maintaining data pipelines and/or machine learning pipelines in production.
  • Hands-on experience with Apache Airflow for workflow orchestration.
  • Practical experience with AWS Step Functions and AWS Glue.
  • Experience deploying and supporting machine learning models using AWS SageMaker.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS cloud services and cloud-based production environments.
  • Experience working with systems operating at significant scale, with a strong understanding of reliability and performance considerations.
  • Experience collaborating closely with Data Scientists, ML Engineers, and other technical stakeholders.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Comfortable working independently and collaboratively within distributed, cross-functional teams.
  • Experience with GCP is a plus but not required.
  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools is also advantageous.

Benefits:

  • Collegial working environment where responsibility and decision-making are shared across the team.
  • Agile culture where employees are encouraged to contribute ideas and influence technical direction.
  • Supportive approach to learning from mistakes and continuously improving ways of working.
  • Opportunities to work on different projects and broaden your technical experience.
  • Ongoing training, mentoring, and professional development.
  • Opportunities for career growth and exposure to new technologies and challenges.
  • Possibility of business travel.
  • Flexible working arrangements appropriate to a distributed team.
  • Additional salary, healthcare, and other employment benefits may vary according to local terms in Slovenia.

title: Remote Data Engineer
description:
Are you looking for a new challenge?


Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance?


Prima could be the place for you.


Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain.


To help fuel that growth, we need a Senior Data Engineer to join our Engineering team.



This team is the beating heart of Prima.



You’ll be joining over 350 engineers across software development, infrastructure, operations and security. Fueled by curiosity, experimentation and collaboration, you’ll help deliver scalable, impactful solutions that shape the future of insurance.



Excited to make an impact? Here are the details



You’ll be joining our pricing and underwriting domain to bridge the gap between machine learning/data science and engineering. You will help build, publish, and maintain our complex data products and pipelines, key elements that have a significant impact on the company’s growth.

What you’ll do


  • Shaping the architecture of data products designed for data analytics and data science specifically focusing on use cases like forecasting, feature engineering, customer behaviour, and integration of new data sources.

  • Leading the way in data transformation by setting up best practices in areas like Data modelling, performance optimisation, Data Governance etc, ensuring that the data used within Prima is consistent, available and reliable.

  • Build reusable technology that enables teams to ingest, store, transform, and serve their own data products.

  • Engaging with data scientists and machine learning engineers to explore the product landscape and refine data requirements for enhanced data infrastructure.

  • Embrace continuous learning and experimentation to stay updated on emerging technologies, from testing open source tools to engaging in community-building activities like Meetups. Your passion for staying at the forefront of the field will drive your journey.


What we’re looking for


  • Expert in batch, distributed data processing and near real-time streaming data pipelines with technologies like Kafka, Flink, Spark etc. Experience in Databricks is a plus.

  • Experience in Data Lake / Big Data Analytics platform implementation with cloud based solution; AWS preferred.

  • Proficient in Python programming and software engineering best practices.

  • Expertise with RDBMS, Data Warehousing, Data Modelling with relational SQL (Redshift, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases.

  • Proficiency in DevOps, CI/CD pipeline management, and expertise in infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployment industry-best practices.


Nice-to-Have


  • Hands-on experience in Data Quality and Data Governance techniques.

  • Knowledge on MLOps and Feature engineering.

  • Exposure to common data analysis and ML technologies such as on scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, XGBoost, LightGBM.

  • Exposure to tools like Apache Oozie, Apache Airflow.


£70,000 - £105,000 a year

Why you’ll love it here:



We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks.



Work Your Way: Enjoy full flexibility – work from home, the office or a mix of both. Plus, work from anywhere for up to 30 days a year.


Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you.


Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support.


Think you’re a match? Apply now.



At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives.


Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at (email protected). Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

The essential duties and responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to, the following:

Leadership:

  • Operate mixer; run Moline sheeter;
  • Assist in ordering and maintaining inventory control of ingredients and supplies.
  • Handle damaged and spoiled products per company policy and assist in controlling the level of damaged goods.
  • Control excessive use of utilities and water, and observe sound conservation practices.
  • Maintain general housekeeping as well as a regular sanitation and cleaning program that meets the standards established for the department, including full compliance with all state and local health regulations.
  • Check refrigeration equipment for proper performance at least once per shift.
  • Use and maintain equipment in orderly manner.

· The associate must occasionally exert or lift to 50 pounds carrying bags of flours, buckets and frequently exert or lift moderate amounts of weight.

· Follow safety rules.

Education/Experience

  • High school education or equivalent preferred, but not absolutely required.
  • Minimum of 60 days of experience in full bakery operations and procedures; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Certificates/Licenses/Registrations

  • Health department training required.

Skills Required

  • Must know how to calculate percentages and ratios when measuring ingredients in dough mixtures and recipes for varying quantities or amounts.

  • Ability to read, write, and understand the English language effectively to read and understand:
    • instructions for operating ovens, fryers, fire suppression system and other mechanical and electronic equipment.
    • company handbooks, policies and procedures
  • Pass a standard drug test and qualify as being drug‑free under the legal and medical guidelines permitted by the Drug Free Workplace Act of 1988.

Physical Demands and Work Conditions

The physical demands and work conditions described below are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Some requirements may be modified to accommodate individuals with disabilities:

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, and use the hands to handle, finger, or feel objects, tools or controls.
  • The employee must occasionally exert or lift to 50 pounds carrying bulk containers of flour, sugar, lard and other materials and frequently exert or lift moderate amounts of weight.
  • Successful performance requires specific vision abilities that include close vision and the ability to adjust focus with sufficient visual acuity to examine vendor invoices, analyze reports and other written documents.
  • Be able to climb a ladder to retrieve inaccessible items from overhead or elevated storage shelves and racks.
  • Be able to perform routine cleaning and maintenance duties including lifting of both heavy and light amounts of weight.
  • Have sufficient physical mobility or agility to be able to respond quickly to fire or other emergencies.
  • Be able to work with bakery ingredients and spices including finely powdered substances, meat products, and produce without suffering adverse allergic consequences that affect the ability of the employee to successfully perform the duties of the job.
  • Be able to tolerate moderate amounts of dust and chemical fumes from common household cleaning agents such as ammonia during routine housekeeping duties.
  • The work environment includes occasional exposure to refrigerated frozen food storage areas with temperatures as low as 20 degrees (Fahrenheit) below zero.
  • The work environment includes frequent exposure to heated ovens and high temperatures.
  • The atmospheric environment may occasionally contain airborne particles of flour, spices, and other finely powdered ingredients and frequent aromatic odors.
  • Typically, the noise level in the work environment is moderate.

title: Azure Data Engineer
description:
London

Permanent

title: Data engineer (VDAB)
description:
VDAB zoekt een Data Engineer voor het data intelligence team. Dit team telt zo'n 40 collega’s. Zij voorzien interne en externe data gebruikers van oplossingen. Denk aan management rapportering en business analyse. Ook leveren ze input voor AI toepassingen. Je werkt bijvoorbeeld mee aan de transitie van een klassieke data toolset (data warehouse) naar een recenter platform op cloudera technologie (data lake).

Waarom zou de kandidaat voor deze functie moeten kiezen?

Je komt terecht in een uitdagende omgeving, in een team met een joviale en inclusieve cultuur waar je kan werken met moderne technologie. Bovendien bouw je mee aan een betere ondersteuning van de Vlaamse arbeidsmarkt

Wat is het doel van de functie ?

  • Je zal een belangrijke rol spelen in een uitgebreide portfolio aan projecten die gepland staan om het bestaande dataplatform te vernieuwen en verder uit te breiden.
  • Je werkt in een compact agile team met een scrum aanpak. Je configureert de nodige ELT stromen in DBT en/of NIFI om data te transformeren.
  • Je voegt data elementen toe aan de datavault met de Vaultspeed automator.
  • Je stelt dimensionele datamodellen op om de gewenste datasets te ontwerpen.
  • Je schrijft SQL-queries om de gewenste datasets voor dataproducten te creeëren.
  • Je test en valideert dataproducten om de kwaliteit en integriteit te waarborgen en testbevindingen op te lossen.
  • Je documenteert de end-2-end oplossing
  • Je geeft ondersteuning bij problemen, performance issues en werkt mee aan procesverbeteringen- en optimalisaties.
  • Je verfijnt, samen met de functioneel analist, de gevraagde requirements voor een dataproduct en vertaalt deze naar een concrete oplossing.
  • Je evalueert de technische haalbaarheid, beheersbaarheid en kostefficiëntie van een dataproduct en stelt hieromtrent verbeteringen voor.

De 3 belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Correct opbouwen van datapipelines die een oplossing biedt aan de beschreven user story
  • Zorgen dat de geschreven code correct getest en gedocumenteerd is.
  • Het scrum team versterken door een actief teamlid te zijn.

Wat zijn de belangrijkste taken?

  • Bouwen van data pipelines in moderne ETL/ELT tools zoals DBT en NIFI
  • Het onderhouden van het data platform van VDAB
  • Schrijven en uitvoeren van unit tests om de gebouwde code te valideren
  • Opvolgen en ondersteunen van de operationele processen in het team, inclusief oplossen van voorkomende bugs

description:

title: 143L - Data Engineer (Python/Go/Data Ingestion/Cloud) · Senior · Remote · LATAM
description:
143L - Senior Data Engineer (Python/Go/Data Ingestion/Cloud) · Remote · LATAM

  • Work Model: 100% Remote
  • Project: Identity Security / Cybersecurity Platform
  • Seniority: Senior
  • English Level: B2 / C1
  • Engagement: Full-time

Get to Know Darwoft

At Darwoft, we build custom software solutions and partner with international companies to create high-impact digital products.

We are a Latin American technology company with a people-first culture, strong professional standards, and a long-term partnership mindset. We work with distributed teams, complex technical challenges, and clients whose technology has a direct impact on their businesses and users.

About the Project

We are partnering with an innovative cybersecurity company building a next-generation Identity Security and Identity Observability platform.

The product helps enterprise security teams understand how human users, service accounts, workloads, applications, and AI-driven identities access systems across cloud, SaaS, network, endpoint, and on-premise environments.

At the core of the platform is a highly data-intensive architecture that collects and analyzes large volumes of events, logs, network telemetry, identity activity, and security signals. This information is processed to identify unusual access patterns, security risks, identity blind spots, infrastructure misconfigurations, and potential threats.

The platform integrates with complex enterprise ecosystems including identity providers, cloud platforms, SASE solutions, SIEMs, endpoint security tools, network infrastructure, and security services.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer focused on Data Ingestion, Integrations, and Collectors to become a key technical bridge between enterprise customers and the engineering organization.

This is not a traditional backend or internal data engineering position.

You'll work directly with customers to understand their infrastructure, data sources, security architecture, network topology, APIs, and workflows, then design and implement scalable mechanisms to ingest that information into the platform.

You'll combine data engineering, software engineering, solution architecture, cloud infrastructure, and technical consulting.

A major part of your mission will be building and evolving connectors and ingestion pipelines capable of integrating data from complex enterprise environments while maintaining reliability, scalability, security, and fast time-to-production.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, develop, and maintain production-grade data collectors, connectors, and ingestion services.
  • Integrate enterprise data sources including identity providers, cloud platforms, SASE solutions, network infrastructure, endpoints, applications, security platforms, and SIEM systems.
  • Work directly with enterprise customers to understand their environments, data flows, APIs, security requirements, and integration constraints.
  • Participate in technical onboarding processes, from initial discovery and architecture design through production deployment.
  • Design scalable ingestion architectures for processing security events, logs, identity activity, network telemetry, and other high-volume data sources.
  • Build integrations using REST APIs, cloud-native services, event-driven architectures, and modern software engineering practices.
  • Develop backend services primarily using Python and/or Go.
  • Work with SQL and NoSQL databases to store, transform, query, and analyze high-volume data.
  • Build and operate containerized services using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Deploy and integrate solutions across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments.
  • Troubleshoot complex customer deployment and integration issues across application, infrastructure, networking, API, and data layers.
  • Optimize ingestion performance, reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with Solution Architects, Sales Engineering, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering teams.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor around customer data architecture, collection strategies, security integrations, and implementation best practices.
  • Identify recurring customer requirements and transform them into reusable connectors, platform capabilities, or improvements to the core product.
  • Contribute technical insights from real-world implementations to the product roadmap.
  • Support production adoption and continuously improve time-to-value for enterprise customers.
  • Participate in occasional customer-facing technical sessions and, when necessary, onsite engagements.

What You Bring

  • 10+ years of professional Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, or related experience.
  • Strong software development experience with:

    • Python
    • Go
  • Strong experience designing and consuming REST APIs.
  • Hands-on experience building data ingestion pipelines, connector frameworks, integration platforms, or similar systems.
  • Experience integrating complex enterprise systems and third-party platforms.
  • Solid understanding of both SQL and NoSQL databases.
  • Production experience with at least one major cloud platform:

    • AWS
    • Azure
    • GCP
  • Experience working with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of Git-based development workflows and CI/CD practices.
  • Experience designing reliable, scalable, and production-ready distributed systems.
  • Strong debugging skills across APIs, infrastructure, networking, application services, and data pipelines.
  • Experience working directly with customers, stakeholders, or technical partners.
  • Ability to translate complex customer requirements into pragmatic technical solutions.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to operate effectively in customer-facing technical conversations.
  • High degree of autonomy and ownership when solving ambiguous technical problems.

Highly Relevant Experience

Experience with any of the following will be especially valuable:

  • Identity and Access Management (IAM)
  • Identity Providers (IdPs)
  • Identity Security
  • Cybersecurity platforms
  • SIEM systems
  • Security telemetry
  • Network security
  • Endpoint security
  • SASE / Zero Trust environments
  • Cloud security
  • Large-scale event processing
  • Streaming architectures

Integration Experience

Previous experience integrating APIs or data from platforms such as the following is highly valuable:

  • AWS
  • Microsoft Azure
  • Google Cloud
  • Microsoft Entra ID / Active Directory
  • Okta
  • Google Workspace
  • Duo
  • CrowdStrike
  • Zscaler
  • Palo Alto
  • Microsoft Defender
  • SIEM and security analytics platforms

Direct experience with every platform is not required. What matters is a strong track record of learning complex APIs and transforming heterogeneous enterprise data sources into reliable integrations.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with large-scale data processing or streaming platforms.
  • Experience designing reusable connector SDKs or integration frameworks.
  • Understanding of identity-related security concepts such as authentication, authorization, credentials, service accounts, privileged access, and non-human identities.
  • Experience with security events, audit logs, network telemetry, or cloud activity data.
  • Familiarity with event-driven and distributed system architectures.
  • Experience deploying AI/ML-enabled applications.
  • Exposure to LLMs, AI agents, or AI-powered security applications.
  • Solution Architecture or Forward Deployed Engineering experience.
  • Previous experience in cybersecurity startups or high-growth SaaS environments.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will be measured by your ability to:

  • Deliver successful enterprise integrations and deployments.
  • Reduce customer time-to-production.
  • Build reliable and scalable ingestion solutions.
  • Improve customer adoption and technical satisfaction.
  • Resolve complex integration challenges efficiently.
  • Turn customer-specific requirements into reusable platform capabilities.
  • Contribute improvements that strengthen the scalability and flexibility of the core product.

What Darwoft Offers

  • Contractor agreement with payment in USD
  • 100% remote work
  • Argentina's public holidays
  • English classes

  • Access to learning platforms
